jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **COMPANY** We build AI technology for the metals industries. Our products work reliably in high\-volume production environments 24/7, making billions of dollars’ worth of decisions. Because we work at the intersection of the heavy industries and AI, we solve problems involving manufacturing operations, physics and chemistry, software engineering and AI. We work to bring AI into the physical world to unlock real value for our customers. Our teams spend a lot of time on site, with the customer, understanding their problems firsthand and iterating quickly to solve them. We operate across two primary hubs in London, United Kingdom and Austin, Texas. For this role, you will be based out of our Austin office (we can accommodate relocation for the right candidate). We try to work with minimal process and permission, but ample support and collaboration. We rarely have a scheduled meeting, but we all work in the office, discussions occur continuously throughout the day, and no request for help goes unanswered for more than a few minutes. Features get shipped to production every day. Many are designed, developed, and shipped on the customer’s site, without a central planning process. **ROLE** As a Deployment Strategist, you will be broadly responsible for successfully deploying our technology in customer sites, in collaboration with forward deployed engineers and others. If the forward deployed engineer is like being the CTO of a deployment, being a deployment strategist is like being the CEO. You will: * Understand the problems of potential new customers. During discovery calls and site visits with executives and engineers, you will build a deep understanding of their industrial process and most important problems. * Work closely with forward deployed engineers to propose solutions. You will create and present demos, data analysis, and business case calculations in support of that solution. * Work closely with forward deployed engineers to successfully implement the solution by rapidly iterating with the customers in production. You will work closely with the customer’s engineers, IT teams, and management. You will do things like train users, do demos, observe usage, gather feedback, present results, and design improvements. * Identify and enter new markets, industries, or potential customers for our technology. * The above activities involve building a deep understanding of the customer in terms of data, physics, manufacturing operations, and business considerations. You will often be the first person who has comprehensively mapped the customer’s data sources and data pipelines; the flow of value and physical quantities through their process; and the decisions made to operate the business. **CANDIDATE** You will have: * **Some programming experience.** Your job might not involve writing a lot of code, but you should understand programming and data. You may have been a professional software engineer, or you have just written modelling code in an academic environment, or simple scripts in a business environment. * At least a bachelors degree or equivalent knowledge or experience in physics, engineering, maths, or a similar field. * Interest and taste in product design. We are open to a wide range of backgrounds, but some examples we expect to see are: * Software engineers or forward deployed engineers * Process engineers and operations managers from manufacturing * Entrepreneurs and management consultants * Technical sales and solutions architects For all roles, we are looking for people with the following attributes: * **Exceptional ability.** Whether in work, school, side projects, or elsewhere, you will have demonstrated exceptional ability. We are open minded about the exact form this takes. Some examples we look for: + You have played a key role in an early stage startup + You have won hackathons, math, or physics competitions + You have an impressive side project, like a popular blog or open source library * **Excellent communication.** In speech and writing. * **Conscientiousness.** You want to do good work, regardless of oversight. * You are excited to have freedom to work without too much process and friction, but at the same time, excited to share ideas and work closely with others. * You’re excited to work in the metals industries, and everything that goes with it. That means excited to travel, spend time in massive factories, meeting and working with a wide range of people. * You are comfortable working in uncertain and dynamic environments. **YOU WILL ALSO** * Prefer mostly work in the office, colocated with your team, rather than from home. * Be excited to travel 25 to 75% of the time.

jobs.title: Engineer II, Smart Factory
jobs.description: We awaken the world with energy. LG Energy Solution is the global leader in lithium\-ion battery technology for electric vehicles and energy storage solutions. Located in Queen Creek, Arizona, LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. is LG Group's first cylindrical battery manufacturer in North America, leading the widespread distribution of electric vehicles with the most advanced battery technology in the world. Join us as we inspire our talent with growth, challenge, action and collaboration to Empower Every Possibility! At LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc., the Engineer II, Smart Factory (AX/DX) will play a key role in supporting the planning, development, implementation, validation, and continuous improvement of AI\-driven manufacturing and automation solutions across battery manufacturing operations. This role connects manufacturing needs with automation, data, and production technology to improve equipment efficiency, process capability, traceability, reliability, and operational decision\-making. The position collaborates with production, equipment, quality, IT/MES, parent headquarters, and external vendors throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements definition and design review through installation, commissioning, stabilization, and ongoing support. Responsibilities: * Review manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled improvement. * Plan and coordinate deployment of AX/DX solutions, including remote operations, autonomous or automated control, product traceability, fault detection and classification, vision inspection, and preventive or predictive maintenance. * Participate in design reviews, specification reviews, Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, functionality checks, performance validation, and production stabilization. * Troubleshoot and maintain AX /DX systems and related production technology, including PC\-based control systems, markers, vision cameras, sensors, interfaces, and network\-connected equipment. * Analyze manufacturing and system data to support root\-cause analysis, system optimization, and improvements in equipment efficiency and availability. * Create and maintain project documentation, issue logs, technical standards, standard operating procedures, test records, and weekly or monthly status reports. * Coordinate project schedules, action items, risks, and deliverables with internal stakeholders, parent headquarters, and technology vendors. * Support AX/DX investment planning, budget tracking, vendor evaluation, equipment and software procurement, and lifecycle management. * Promote safe implementation by participating in technical risk reviews and following site safety, environmental, cybersecurity, and change\-management requirements. * Perform other related duties as assigned. Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required. * 3\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, equipment engineering, factory automation, manufacturing IT, AI transformation, or a related technical environment. * Experience supporting equipment or system installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, or continuous improvement projects. * Experience with data analysis projects, production system projects, or AI\-enabled manufacturing solutions preferred. * Knowledge of battery manufacturing, automotive manufacturing, or other highly automated production environments preferred. * Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support production teams, parent headquarters, and global sites. * Occasional domestic travel may be required to support training, suppliers, project execution, or collaboration with other sites Skills * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including root\-cause analysis and implementation of recurrence\-prevention measures. * Strong organizational and project\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * Ability to coordinate cross\-functional projects and communicate technical details effectively with internal stakeholders, headquarters teams, and external vendors. * Knowledge of PLCs, industrial networks, PC\-based control systems, machine vision, sensors, markers, and production traceability preferred. * Programming and data analysis skills using Python, C\#, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools preferred. * Knowledge of machine learning, advanced analytics, or AI\-enabled manufacturing applications preferred. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools for report writing, presentations, project tracking, and data analysis. * Experience working in a multicultural or globally distributed organization preferred. * Bilingual proficiency in English and Korean preferred, but not required. Why should you work here? 1\. Growth \- You are a self\-driven individual who seeks and captures the opportunities for growth we offer by acquiring and solving tasks. 2\. Challenge \- You reach beyond expectations and strive for innovative methods beyond the traditional. 3\. Action \- You are driven, take initiative, can execute decisions with agility and fulfill tasks to completion. 4\. Collaboration \- You are enthusiastic about teamwork while respecting the different backgrounds and experience of colleagues. EEO Statement LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Recruitment Fraud Alert Notice We have recently become aware of fraudulent recruiting activities in which individuals falsely claiming to represent LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. contact job seekers, advertise fictitious employment opportunities, request personal information, or seek payment in connection with an application or job offer. LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. will never request payment, fees, gift cards, banking transfers, or purchases from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. We also do not request sensitive personal information, such as a Social Security number or date of birth, during the initial application or interview process. Certain information may be required only after a legitimate offer has been accepted and as part of the formal onboarding, payroll, background\-screening, or employment\-verification process. Authorized LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. representatives conducting recruiting business by email will use an official "@lgensol.com" email address. Candidates should be cautious of communications originating from personal email accounts or requests to communicate exclusively through platforms such as Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook/Live.com, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Discord, or iMessage. If you receive a suspicious communication or believe someone is fraudulently representing LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc., do not respond or provide personal information, send money, or click any links or attachments. We take recruitment fraud seriously and encourage all candidates to remain vigilant. Our goal is to help protect job seekers from fraudulent activity and identity theft.

jobs.title: Founding Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You own how MintMCP shows up in the world. We're defining a category as it forms — how enterprises put AI agents to work without handing over the keys — and you're the one who turns a deep, fast\-moving technical product into a story that engineers, security leaders, and buyers actually get. This is a founding role, so you own the whole arc. You'll set our messaging and narrative, the source of truth for what we say, to whom, and why it matters, and you'll hold it steady as the product and the market move underneath you. You'll drive launches end to end, from narrative to release to follow\-through, staying close enough to customers to carry each release from beta to broad availability and own how activated people are on what ships. You'll turn customers like Coursera, Stability AI, and Modern Treasury into case studies and proof. You'll establish MintMCP's point of view on agent governance and get it heard through thought leadership, the SEO/AEO engine, and the agencies that scale it. And you'll build the sales content system that equips our AEs with the collateral they own for prospects and customers. You'll scale yourself with MintMCP’s team of coworker agents (our own product). You'll sit with engineers to learn how the product really works and with customers to hear how it lands, and turn both into differentiated, jargon\-free messaging. Do it well and MintMCP's story becomes the one the whole category gets described in. **About You** ------------- * 5\+ years in product marketing, ideally with technical or infrastructure products. * A strong writer and storyteller who can turn deep technical capability into a clear narrative. * You can sit with engineers and customers, absorb deep technical detail, and turn it into differentiated, jargon\-free messaging. * A strategic thinker — you set positioning and priorities, make sharp trade\-offs about what *not* to do, and tie marketing back to company goals. * Agent\-native — you use Claude and agents to scale your own output, with the judgment to tell a differentiated, on\-strategy idea from one that only sounds good. * Well organized — the scope is broad, and you'll wrangle engineers, internal teams, customers, and agencies at once without letting things slip. * Bias to ship — you can run a launch and move fast. * A track record you can point to: a product or category you positioned, a launch you ran, and the results that followed. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with MCP, AI agents, or enterprise security. * You know the CIO, CISO, and platform/IT buyer — you've marketed to them and know how they evaluate. * Fluent across the content and search stack — SEO and AEO, editorial calendars, and briefing and managing agencies or freelancers. * You've been an early marketing hire or built a function from scratch — comfortable creating structure where there's little. **Details** ----------- In person, San Mateo and San Francisco. Competitive salary and meaningful early\-stage equity (add a range before posting). To apply: email hiring@mintmcp.com and tell us why you're interested.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Flutter, Mobile & Web)
jobs.description: About FaithOnline FaithOnline is building a Gospel\-centered digital ecosystem for real spiritual formation, honest connection, and grounded community online. We believe technology should serve growth in Christ, not distraction or noise. We are pre\-launch and moving quickly. Our platform is iOS and Android first, built for believers who want more than a scroll. Every engineer we bring on shapes both the product and the mission. We are not filling seats. We are looking for builders who care about what they build. The Role We need a full\-stack engineer who can work across the whole stack: mobile, backend, and web. You will build a real product for real users, and your work will ship quickly and carry weight. This is not a slow corporate role with layers of process. We move quickly, learn quickly, and adjust quickly. Everyone here owns their work and runs with it. No hand\-holding required. The role starts as a contract position at about 20 hours per week. Hours and scope can grow as the platform grows. What You'll Work On **Mobile (iOS \+ Android)** * Build and maintain features across our Flutter app * Turn Figma designs into polished, performant UIs with Material Design components * Keep the app stable, fast, and crash\-free * Support App Store and Google Play build, submission, and release **Backend and Infrastructure** * Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and data pipelines * Work across our core stack: Supabase (auth \+ database), GCP (infrastructure), Redis (caching), GetStream (social feed \+ messaging) * Keep us fast, reliable, and scalable as we grow, and weigh in on architecture decisions **Web and Admin** * Build and maintain our web admin dashboard and creator publishing tools * Write clean, maintainable code across frontend and backend * Build the internal tooling that keeps the platform running **Working Together** * Partner closely with product, design, and QA * Take part in sprint planning and ticket refinement over Slack and Jira * Raise issues early, propose solutions, and own your work end to end Our Stack You should be comfortable across most of this, or able to get comfortable quickly: * **Mobile:** Flutter (iOS \+ Android) * **Design:** Figma, Material Design components * **Social / Messaging:** GetStream * **Auth \+ Database:** Supabase * **Infrastructure:** GCP (Google Cloud Platform) * **Caching:** Redis * **Content CMS:** Ghost * **Analytics:** Mixpanel * **Testing:** BrowserStack (App Live \+ App Automate) * **Project Management:** Jira, Confluence/Notion, Slack * **Backend:** Node.js \+ Express \+ Inversify Who We're Looking For * **A true generalist.** You move comfortably across mobile, backend, and web, and you can point to things you have shipped end to end. Breadth matters more to us than any single specialty. * **Strong mobile instincts.** Flutter experience is a big plus. If you have not used it yet but you learn fast and have shipped mobile before, we are glad to teach you. * **You build with AI tools.** Using AI to move faster and write better code is a normal part of how you work, not an afterthought. * **Still hands\-on, and want to stay that way.** This is a build role, not a manage\-from\-above role. The best fit is someone deep in the code who loves being there. * **Startup\-minded.** You are comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you take ownership without being asked. * **A follower of Jesus** who wants every part of life, work included, to glorify Him, and who is looking for a place where His name is welcome rather than off\-limits. Nice to Have * GetStream or a similar social / activity feed platform * Supabase or Firebase\-style backend\-as\-a\-service * Ghost CMS or a similar content platform * App store submissions, TestFlight, and Google Play Console * A background in faith\-based, mission\-driven, or community\-focused products What Success Looks Like * You ship quality features across iOS, Android, and web that serve users and advance the mission * You move quickly through the stack without leaving technical debt that slows the team down * You work smoothly with design, backend, QA, and product * You own your workstream and you deliver * You grow with the platform as it scales from early traction into a thriving community of believers A Note on Who We Are FaithOnline is a Gospel\-centered platform built on a clear Statement of Faith. We believe in the authority of Scripture, salvation through Jesus Christ alone, and the call of the Great Commission. We are building technology in service of the Church, not in competition with it. The engineer we hire should share this foundation. You do not have to agree with every implementation decision we make, but you should believe in what we are building and why. *"Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord."* (Colossians 3:23\) Learn more about us: https://www.faith.online/about Pay: From $60\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Tell us about a mobile app you've shipped to both iOS and Android. What framework did you use, how long have you worked in it, and what did cross\-platform cost you that native would have solved? \* * Walk us through your full\-stack experience. What does your typical stack look like across mobile, backend, and web — and which layer are you strongest in? \* * If you were architecting the backend for a social platform from scratch, what stack and infrastructure would you choose to ensure strong uptime, scalability, and observability — and why? \* * How do you use AI tools in your day\-to\-day development? Give us a specific example of something you built or debugged differently because of them, and where you stop and rely on your own judgment instead. \* * How you work Describe a time priorities changed mid\-project. What did you have to throw away, how did you decide what to keep, and what shipped in the end? \* * How you work What does working in a startup environment mean to you, and how is it different from how you've worked elsewhere? What's the smallest team you've shipped with, and what did you end up owning that wasn't strictly your job? \* Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Member of Product Staff
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ We're looking for a Member of Product Staff to be the GM and owner of a product pillar, identifying what to build, building conviction, shipping with engineering and research, and driving it to measurable outcomes. This is a highly cross functional role and You are close to users, close to the data, and close to the code. You write the PRDs, you query the tables yourself, and you stay with the product after launch until it works. Arena is small, and the product surface is unusually broad: a consumer product used by tens of millions of people each month, an API and enterprise offering that leading AI labs and enterprises rely on, and the evaluation methodology and leaderboard that sit underneath all of it. Depending on your background, you'll focus on one of the following areas: * **Enterprise \& API.** The API and enterprise product surface that labs, enterprises, and independent researchers build on. You'll partner directly with customers to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results; translate their feedback into product and engineering initiatives; and own packaging and monetization so that every new product ships instrumented, billable, and correctly represented in our systems. * **Evaluation.** The products that turn human preference into trustworthy evaluation. This is the leaderboard, the methodology, and the tools model developers use. You'll partner with research to develop new metrics, methodologies, and evaluation protocols that go beyond traditional benchmarks, disentangle performance factors like style, reasoning, and robustness, and protect the scientific integrity and transparency of the Arena leaderboard. * **Growth.** How tens of millions of people discover, use, and come back to Arena. You’ll run experiments, and partner with design and marketing engineering to turn what we learn about our highest\-expectation users into a product they can't stop using. **YOU'LL** ---------- * Own product areas end to end, from identifying opportunities that aren't on anyone's roadmap, to building conviction, shipping, and driving to measurable outcomes * Ship and iterate, You measure, course\-correct, and drive to sustained impact against the companies north star goals. * Work with ML researchers to turn research into product, creating new methods, models, and data consumable for the people who need them * Develop a deep understanding of our highest\-expectation users, consumers, labs, enterprises, researchers and how they actually use Arena * Monitor user feedback, usage data, and analytics to identify trends, prioritize initiatives, and refine what we've shipped * Write the PRDs, specs, and narratives that align engineering, design, research, and leadership, and create clarity out of ambiguity when needed * Make high\-stakes product decisions under uncertainty, and be accountable for the outcomes * Raise the product quality bar on the team and introduce practices others adopt, unblock teammates, and hold the line on craft **YOU'LL HAVE** --------------- * 5\-10\+ years of product management experience on consumer, developer, or enterprise products, ideally including 0\-to\-1 work at an early\-stage company * A track record of repeated, attributable impact, multiple projects across different roles or companies where you can quantify outcomes (revenue, engagement, efficiency) and the impact sustained after you moved on * Product judgment, taste and autonomous ownership. You've identified opportunities, validated them with evidence, built buy\-in, shipped, and the bet paid off. * You’ve killed important projects in your career for the betterment of the product. * Clear, persuasive communication. You build buy\-in across engineering, research, design, and leadership. You create clarity for others, not just yourself * Technical depth to work directly with engineers and researchers * Genuine conviction about AI evaluation and Arena's mission — you can articulate why this domain matters and where the product should go * Comfort with ambiguity. We're a startup. Scope is fluid, context shifts, and you'll wear many hats **BONUS POINTS** ---------------- * Production experience with AI/LLM systems — inference pipelines, evaluation workflows, model integration, or AI\-powered product features * Experience with developer\- or enterprise\-facing products, and fluency in consumption or usage\-based revenue models * Comfort working with real\-world usage data and designing metrics beyond standard benchmarks, including experiments run with statistical rigor * Experience growing a consumer or developer product at scale, with hands\-on ownership of experimentation and analytics * You've raised the bar on a team with measurable before/after — introduced practices, tools, or standards that others adopted **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Kernel Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About NeuroSpark** NeuroSpark builds and operates a high\-performance AI inference platform that helps enterprises run large language models faster, cheaper, and at scale. Inference infrastructure is the foundation the entire AI application layer runs on — every AI product ultimately depends on how fast, how reliably, and how affordably models can serve their users. Our vision is to make that layer so efficient that compute is never the reason a good AI product fails.### **About the Role** NeuroSpark Inc operates an enterprise AI inference platform providing high\-throughput, low\-latency access to large language models across a distributed, heterogeneous compute fleet. As a **Member of Technical Staff, Kernel Engineer**, you will work at the lowest performance\-critical layers of NeuroSpark's inference stack, designing and optimizing GPU and accelerator kernels that directly determine model latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and hardware utilization. You will work across the boundary between model architecture, GPU execution, inference runtimes, and distributed serving systems. The role involves identifying performance bottlenecks in real production workloads, developing hardware\-aware optimizations, and integrating those improvements into the systems that serve models at scale. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role with significant technical ownership. You will work closely with engineers across inference, distributed systems, and infrastructure to push model performance across current and emerging accelerator platforms. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and optimize high\-performance GPU kernels for performance\-critical AI operations, including **GEMM, attention, normalization, quantization, KV\-cache operations, and Mixture\-of\-Experts (MoE) workloads**. * Develop and optimize kernels using technologies such as **CUDA, Triton, C\+\+, PTX, CUTLASS**, and related GPU programming frameworks. * Profile production inference workloads to identify bottlenecks across **compute, memory bandwidth, memory hierarchy, kernel launch overhead, synchronization, and data movement**. * Optimize GPU execution through techniques including **memory coalescing, shared\-memory utilization, tiling, warp\-level programming, Tensor Core utilization, operator fusion, latency hiding, and compute/communication overlap**. * Improve end\-to\-end LLM inference performance across **latency, throughput, memory utilization, concurrency, and hardware efficiency**, rather than optimizing kernels in isolation. * Develop and optimize kernels for modern model architectures, including **Transformer\-based LLMs, attention variants, MoE models, and emerging model architectures**. * Implement and evaluate lower\-precision execution and quantization strategies, including **FP16, BF16, FP8, FP4, INT8**, and other hardware\-supported formats. * Integrate optimized kernels and operators into inference frameworks and internal runtimes built around technologies such as **PyTorch, Triton, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM**, or equivalent systems. * Use profiling and performance\-analysis tools such as **Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, PyTorch Profiler, roofline analysis**, and internal benchmarking infrastructure to diagnose and resolve performance regressions. * Build reliable benchmarks, correctness tests, and performance regression tests to ensure kernel improvements remain numerically correct and production\-ready. * Optimize workloads across **multi\-GPU and distributed environments**, working with the broader infrastructure team on communication, parallelism, and compute efficiency. * Help extend NeuroSpark's inference stack across heterogeneous hardware, including **NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and other current and emerging AI accelerators**. * Work closely with hardware vendors, inference engineers, and distributed\-systems engineers to evaluate new accelerator architectures and translate hardware capabilities into production performance improvements. * Contribute to architectural decisions affecting the Company's inference runtime, model execution layer, and hardware\-performance roadmap. ### **Qualifications** * Strong experience in **GPU programming, kernel development, high\-performance computing, ML systems, or performance engineering**. * Proficiency in **C\+\+** and hands\-on experience with **CUDA, Triton**, or another accelerator programming model. * Strong understanding of modern GPU architecture, including: * + GPU memory hierarchy + Threads, warps, blocks, and grids + Shared memory and register usage + Memory bandwidth and access patterns + Tensor Cores + Synchronization and parallel execution + Occupancy and instruction\-level parallelism * Experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads for **latency, throughput, memory usage, and hardware utilization**. * Experience with performance\-critical machine\-learning operations such as **attention, GEMM, quantization, KV cache, MoE, or other Transformer operators**. * Familiarity with **PyTorch** and modern ML inference or training execution stacks. * Strong understanding of numerical correctness, floating\-point behavior, and mixed\-precision computation. * Ability to reason from first principles about performance bottlenecks across hardware and software layers. * Strong debugging skills and the ability to take performance work from profiling and hypothesis through implementation, benchmarking, and production deployment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative engineering environment. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with **PTX/SASS, CUTLASS, CuTe, CUB, Thrust**, or other low\-level GPU libraries and programming abstractions. * Experience with inference frameworks such as **vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM, FlashInfer**, or similar systems. * Experience implementing or optimizing **FlashAttention or other fused attention kernels**. * Experience with **ROCm / HIP** and AMD GPU architectures. * Experience optimizing workloads across **multi\-GPU or multi\-node systems**, including NCCL and collective communication. * Knowledge of ML compiler and runtime systems such as **torch.compile, XLA, MLIR, TVM**, or related compiler stacks. * Experience with **distributed training and inference**, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, or expert parallelism. * Experience optimizing workloads on multiple accelerator architectures or developing hardware\-portable kernels. * Contributions to open\-source projects in **GPU kernels, ML systems, inference engines, compilers, or high\-performance computing**. * Experience bringing new model architectures or accelerator platforms into production. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** The expected base salary range for this position is: **$170,000 – $350,000 USD per year** Actual compensation will depend on experience, technical depth, level, and role scope. This position also includes: * **Equity / stock options** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Unlimited PTO * Opportunities for significant technical ownership and impact * **H\-1B and other work visa sponsorship available**

University students, recent graduates, bootcamp graduates, and self\-taught developers are encouraged to apply. **Nice to Have** * Basic React or Next.js experience * Basic Node.js or Python experience * Familiarity with Git and GitHub * Basic knowledge of databases * Understanding of APIs * Personal, university, or bootcamp software projects * GitHub repositories demonstrating your work with: * Modern frontend development * Backend development * REST APIs * Databases * Git and GitHub workflows * Debugging and testing * Code reviews * Professional software development practices * environment * Hands\-on software development experience * Opportunity to work on real internal and client projects * Technical guidance and feedback * Exposure to modern development tools and technologies * Experience working with an international team * Opportunity to build your professional portfolio * Potential opportunity for a longer\-term developer position based on performance and technologies you are currently learning or working with, and why you are interested in this internship * Your GitHub profile, portfolio, university projects, or other relevant project links, if available * Your current location and time zone * Your current education or employment status * Your general weekly availability * Your expected hourly rate, if applicable Please include **“Software Developer Intern Application”** in the email subject line. We look forward to hearing from motivated developers who are eager to gain practical experience, learn from real projects, and grow their software development skills with Nexorlio. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** ------------- * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Software Engineer I/II - Scientific Computing
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY Iambic is seeking a Software Engineer to build software that helps computational chemists run, monitor, and analyze scientific workloads. You will join the Software Engineering group and work closely with computational chemists and machine learning researchers to turn research needs into reliable Python applications and cloud workflows. The role spans design, implementation, deployment, and support for software used in computational drug discovery. This full\-time role is based on the US East Coast, ideally in Boston; remote work elsewhere in the United States is also considered. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Partner closely with computational chemists and machine learning researchers to understand research needs and deliver practical software solutions. * Build and maintain Python applications, libraries, APIs, and command\-line tools. * Develop reliable workflows for drug discovery workloads. * Improve orchestration, monitoring, and recovery for workloads on AWS and neo\-clouds such as Modal and Lambda. * Integrate scientific applications with shared data, compute, and model services. * Troubleshoot issues, document tools, and help scientists use them effectively. * Contribute to design, testing, review, deployment, and production support. QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field and five or more years of software development experience, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong Python skills and experience writing clear, tested, maintainable production code. * Experience running scientific or batch workloads on AWS. * Experience with Prefect or another workflow orchestration system. * Familiarity with computational chemistry workloads such as molecular dynamics or docking. * Familiarity with the machine learning model lifecycle * Strong service mindset, clear communication, and a genuine interest in helping scientists be effective. ABOUT IAMBIC THERAPEUTICS Iambic is a clinical\-stage life\-science and technology company developing novel medicines using its AI\-driven discovery and development platform. Based in San Diego and founded in 2020, Iambic has assembled a world\-class team that unites pioneering AI experts and experienced drug hunters. The Iambic platform has demonstrated delivery of new drug candidates to human clinical trials with unprecedented speed and across multiple target classes and mechanisms of action. Iambic is advancing a pipeline of potential best\-in\-class and first\-in\-class clinical assets, both internally and in partnership, to address urgent unmet patient need. Learn more about the Iambic team, platform, pipeline, and partnerships at iambic.ai. MISSION \& CORE VALUES Our mission is to deliver better medicines through innovations in AI\-based discovery technologies. The culture and work at Iambic Therapeutics are profoundly strengthened by the diversity of our people and our differences in background, culture, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, and life experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where a diverse group of talented humans work together to discover therapeutics and create technologies. PAY AND BENEFITS We offer industry leading competitive pay, company paid healthcare, flexible spending accounts, voluntary life insurance, 401K matching, and uncapped vacation to our team. We are in a brand\-new state\-of\-the art facility in beautiful San Diego with an onsite gym, dining, and easy access to great places to live and play. Compensation Range: $129K \- $190K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **Key Responsibilities \& Duties** * Design, build, and ship full stack features across our Registry platform — frontend, backend, and database. * Build and maintain integrations with our core platforms, including Healthie (EMR), Candid (RCM), Spruce (messaging), and HubSpot. * Write and maintain APIs and webhooks that connect FamilyWell's systems, with attention to idempotency, retries, and data reconciliation. * Design and evolve database schemas and queries (Postgres), balancing performance, data integrity, and clarity. * Partner with Product, Data, and Clinical Operations to translate requirements into technical designs and shipped software. * Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests; participate in code review and uphold engineering quality standards. * Support CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and monitoring/observability for the systems you build. * Follow HIPAA and security best practices for handling protected health information (PHI). * Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working cross\-functionally to identify root causes. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3–6\+ years of professional software engineering experience as a full stack developer. * Proficiency with a modern JavaScript/TypeScript stack (e.g., React/Next.js on the frontend; Node.js or Python on the backend). * Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases (Postgres preferred). * Experience building and consuming REST APIs and integrating with third\-party platforms/SaaS tools. * Comfort working across the full stack — from UI to backend services to data layer — rather than specializing in one layer only. * Strong testing discipline and code quality habits (unit/integration testing, code review, documentation). * Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, remote startup environment and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners. * Experience using AI\-powered development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows. **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, with familiarity with HIPAA and PHI handling. * Hands\-on experience with healthcare platforms such as Healthie, Spruce, Candid, athenahealth, or similar EMR/RCM systems. * Healthcare data experience — working with clinical, claims, or operational data in a warehouse/BI environment (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, Sigma). * Familiarity with healthcare data standards and interoperability (FHIR, HL7, X12/837\-835\). * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker), and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions). * Prior experience at an early\-stage startup, comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities. **Compensation** $140,000\-$155,000\. While the anticipated range is within this band, flexibility may be limited based on the candidate's experience and overall fit.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: IT Support Technician Cascade IT Services, Bend, Oregon. Full time, based in Bend or Central Oregon. About us Cascade IT Services is a managed service provider in Bend, Oregon. We look after the computers, email, networks and security for small businesses across Central Oregon, from dental offices and accounting firms to nonprofits. Our customers are business owners, not IT people, and they count on us to explain things plainly and fix them properly. We are a small, growing team. The role You will be the first person our customers reach when something breaks. You will work the support queue every day alongside our engineer, visit customer offices around Central Oregon when a problem needs hands on help, fix what you can yourself, and hand off cleanly when something needs him. You report to the owner. What you will do \- Answer new support tickets and phone calls, and keep every open ticket moving until it is resolved and the customer has confirmed it. \- Connect remotely to customer computers through NinjaOne and fix problems end to end, including command prompt, PowerShell and screenshots for the record. \- Set up new computers and users: install our security and management tools, join them to Microsoft 365, and apply the standard settings. \- Manage Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace accounts, including new staff, departures, licenses, passwords and multi factor sign in. \- Respond to security alerts from Huntress, such as unusual sign ins or disabled antivirus, following our playbook and escalating quickly when it matters. \- Handle compromised accounts and devices: lock the account, revoke sessions, reset passwords and multi factor sign in, check for malicious mailbox rules, and clean up a computer after it has been isolated. \- Troubleshoot printers and scanners, including network printers, shared printers and drivers. \- Diagnose network problems at the desk: wifi, switch ports and PoE, IP addressing, mapped drives and network storage, and whether a problem is the internet provider, the office network or the computer. \- Fix email delivery problems such as bounces and sending limits, and understand how SPF, DKIM and DMARC affect them. \- Support OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams, including file sync, sharing permissions and call quality. \- Restore lost email and files from Microsoft 365 backups. \- Keep computers patched and healthy, and diagnose hardware problems on Windows laptops, Surfaces and Macs. \- Work with outside vendors (internet providers, phone providers, software vendors) and know where our responsibility ends and theirs begins. \- Run the recurring checks: device health, license counts against what customers pay for, and email security reports. \- Write it down. Every ticket gets clear public notes, and anything you solve twice becomes a knowledge base article. What good looks like here \- Customers never have to chase us. If you are waiting on them, you tell them; if they are waiting on you, they hear from you the same day. \- Every ticket gets an update before the end of the day, even if the update is "still working on it." \- A ticket closes because the customer confirmed it works, not because it went quiet. \- Remote sessions never end partway through a fix without telling the customer what is done and what comes next. \- Findings go in the ticket where the customer and the team can see them, not in a private note or a chat message. \- Time is logged accurately on every ticket, because for many of our customers it is what we bill. \- You are reachable in the team chat during Pacific business hours. \- When you are stuck for more than about 30 minutes, you ask. What we are looking for \- At least 2 years of help desk or support work. MSP experience, or supporting several client companies, is preferred. \- Strong Windows 10 and 11 troubleshooting, including performance, hardware and printing problems. \- Solid macOS support experience, including setup, troubleshooting, and Microsoft 365 on a Mac. \- Hands on Microsoft 365 administration: Exchange Online, Entra ID, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams, plus licensing. \- Hands on Google Workspace administration: users, groups, email, Drive sharing and security settings. \- Device management experience: enrolling and managing Windows, Mac and mobile devices through Intune or a similar tool, including Autopilot, compliance policies and app deployment. \- Working knowledge of networking: IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, wifi, switches and firewalls. \- Experience responding to security incidents such as compromised accounts and malware, not only reading alerts. \- Experience with a remote management tool such as NinjaOne, Datto or ConnectWise. \- Clear, friendly written and spoken English. Much of this job is explaining things to people who are not technical. Nice to have: scripting in PowerShell or Bash to automate routine fixes and checks, Huntress or another security tool, Bitdefender, Active Directory and Windows Server, UniFi or Cisco networking, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), Microsoft 365 backup tools, HIPAA experience with healthcare or dental offices, phones and tablets, and any CompTIA, Microsoft or Cisco certification. Schedule and benefits \- Full time, Monday to Friday, about 8:00 to 17:00 Pacific. \- Company laptop provided. \- Two month evaluation period for both sides, with a pay review at the end. \- We pay for certification exams, and we use AI tools such as Claude every day to work faster. How to apply Apply here with your resume and a short note describing one support problem you solved that you are proud of, and how you explained the fix to the customer. Shortlisted applicants do a practical test of about 60 to 90 minutes with our engineer: a live remote session on a staged problem, a compromised account scenario, and a written reply to a customer. Pay: From $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: 10Beauty is a robotics startup based in Burlington, MA on a mission to forever change the beauty and wellness space. We have raised $70M from some of the leading venture and celebrity investors in the country to build the world's first fully autonomous 5\-step manicure machine. We have pre\-sold our first 1,000 machines to some of the most iconic brands in America, including Ulta Beauty, Nordstrom, Equinox and Marriott. As of November 2025, we launched our first robot at Ulta Beauty in Everett, MA and are continuing to scale across said brand locations above. We are a fast growing 60\+ person organization with deep robotics experience. Come join the company who will put 'beauty robotics' on the map! **Introduction:** 10Beauty is seeking a talented and passionate Senior Full\-Stack Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you will be instrumental in building and maintaining cloud\-based applications that power our robots. You will be responsible for developing solutions that enable seamless control, real\-time monitoring, and insightful data reporting from our robotic fleet. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of robotics and cloud technologies, contributing directly to the intelligence and autonomy of our advanced robots! **What you'll do:** * Design, develop, and deploy scalable and reliable full\-stack cloud applications using a variety of technologies + Build user\-friendly web interfaces and APIs for controlling robot behavior, configuring tasks, and managing deployments + Develop robust backend systems for processing and storing real\-time telemetry data, sensor readings, and operational logs from robots + Implement data visualization tools and dashboards to provide insightful reporting and analytics on robot performance and operational efficiency + Collaborate closely with embedded engineers, AI/ML specialists, and business owners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions + Design and implement secure and efficient data communication protocols between robots and the cloud + Contribute to the development and maintenance of our cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) + Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to ensure high availability and reliability + Contribute to the architectural design and technical roadmap of our cloud platform + Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards + Document technical designs, APIs, and deployment processes **What you have:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field or relevant work experience + Proven experience (5\+ years) as a Full Stack Engineer + Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js, Go, or C\+\+ + Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices + Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their core services (e.g., EC2, ECS/Kubernetes, S3, RDS, serverless functions) + Experience with database technologies, both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) + Strong understanding of software development best practices, including testing, version control (Git), and agile methodologies **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working with robotic systems or IoT devices + Knowledge of communication protocols relevant to robotics (e.g., gRPC, MQTT) + Experience with data streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar) + Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3\.js, Chart.js) + Familiarity with security best practices for cloud applications *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status*. ### **Thank you for considering 10Beauty!**

jobs.title: Proposal Specialist II
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking a **Proposal Specialist II** to support our **Program Management** marketing team on pursuits, including partnering in the preparation of formal and informalresponses to client solicitations, including expressions of interest (EOI), requests for qualifications (RFQ), requests for proposals (RFP), and pre\-qualification efforts. *This will be a hybrid position including a combination of both remote and in\-office work schedules, that can be based in, but not limited to: Arlington, VA; Annapolis Junction, MD; Philadelphia, PA.* **Job Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:** * Responsible for managing responses to requests for qualifications (RFQ) and requests for proposals (RFP), across multiple disciplines within Program Management. * Leads and/or participates in proposal strategy development and planning with capture teams and helps develop and apply the win plan, themes, and discriminators throughout marketing materials. * Develop proposal outlines and schedule and manage them for compliance. * Run proposal project team/proposal review meetings and manage proposal and presentation revisions based on direction from review teams. * Proactively gather materials from project team and write, edit, and coordinate proposal content, maintaining compliance with client requirements. * Coordinate graphics, including organization charts, maps, flow charts, and matrices, with graphics team. * Coordinate with subconsultant companies to request and collect marketing materials for proposal submissions. * Proactively conduct quality assurance/quality control on proposal/marketing materials through strong grammatical skills and attention to consistency and detail. * Perform final layout in InDesign and produce hard copies if required. **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree \+ 2 years of experience collaborating within a marketing team to lead and support proposal / marketing activity within the AEC industry or a demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. * Proficient in word processing programs (e.g., Microsoft Word), spreadsheet management (Excel), and presentation software (e.g., PowerPoint), as well as desktop publishing software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite), graphics programs (e.g., InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Acrobat, Photoshop). * Developed knowledge of marketing best practices and procedures, work processes, and tools. * A working knowledge of collaborative tools such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, etc. * Ability to produce accurate, compliant, and compelling work independently and with others. * Proven organizational and administrative skills, including the ability to complete varied work tasks on schedule, and lead deliverable efforts by others; and the proven ability to manage documents. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to write and edit proposal materials * Ability to exercise discretion with confidential/ sensitive issues. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Journalism, English, Communications, Marketing or a related field. * 3\-4 years of proposal experience. * Diplomacy with peers and internal clients in handling challenging situations * Takes initiative and formulates creative ideas in proposals, presentations, and other marketing related areas * An understanding of CRM and/or Salesforce experience is a plus. * A professional demeanor and excellent interpersonal skills **Additional Information** * Relocation assistance and/or per diem is not offered for this position. * This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization now or in the future At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
