jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** -------------------- AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose. **The Job/What You'll Do:** The Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead is a pivotal, hands\-on leadership role responsible for the end\-to\-end design, governance, and operational excellence of AssetMark's data platform. This role is a strategic blend of deep technical architecture and team enablement, serving as the bridge between business needs and production\-grade data systems. The focus is on driving highly scalable solutions and pioneering the integration of AI/ML models into our data ecosystem. **We can only consider candidates for this position who are able to accommodate a hybrid work schedule and are close to our Charlotte, NC office.** **Responsibilities:** **I. Data Architecture \& Strategic Design** * **Platform Leadership:** Define, champion, and drive the technical vision for our modern data architecture on **Azure and Snowflake** . Direct experience with Snowflake, DBT, Fivetran, and Azure data lake is required. This includes making key decisions on Lakehouse patterns, data modeling methodologies (Dimensional, Data Vault), and the strategic use of services like Azure Synapse and Azure Data Factory. * **End\-to\-End Design:** Lead the architectural design and implementation of highly scalable and resilient ELT/ETL pipelines, ensuring optimal performance for mission\-critical financial workloads. * **Build vs. Buy:** Provide expert technical guidance and contribute to the evaluation and selection of new data tools and frameworks (e.g., orchestration, observability, vector databases). * **Cost Optimization:** Drive FinOps practices within the data platform, focusing on optimizing Snowflake compute usage, storage costs on Azure, and overall cost\-per\-query efficiency. **II. Engineering Excellence \& Team Leadership** * **Hands\-on Coding \& Delivery:** Serve as a **hands\-on technical leader** by writing, optimizing, and reviewing complex code primarily in **Python** and **SQL** . Directly contribute to the most challenging parts of data pipeline development. * **Standards \& Governance:** Define, document, and enforce **engineering best practices, architectural design patterns, and coding standards** across the data team. * **Code Review / PR Process Ownership:** Oversee the code review process, providing constructive, high\-quality technical feedback to ensure that all committed code is scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligns with the defined vision. * **Mentorship:** Actively mentor and coach junior and mid\-level data engineers on technical depth, debugging complex distributed systems, and modern data stack methodologies. * **CI/CD \& DevOps:** Lead the integration of data solutions into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), ensuring robust testing, deployment automation, and operational readiness. **III. Data Governance \& Reliability (DataOps)** * **Data Quality \& Observability:** Own the strategy and implementation of **Data Observability** solutions (like Monte Carlo) to proactively monitor the health, freshness, volume, and lineage of all production datasets. * **Data Lineage \& Cataloging:** Ensure comprehensive data lineage is captured and maintained to support transparency, auditing, and impact analysis across the platform. * **Security \& Compliance:** Collaborate closely with security and compliance teams to design and implement rigorous data governance policies, including PII masking, data tokenization, and **Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)** specific to financial data. * **SLA Management:** Define, monitor, and enforce data Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical data assets, and lead blameless post\-mortems following any data incident. **IV. AI/ML Enablement \& Innovation** * **AI Data Strategy:** Partner with Data Science and Product teams to architect the necessary data flows and infrastructure to support **AI/ML model training, inference, and MLOps** . * **GenAI Integration:** Provide technical leadership in piloting and implementing **Generative AI (GenAI)** techniques—leveraging LLMs via tools like **Snowflake Cortex** or open\-source frameworks—to automate engineering tasks (code generation, documentation) and enable new data products. * **Feature Engineering:** Guide the team on best practices for designing and curating versioned, high\-quality **feature sets** for production\-ready machine learning models. **Required Qualifications** * **Experience:** 10\+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering, with a significant portion dedicated to cloud data platforms. * **Technical Depth:** Expert proficiency in **Python** and **Advanced SQL** . Deep, hands\-on experience with **Snowflake** (architecture, performance tuning, Snowpark) and **Microsoft Azure** data services. * **Leadership \& Design:** Proven experience leading technical design sessions, defining target state architectures, and mentoring senior engineers. * **DataOps Fluency:** Strong experience with modern data stack tools, including **dbt (Data Build Tool)** and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Azure Data Factory). * **Domain:** Experience working with large\-scale, complex datasets, preferably within the **Financial Services or Asset Management** industry. * **Soft Skills:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical trade\-offs to non\-technical executive stakeholders. *Compensation: The Base Salary range for this position is between $162,000\-$190,000\.* *This information reflects a base salary range that AssetMark reasonably expects to pay for the position based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, education, experience, and actual work location. This position will also be eligible for additional variable incentive compensation and competitive benefits.* *Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US to be considered. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.* \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-TN1 **Who We Are \& What We Offer:** We are AssetMark, a company on the move, shaping the future of financial services. Growth is in our DNA. Every day, we combine technology, insight, and collaboration to create new possibilities for advisors, for our people and for our investors. At AssetMark your ideas matter; they’re heard, valued, and drive meaningful change. Join a team that sets new standards and creates space for you to thrive and do your best work. **Our Mission** Our mission is simple: to help our 10,500\+ financial advisors make a meaningful difference in their clients’ lives. We do this by combining powerful technology, holistic support, and expert consulting to help advisors run stronger, more efficient businesses. Backed by a comprehensive suite of investment solutions and a trust company that boasts of $150B\+ AUM, our platform empowers advisors to deliver exceptional service and an outstanding client experience. **Our Values** Heart. Client Success. Integrity. Respect. Excellence. Our values are how we show up every day. **We believe in:** * Leading with Heart, in truly making a difference in the lives of others: teammates, clients, investors and communities. * Obsessing over Client Success, bringing a relentless focus on what matters to clients that sets us apart and creates loyal, lasting relationships. * Unyielding Integrity, doing what’s right, always. Even when it’s hard. * Collective Respect, in being authentic, inclusive and valuing all voices while winning together. * Operating with Excellence, in learning fast, continuously improving, innovating and collaborating to find new and better solutions. These values shape our culture, guide our decisions, and define what it means to be part of the AssetMark family. **Our Culture \& Benefits** Our culture brings our mission and values to life. Here, we do what’s right, embrace diverse ideas, and innovate together. We also offer a wide range of benefits to support you and your family—because thriving at work starts with thriving in life. * Flex Time or Paid Time Off and Sick Time Off * 401K – 6% Employer Match * Medical, Dental, Vision – HDHP or PPO * HSA – Employer contribution (HDHP only) * Volunteer Time Off * Career Development / Recognition * Fitness Reimbursement * Hybrid Work Schedule As an Equal Opportunity Employer, AssetMark is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued.

IaC ownership: reusable modules, standardized patterns, environment consistency (25%) * Develop and maintain IaC (Terraform, Ansible, Bicep) with focus on reusable modules, standardized patterns, and consistency. * Establish code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation) to improve repeatability and reduce risk. Automation\-first engineering for efficiency and improve reliability (15%) * Build automation workflows and scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate manual operational tasks and improve reliability. Reliability ownership and operational standards (lead, don’t just participate) (15%) * Own reliability outcomes for cloud services. * Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis; implement preventative improvements. * Define and improve runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, and support models. Security, compliance, resilience, and vulnerability management as engineered guardrails (12%) * Ensure deployments meet security and compliance expectations through guardrails, patterns, and technical controls with Security/Risk. * Support audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples) with evidence support and control implementation. * Design and validate backup, recovery, and resilience patterns; ensure objectives are tested and reliable. * Lead and automate patching and vulnerability management improvements. Technical leadership: mentoring and cross\-team influence (\*8%) * Translate requirements into designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps aligned to cloud\-first. * Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. * Provide technical guidance across teams, influencing patterns and decisions to reduce delivery friction **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree required * 5\+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or related roles. * Hands\-on engineering depth in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI). * Strong IaC (Terraform preferred and/or Ansible) including module development and pattern standardization. * Strong scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or equivalent). * Experience implementing or significantly improving CI/CD practices for infrastructure delivery. Strong operational ownership: incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventative remediation. * Certifications / licenses (2 or more preferred) * AWS Solutions Architect – Professional * Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert * Google Professional Cloud Architect * Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional Knowledge * Deep knowledge of multi\-cloud design and operations, with hands\-on depth in at least two: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI. * Knowledge of building and improving foundational services and standard patterns: identity integration, networking, logging and monitoring, compute, storage, security controls. * Knowledge of operational excellence practices: runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, operational readiness, lifecycle management. Knowledge of security and compliance implementation patterns and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples). * Skills * Engineer, automate, and operate cloud services end\-to\-end; drive ambiguous work to clarity. * IaC engineering with emphasis on reusable modules, pattern standardization, and environment consistency (Terraform preferred and or Ansible). * Build automation workflows and enforce code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation). * Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements. Optimize for performance and cost\-efficiency, including enforcing tagging standards and cost allocation practices. * Abilities * Ability to own reliability outcomes and reduce operational toil through automation. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps. Ability to mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing, and influence cross\-team patterns. * Languages and tools * Scripting and automation: Python, PowerShell, Bash (or equivalent). * IaC: Terraform (preferred), Ansible, Bicep. * Containers and orchestration (preferred): container platforms and orchestration experience. * Governance and guardrails (preferred): Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, GCP org policies. Preferred * Containers and orchestration. * Cloud governance and guardrails (Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, org policies). * Centralized logging and security monitoring integrations (SIEM examples). * Regulated environments and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC). * Multi\-region patterns, shared services networking, private connectivity. The pay rate range for this job position is $74,200 to $148,230\. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

jobs.title: Manager, AI-Native Security Operations
jobs.description: *Please Note: This is a Utah\-based hybrid position which will require some regular in\-office days each week. Additionally, employment with BambooHR is contingent on passing both a background and credit check.* **AI at BambooHR:** At BambooHR, we believe in leveraging cutting\-edge technology to empower people and transform HR. We're actively integrating AI into our solutions and workflows to enhance efficiency and drive innovation. To that end, we're looking to our existing team members and future hires to share this forward\-thinking mindset: individuals who are curious about AI's potential, eager to learn and adapt, and ready to explore how intelligent tools can elevate their work along with BambooHR's impact on setting people free to do great work. Join us in reimagining the future of HR! **Essential Job Duties** BambooHR is rebuilding its Security Operations function around AI. We are not adding AI tooling to an existing SOC \- we are redesigning how the work happens, so that automation and AI agents carry the volume and our people carry the judgment. We are looking for a manager to lead that team and own that transformation. You will lead a team spanning detection engineering, threat intelligence and hunting, and incident response. Day to day, you will run a live operation: incidents, detections, hunts, on\-call coverage, service\-provider relationships, and the operational metrics that leadership works from. Running alongside that operation is the change itself — automating triage and enrichment so analysts stop working queues, building detection content we write, tune and own, and standing up threat intelligence as a program that produces detections and hunt hypotheses rather than reports that have no clear actionable insights. The reason this role exists now is that the surface a security team defends is changing shape. As HR technology becomes more AI\-driven and more agentic, autonomous software acts with real authority, machine identities multiply, and attacks accelerate. That surface grows faster than any security team can hire against, which is why we staff for judgment and build automation for volume. This role sits at the center of that decision \- and the person in it will spend a meaningful part of their time deciding, in writing, how much authority automated systems are allowed to hold. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** * Leads and grows a team of security analysts, detection engineers, and threat intelligence practitioners. * Recruits, interviews, hires, onboards and retains technical security talent in a competitive market. * Oversees the daily workflow of the team: shift coverage, on\-call rotation, incident assignment, and detection backlog priority. * Provides constructive and timely performance evaluations, and builds development plans against the skills an AI\-native SOC actually requires: detection\-as\-code, agent supervision, and intelligence tradecraft. * Supports career growth and internal mobility across the broader security organization, treating it as a retention strategy rather than a loss. * Handles discipline and termination of employees in accordance with company policy. **Duties/Responsibilities:** **Run the operation** * Own daily security operations end to end \- alert handling, shift coverage, on\-call rotation, escalation quality, and detection backlog priority and rule retirement. * Serve as incident commander for the majority of security incidents, and partner with the VP of Information Security on the most severe incidents and on executive communication. * Manage security service\-provider relationships, including service reviews, escalation quality, and tuning direction. * Publish a regular operational metrics pack that the team and executive leadership both work from. **Automate the volume, not the analyst** * Build and enforce an automated incident runbook program covering the incident types behind the majority of alert volume. * Drive the automation of Tier\-1 triage and a growing share of Tier\-2 workflows, so routine work resolves without a human touching it and escalations arrive as an assembled case with clear timeline, scope, and blast radius, rather than a raw alert. * Redirect reclaimed capacity upward rather than out of the team \- into deeper investigation, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. **Own the detections** * Run detection engineering as a product: a prioritized backlog including rules in version control with CI validation, and a full lifecycle of write, test, deploy, measure and retire. * Build in\-house detection capability against our own security telemetry, so detection content is something we write, tune and can explain to an engineer, an auditor or a customer. **Build threat intelligence and hunting into programs** * Stand up a formal threat intelligence program: approved intelligence requirements, a collection plan mapped to real sources, and a threat model grounded in the risks that actually apply to employee and payroll hours when incident severity requires it. **What Will Make Us REALLY Love You** * Experience securing AI or agentic systems \- prompt injection, tool abuse, and third\-party or autonomous code holding execution authority. * Prior experience standing up a threat intelligence program from zero: intelligence requirements, collection planning, intel\-to\-detection pipeline, and adversary emulation. * Experience transitioning detection capability in\-house from a managed provider. * Experience with non\-human identity at scale \- service accounts, workload identity, machine credentials \- and its detection implications. * Background in HR, payroll, or fintech SaaS, or other environments where employee data and payment fraud are primary adversary objectives. * Experience with cyber resilience practice: backup immutability verification, recovery drills, and recovery\-time objectives measured against contractual commitments. * Experience building or supervising LLM agents in production, including evaluation, guardrail design, and human\-in\-the\-loop review patterns. * Public contribution to the detection engineering or threat intelligence community \- detection rules, open\-source tooling, conference talks, or published research. * Security certifications (GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GDAT, GCTI, OSCP, CISSP) preferred, not required. **What You'll Love About Us** * A Great Company Culture that has been recognized by multiple organizations like Inc, and Salt Lake Tribune * Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance * Generous leave policies that include 4 weeks of vacation, 12 company holidays, parental leave, and volunteer time off so you can enjoy quality of life * 401k plans with up to 6% company match * $2000 Paid\-Paid Vacation bonus * EAP through Headspace * Check out all our benefits that benefit you **About Us** At BambooHR, we're building something different: we're building a people intelligence platform that transforms HR and sets people free to do great work! We're a proven market leader driving innovation while building lasting success through thoughtful, sustainable growth. Here, you'll find a place that champions growth: both professional and personal, both individual and collective. We invest in potential, giving you the space to stretch your capabilities and turn good ideas into reality while providing the safety net of a supportive, values\-driven culture. Our approach combines meaningful work with meaningful lives, offering competitive benefits, professional development, and the flexibility to thrive both in and outside the office. What sets us apart isn't just what we do, but how we do it: with openness, integrity, and a shared commitment to doing the right thing. Join us in creating HR software that makes work better for everyone, while we make work better for you. ***BambooHR is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals and will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you would like to request accommodations, please let your recruiter know.*** ***BambooHR is An Equal Opportunity Employer\-M/F/D/V*** ***Because our team members are trusted to handle sensitive information, we require all candidates that receive and accept employment offers to complete a background check before being hired.*** ***For information on California Privacy Policy,*** ***click here******.*** ***Our process utilizes AI as an assistant to efficiently process and analyze candidate data. Recruiters and hiring managers maintain full oversight and accountability, ensuring that all final selection and rejection decisions are human\-made and based solely on objective job qualifications. Please see our*** ***General Privacy Notice*** ***and*** ***California Privacy Notice*** ***for more details.*** ***See our*** ***AI Guidelines for Candidates*** ***for details on how BambooHR uses AI in recruiting, how we expect candidates to use AI, and what is not allowed.***

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer I
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY:** The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer I will be part of a team that manages the provisioning, monitoring, recovery, and updating of cloud infrastructure (inclusive of the automation of these functions). The individual in this position must be someone whom is a fast learner, a self\-starter, loves to solve problems, and keen to automate operational processes. The individual should have the desire to continually improve the Bank's cloud infrastructure design and provide a secure and highly available computing platform. In addition, the Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will configure and maintain existing infrastructure components, implement upgrades, and utilize management tools to monitor \& report on the reliability of the environment. The role will also be responsible for finding opportunities to improve the Bank's architecture using cloud and cloud\-native technologies. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Problem Management: Performs Participates in post\-Incident reviews of all Major Incidents and assist toward determining Action Items required to avoid similar issues/minimize downtime for future Incidents * Provide reliable, predictable deployment and maintenance of distributed systems adhering to security best practices * Assist in the day\-to\-day operations of managing the Bank's Cloud Infrastructure Services including software deployment and upgrades, system setup, system administration, monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, configuration and change management, capacity planning, availability management, disaster recovery and routine update of services * Ensure support for culture of continuous improvement, including identifying areas for potential improved automation and feeding back to relevant teams * Supports multiple systems or applications of medium to highly complex (complexity defined by size, technology used, and system feeds and interfaces) with multiple concurrent users, ensuring control, integrity, and accessibility * Produce and maintain documentation to support solutions that have been developed/deployed to aid in the support of the solution * Design and maintain production monitoring tools, troubleshoot performance and stability issues * Create and maintain automated monitoring and reporting of cloud infrastructure health, performance and cost control * Monitor cloud infrastructure to identify areas of improvement, reliability, cost savings, etc. * Develop/change SOP/Knowledge Article review for any new Feature launch or other significant change that may impact support documentation * Configuration management, review, and governance of Cloud resources, identity and access management (IAM), etc. * Actively troubleshooting any issues that arise during testing and production, catching and solving issues before launch * Participation in disaster recovery planning and testing * Back\-up and recovery of cloud\-hosted systems * Troubleshooting and providing technical support service * Provides Level 2 production support * Participate in routine on\-call rotations * Ensuring and facilitating knowledge sharing within the department * Maintain current knowledge of cloud trends \& developments * Contribute to the development of cloud standards, best practices and organizational cloud capability * Research and drive or equivalent management/work experience (At least 2 years), which includes practical experience in Information Technology and IT Security Experience with cloud\-based enterprise infrastructure years experience * \- Experience in designing applications (eg web, client/server, COM\+, etc) * Understanding of the five pillars of a well\-architected frameworks * Ability to interface with cloud services and tools from an infrastructure as code perspective * Awareness of networking and internet protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, HTTP and distributed networks * Awareness of information Backups, and Disaster Recovery * Work within the construct of a platform product team, to understand the technical requirements of our product teams to deliver creative solutions which meet or exceed those needs * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills * Excellent communication and organizational skills, and the ability to stay focused on completing tasks and meeting goals within a busy workspace * Strong communication and collaboration skills * Ability to work independently * Self\-motivated * Ability to set own goals and manage towards them * Ability to effectively mentor team **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** **Additional Information** * Candidates residing in locations within BankUnited's footprint may be given preference.

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About Base** -------------- Base is America’s next\-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. **About the Role** ------------------ Base is seeking a Test Engineer to facilitate the deployment, sustaining, and improvement of automated manufacturing test systems developed in\-house for the production of battery backup systems. As a member of our team, you will ensure the products developed by the team meet world\-class expectations and ensure success of the overall project. You must have a genuine passion for engineering and thrive working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment. **What You’ll Do** * Lead uptime (HW reliability, software faults, maintenance schedules, etc.), cycle time and FPY improvements on manufacturing test equipment. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure the manufacturing test equipment meets and exceeds expectations. Understand shortcomings when expectations are not met. * Perform preemptive data analysis and voice of the customer (VOC) discussions to understand challenges with manufacturing test equipment post deployment, and advocate for solutions that align with both equipment and production goals. * Understand engineering first principles of test equipment and have a system level grasp of operations to serve as a key contact for the design team and site operations. * Build and validate test equipment, then deploy to production lines at contract. manufacturers and internally, while verifying tester documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to production. * Provide ongoing troubleshooting support for these testers after deployment. * Support equipment troubleshooting and qualification during development and ramp\-up of manufacturing equipment. **What You’ll Bring** * 5\+ years of experience in electrical test systems design. * Exposure to a wide variety of test and automation systems, production machinery, industrial sensors, data acquisition, safety, and I/O devices (i.e., pogo\-pins, pressure transducers, temperature controllers, current and power meters, PLCs, etc.) * Hands\-on experience designing and building end\-of\-line and functional test systems * Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems. * Understanding of grid simulators, RLC power manipulation, inverter operations, and power system controls. * Ability to read and understand software code (e.g., TestStand, LabVIEW, Python, Golang, C, C\+\+). * Experience with CAN bus communications and ability to interpret traces. * Basic proficiency in PLC programming and troubleshooting (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Siemens). * Effective at summarizing/presenting data in a manner that is easily digestible to various technical and non\-technical audiences. * Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. **About this Team** Makers of the machines that power tomorrow. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns the interface between a proof of concept and a scalable, profitable product. Our team focuses on how a product can be built, defining the process technology and equipment solutions along the way. We are the feedback loop with the product design team to ensure designs are manufacturable both at cost and scale. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns every aspect of bringing the physical mechanisms of manufacturing a product into the factory. *Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.* **Our Values** -------------- * **First Principles Thinking:** Question assumptions. Principles \> rules. * **Operate at Base Pace:** Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. * **Give \& Get Feedback:** Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. * **Everyone’s an Owner:** Follow through on commitments and own results. * **Strong Opinions, Loosely Held:** Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. * **Committed to the Mission:** Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in\-person. It’s not a 9\-to\-5\. We are all\-in. * **Fun \& Optimism Coexist with Grit:** Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. **Do the best work of your life at Base.** ------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Geotechnical Engineer, Senior - Springer Mine/Mineral Processing Plant
jobs.description: **Geotechnical Engineer, Senior** **Location:** Site\-Based at the Springer Site, Imlay, Nevada **About the Springer Site** The Springer site is an underground mining operation located near Imlay, Nevada. As activities at the site continue to advance, geotechnical analysis and monitoring are essential to supporting safe design, construction, and site operations. **About the Role** The Senior Geotechnical Engineer provides technical expertise related to ground conditions, slope stability, excavation support, foundations, earthworks, and geotechnical risk at the Springer site. This role collects and interprets geotechnical information, monitors field conditions, and develops practical recommendations to support safe project execution and operations. Working closely with Engineering, Projects, Construction, Operations, Health and Safety, contractors, and consultants, the Geotechnical Engineer helps identify ground\-related risks and ensures geotechnical requirements are incorporated into project planning and field activities. **Key Responsibilities** **Geotechnical Analysis** * Analyze soil, rock, groundwater, and other geotechnical data to support engineering design and site activities. * Evaluate ground conditions, slope stability, excavation requirements, foundations, and earthworks. * Develop practical geotechnical recommendations, design criteria, and risk\-control measures. **Field Investigation \& Monitoring** * Plan and support geotechnical investigations, drilling programs, sampling, mapping, testing, and instrumentation activities. * Inspect excavations, slopes, foundations, and other work areas to confirm actual ground conditions. * Monitor geotechnical instrumentation and field performance and identify conditions requiring further assessment or action. **Engineering \& Construction Support** * Review drawings, specifications, work plans, and contractor submissions for geotechnical considerations. * Provide field support during excavation, earthworks, foundation construction, and other ground\-related activities. * Respond to technical questions and recommend solutions when actual site conditions differ from design assumptions. **Risk \& Safety Management** * Identify, assess, document, and communicate geotechnical hazards and risks. * Support the development of monitoring plans, trigger\-action\-response plans, and ground\-control procedures. * Participate in risk assessments, design reviews, incident investigations, and safety initiatives involving geotechnical conditions. **Technical Documentation** * Prepare technical reports, calculations, inspection records, monitoring summaries, and geotechnical recommendations. * Maintain accurate records of investigations, test results, field observations, instrumentation data, and design decisions. * Coordinate geotechnical information with engineering drawings, project records, and as\-built documentation. **Stakeholder \& Consultant Coordination** * Coordinate geotechnical activities with Engineering, Construction, Operations, Projects, contractors, laboratories, and specialist consultants. * Review consultant deliverables and monitor field services for alignment with approved scopes and technical requirements. * Communicate geotechnical findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Qualifications \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Geological Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline. * Professional Engineer licensure in Nevada, or eligibility to obtain it, is preferred. * Minimum of 8 years of geotechnical engineering experience in mining, civil construction, heavy industry, or a related environment. * Experience with field investigations, geotechnical logging, slope\-stability assessments, foundations, or earthworks. * Experience interpreting geotechnical data and preparing technical recommendations and reports. * Familiarity with geotechnical instrumentation, monitoring methods, and risk\-management practices. * Valid driver's license and ability to meet all site\-access requirements. **Skills \& Competencies** * Strong knowledge of soil and rock mechanics, geotechnical investigations, and engineering design principles. * Ability to analyze technical data and translate findings into practical field recommendations. * Ability to interpret geological information, drawings, specifications, and construction documentation. * Strong technical writing, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Proficiency with relevant geotechnical analysis, modelling, data\-management, and Microsoft Office applications. * Ability to manage consultants, field programs, priorities, and technical deliverables. **Personal Attributes** * Safety\-focused and attentive to changing field conditions. * Analytical, practical, and detail\-oriented. * Comfortable making evidence\-based technical recommendations. * Collaborative and able to communicate across engineering, construction, and operational teams. * Proactive in identifying and escalating geotechnical risks. * Comfortable working in active field and industrial environments. **Working Conditions** * This is a primarily site\-based role at the Springer site in Imlay, Nevada. * Work involves a combination of office analysis and regular field inspections. * May require extended or rotational schedules based on project and operational needs. * Requires walking over uneven terrain and accessing active construction or operational areas. * The position may involve exposure to outdoor conditions, dust, noise, heavy equipment, elevations, and varying weather conditions. **Why Join** * Take on a key technical role where your recommendations will directly influence safe design, construction, and site operations. * Work on varied geotechnical challenges involving field investigations, earthworks, foundations, slope stability, and risk management. * Collaborate closely with Engineering, Construction, Projects, Operations, and specialist consultants. * Help shape geotechnical standards, monitoring practices, and risk\-management processes as the Springer site advances. * Receive competitive compensation and benefits while contributing to a safety\-focused and collaborative team. **We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.** This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Blue Moon Metals Inc. and its business entities do not currently utilize AI to screen, assess, or select applicants. **Pay range and compensation package** Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. **Equal Opportunity Statement** We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

observations, water levels, and facility performance to identify trends or conditions requiring action. * Conduct regular inspections and document findings, recommendations, and required follow\-up activities. **Risk, Safety \& Compliance** * Identify, assess, and communicate technical risks associated with tailings and water\-management infrastructure. * Support risk assessments, design reviews, emergency\-preparedness activities, and change\-management processes. * Help ensure tailings activities comply with applicable MSHA requirements, permits, regulatory requirements, approved plans, and company standards. **Technical Documentation** * Prepare and maintain technical reports, inspection records, monitoring summaries, drawings, calculations, and engineering recommendations. * deficiencies, and corrective measures through completion. **Stakeholder \& Consultant Coordination** * Coordinate technical activities with the Engineer of Record, specialist consultants, contractors, laboratories, and internal site teams. * Communicate tailings performance, risks, technical requirements, and required decisions to project and site leadership. * Support continuous improvement in tailings governance, monitoring, construction practices, documentation, and operational controls. **Qualifications \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or a related discipline. * Master's degree in Geotechnical Engineering, Tailings Engineering, or a related discipline is considered an asset. * Professional Engineer licensure in Nevada, or eligibility to obtain it, is preferred. * Minimum of 10 years of progressive engineering experience in a mining environment, including at least 5 years dedicated to Tailings Storage Facility design, construction, or operations. * Experience with both conventional and dry\-stack Tailings Storage Facilities is preferred. * Experience interpreting geotechnical data, instrumentation results, engineering drawings, specifications, and technical reports. * Familiarity with tailings risk management, construction quality assurance, water management, and facility surveillance. * Experience coordinating specialist consultants, contractors, laboratories, and multidisciplinary teams. * Ability to complete and maintain all required MSHA training and site\-specific certifications. **Skills \& Competencies** * Strong knowledge of tailings engineering, geotechnical principles, dam safety, and water\-management practices. * Ability to analyze technical data and translate findings into practical engineering recommendations. * Ability to review technical designs, drawings, specifications, construction records, and monitoring information. * Strong technical writing, documentation, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to identify technical risks and escalate concerns appropriately. * Proficiency with relevant engineering, geotechnical, and tailings modelling software, such as GeoStudio (SLOPE/W and SEEP/W), PLAXIS, FLAC, Rocscience applications, or equivalent tools. * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage consultants, field activities, and technical deliverables. **Personal Attributes** * Safety\-focused and committed to responsible tailings management. * Analytical, practical, and attentive to detail. * Proactive in identifying technical risks and required actions. * Collaborative and able to work effectively with technical, operational, environmental, and construction teams. * Comfortable exercising professional judgment and raising concerns when required. * Accountable and committed to maintaining accurate, high\-quality technical records. **Working Conditions** * This is a primarily site\-based role at the Springer site in Imlay, Nevada. * Work involves a combination of office\-based engineering and regular field inspections. * Requires access to active construction, tailings, water\-management, and operational areas. * The position may involve exposure to outdoor conditions, uneven terrain, dust, noise, heavy equipment, and varying weather conditions. * Required personal protective equipment must be worn in designated areas. **Why Join** * Bring your technical expertise into the field and see your recommendations contribute to real progress at the Springer site. * jobs.title: Fire Inspector
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Under the direction of the Fire Marshal, the Fire Inspector performs entry\-level fire prevention work, including inspections, code compliance activities, public education, records maintenance, and support for fire investigations. The position may respond to emergency incidents when requested by command staff to assist with fire, medical, environmental, or other life\-safety concerns. **Essential Functions** The following duties are normal for this position. These are not to be construed as exclusive or all\-inclusive. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be required and assigned. **Fire Inspections and Code Compliance** * Inspects residential, licensed care, commercial, industrial, multi\-story, new, and existing buildings, facilities, and properties to determine compliance with applicable fire and life safety codes. * Identifies, documents, and tracks code violations through site visits, written notices, certified mail, citations, and legal action when required. * Reviews construction, occupancy, fire protection, exposure, alarm, suppression, detection, and extinguisher systems for operational readiness and code compliance. * Interprets local, state, and national fire and life safety codes for the public, contractors, architects, engineers, business owners, vendors, law enforcement, and other agencies. * Determines whether business emergency plans are required and reviews, evaluates, and processes those plans. * Research codes, investigates fire and life safety complaints, and takes appropriate enforcement or corrective action. * Develops, coordinates, and maintains hazardous materials information for facilities within the Fire District’s jurisdiction. * Works with governmental agencies to support compliance and enforcement of fire codes, standards, hazardous materials requirements, and related regulations. * Participates in public information, education, and community risk reduction activities, including talks, demonstrations, training programs, station tours, school programs, civic events, and Fire District functions. * Assist the Senior Inspector/CRR Educators with presentations for community groups, schools, organizations, and institutions. * Attends special events to support public fire safety. * Conducts public education programs on topics such as fire extinguisher use, helmet and seatbelt safety, senior and child home safety, and general health and wellness issues. * Responds to emergency and non\-emergency incidents when requested by command staff and within the scope of assigned duties, certifications, and training. * Provides support at incidents involving fire, motor vehicle accidents, explosions, hazardous materials, medical emergencies, technical rescue, public assistance, and other life\-safety concerns. * Conducts site visits to commercial facilities, hazardous structures, buildings, and assigned areas to maintain familiarity, identify safety concerns, and assist with pre\-fire planning updates. * Cleans, maintains, tests, and inspects Fire District equipment and personal protective equipment; informs the appropriate officer of maintenance needs or equipment problems. * Performs data entry, incident reports, inspection reports, and related documentation as assigned. * Maintains files, inspection reports, violation documentation, and related records in accordance with Fire District policies. * Attend meetings, conferences, workshops, training sessions, and continuing education activities to maintain required certifications and professional development. * Meets scheduling and attendance requirements. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Knowledge of Fire District rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and standard operating procedures. * Knowledge of city and county ordinances, National Fire Protection Association standards, fire prevention codes, South Carolina Occupational Safety and Health Administration regulations, and other applicable federal, state, and local requirements. * Knowledge of hazardous materials, hazardous substance references, bloodborne pathogens, emergency medical methods, and health and safety practices consistent with certifications and licenses held. * Ability to perform detailed work accurately, independently, and within established deadlines with minimal supervision. * Ability to prioritize assignments, adapt to changing priorities, and manage a high volume of work. * Skill in operating ladders, two\-way radios, cameras, atmospheric and chemical sampling equipment, firefighting tools, and standard office equipment. * Ability to use Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Visio, and PowerPoint, as well as Fire District databases and reporting software. * Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, maintain accurate records, and support code compliance documentation. * Ability to conduct oneself professionally and engage respectfully with the public, coworkers, supervisors, partner agencies, and elected officials. * Ability to work the allocated hours of the position. **Reasoning Ability** * Ability to understand and carry out verbal and written instructions, including lawful orders from superior officers. * Ability to interpret and apply local policies, procedures, written instructions, general correspondence, and federal, state, and local regulations. * Ability to identify problems, analyze facts, exercise sound judgment, and recommend appropriate conclusions or corrective actions. * Ability to think quickly, maintain self\-control, and adapt to stressful or changing situations. * Ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion regarding business\-related files, reports, conversations, and information subject to applicable open records laws. * Ability to organize work, manage time effectively, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate and concise records and reports. **Required Education, Experience, Licensing, and Certifications/Coursework** * High school diploma or GED. * Associate degree in fire science or related field preferred. * Valid driver’s license. * Minimum of four years of experience as a Firefighter/EMT. * IFSAC/ProBoard Firefighter II. * Must obtain within one (1\) year of hire: + ICC Fire Inspector I Certification + South Carolina Fire Marshal Rules and Regulations + NIMS\-ICS for the Fire Service or equivalent training. + Basic Fire Investigation through NFA, SCFA, or equivalent training + Fire and Life Safety Educator I **Physical and Work Environment** The physical and work environment characteristics described in this description are representative of those encountered while performing the functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions or as otherwise required by law. * Position requires extensive walking, bending, crawling in various types of buildings, and fire damaged structures. * This work requires occasional exertion of up to 75\-100 pounds of force; work regularly requires sitting, frequently requires standing, speaking or hearing, using hands to finger, handle or feel and repetitive motions and requires walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching or crawling and reaching with hands and arms. * Enter buildings under post\-fire conditions which might include smoke, residual heat, and limited visibility, in designated personal protective clothing including appropriate respiratory protection. * Work in high places, open and/or confined spaces. * Use a variety of tools to remove walls and ceilings, requiring pulling and pushing motions with arms extending overhead for long periods of time, or to force entry into a building. * Operate district vehicles during the day and at night, using depth perception and peripheral vision in emergency situations, in congested traffic and in unsafe road conditions caused by factors such as fog, smoke, rain, ice and snow. * Moves material such as burnt building debris from one place to another using a shovel, rake or rubbish hook to rescue trapped or endangered persons, or to overhaul a burned\-out structure. * Work requires close vision, distance vision, ability to adjust focus, depth perception, color perception, night vision and peripheral vision. * Work may require wearing specialized personal protective equipment. * May be subject to recall during natural or man\-made disasters, requiring extended work periods of 24\-hour shifts or longer. **Disclaimer** This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Management reserves the right to assign or modify duties as needed. This document does not constitute an employment agreement and may be revised at any time.

jobs.title: AI DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** As an AI DevOps Engineer you'll design, build, connect, and operate AI tools and automated workflows that help Booz Allen teams deliver secure, reliable results. You'll be a hands\-on technical contributor helping teams use approved AI models, automate work, and connect AI tools to enterprise systems. You'll work with engineers, product owners, cybersecurity practitioners, and platform teams to turn business and operational needs into practical solutions. You'll help make sure those solutions are secure, reliable, easy to use, and easy to support. **What You'll Work On:** * Design, configure, test, deploy, and support AI tools and automated workflows. * Set up and operate the AI Gateway, which provides controlled access to approved AI models including access permissions, model selection, API connections, usage tracking, and audit records. * Lead the secure, maintainable connection of AI tools, APIs, enterprise applications, and workflow platforms. * Develop and maintain automation scripts, workflows, technical documentation, runbooks, and implementation guidance. * Plan and carry out testing, troubleshooting, and release activities for AI tools and automations. * Partner with cybersecurity and platform teams to protect data and implement secure sign\-in, permissions, access controls, and monitoring. * Support cyber operations, including work with 5\.5 and Mythos. * Review tool performance, usage, user feedback, and recurring issues to identify improvements. * Improve prompts, workflows, and AI assistant configurations to increase accuracy, reliability, and ease of use. * Provide technical input in design discussions, code reviews, backlog refinement, and sprint planning. Coach junior team members and clearly communicate technical decisions, risks, and recommendations. * Join us. The world can't wait. **You Have:** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, systems integration, platform engineering, automation, cybersecurity operations, or a technical field * Experience delivering business or enterprise software, automation, integration, platform, or application solutions * Experience implementing or supporting AI tools, automation platforms, AI gateways, workflow technologies, or enterprise applications * Experience with cloud platforms, DevSecOps practices, identity and access management, logging, and monitoring tools * Experience building secure system integrations, including sign\-in, permissions, access controls, logging, and audit records and integrating systems through APIs, webhooks, or service\-based architectures * Experience with cloud platforms, automated software delivery such as CI/CD, identity and access management, or monitoring tools * Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues, documenting solutions, and driving work to resolution * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across engineering, cybersecurity, product, and operational teams * Public Trust Bachelor's degree * **Nice If You Have:** * Experience with AI Gateway capabilities, including model selection, usage monitoring, or governance * Experience with AI assistant workflows, prompt improvement, model evaluation, or orchestration tools * Experience with containers, Kubernetes, automated infrastructure setup, or cloud AI services * Experience creating operational dashboards, technical roadmaps, user enablement materials, or adoption metrics Experience leading technical workstreams or mentoring engineers in an agile delivery environment * **Vetting:** Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client; Public Trust determination is required. **Compensation** At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page. Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600\.00 to $176,000\.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. **Identity Statement** As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on **your** own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly provided** . **Work Model** Our people\-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings. * **Remote** : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility. * **Hybrid** : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role. * **Onsite** : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full\-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role. **Commitment to Non\-Discrimination** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

jobs.title: Design Engineer

Bosch Rexroth is dedicated to making the world a better place through innovation and technology. We are looking for associates who will take on our customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found and who will thrive in a face\-paced, collaborative and exciting environment. This covers everything, from community to the environment, to being a social employer. * **Flexibility \& Freedom:** We strive to give you a balance between your work and home life, as well as the freedom to drive your career forward. * **International Opportunities:** We are a truly global, fully networked company, with locations in more than 80 countries all over the world. **Job Description** **Major Duties** * Create innovative designs in a fast\-paced environment focused on serving customers in growing, high technology industries. * Electromechanical design of customer specific sub\-assemblies, systems, product enhancements and new catalog products. * Lead and manage cross\-functional New Product Development projects for electromechanical subassemblies, systems and product enhancements for Bosch Rexroth Mechatronics Products. * Create new designs from concept to prototype to serial production utilizing CREO 3D CAD software. * Design, specify, procure and build Engineering test fixtures. Perform and manage performance and reliability testing, collecting and analyzing data. * Create and manage Bills of Material and execute Engineering Changes as necessary. * Work cross\-functionally with internal departments including Manufacturing, Sales, Product Management, Purchasing, Quality and Logistics to execute project through to completion. * Interact with external customers to establish specifications, collaborate to create designs and verify customer driven performance objectives. **Qualifications** * Experience developing new products for mature, competitive, industrial markets * Up to 5 years of experience designing electromechanical products for low to medium volume serial production * Experience using 3D CAD to create mechanical designs – CREO/PDM preferred, Engineering (BSME, BSET, or equivalent). + Or Associates Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 10\+ years of experience. * Experience with Tolerance analysis and GD\&T. * Experience with engineering calculations including force, kinematics and dynamic loading of mechanical components and systems. * Experience designing components to be manufactured by a variety of processes including CNC machining, sand and die casting, sheet metal and plastics. * Good communication skills, able to work across a broad spectrum of internal and external stakeholders – Customers, Distributors, Sales, Engineering and Operations * Preferred: Experience designing, specifying and/or implementing Linear Motion technologies, including Ball Screws, Linear Bearings, Linear Motors, Linear motion modules, and electromechanical drive systems. * Desired: Some experience with or knowledge of Servo Drives and PLC programming. * Desired: Some experience with Finite Element analysis for stress, deflection and heat transfer applications. **Additional Information** **Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization is not available.** Your well\-being matters at Bosch! We offer a competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This position will have a salary range of $115,000 \- $135,000 annually. In addition to the base rate, the position will have an annual bonus potential of 0% \- 6% of annual salary based company performance. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. We're investing in your success! Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: https://www.myboschbenefits.com/public/welcome Salary estimates published on online job boards, rather than the Bosch US Careers Page, may not be a true representation of the actual pay range offered for this position. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

jobs.description: **Additional Location(s):** N/A **Diversity \- Innovation \- Caring \- Global Collaboration \- Winning Spirit \- High Performance** At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high\-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions. **About the role:** Boston Scientific was recognized by Forbes as one of the Best Workplaces for Engineers in 2026, reflecting a culture where engineers do meaningful work. The OPAL Mapping System is a 3D mapping and navigation system designed to support cardiac electrophysiology procedures. It provides real\-time visualization of intracardiac catheters and displays 3D cardiac maps in selected formats during minimally invasive procedures to assist physicians in identifying the origin of arrhythmias within the heart chamber. As a physician probes the heart with a catheter, the system generates an accurate anatomical model of the chamber. jobs.description: **Job Description** Boyd Thermal by Eaton is currently seeking a Junior Product Manager for our Billerica, MA facility. We are seeking a process\-minded Associate / Junior Product Manager with an engineering background to join our Thermal Management team. In this role, you will start with a focus on our liquid cooling portfolio, specifically Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) and complementary cooling systems and components powering high\-density data center and AI/HPC deployments. You will serve as the process engine for the product lifecycle, bringing structure, standard product management tools, and stage\-gate process discipline from initial product concept through design, launch, and end\-of\-life. You will work directly alongside senior product leadership with decades of deep domain, customer, and market expertise. Your role will be to supplement this institutional knowledge with formal product management frameworks, stage\-gate rigor, clear documentation, and cross\-functional tracking across Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Quality. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Stage\-Gate Process \& NPI Execution** * Drive New Product Introduction (NPI): Facilitate phase\-gate governance across cross\-functional teams, managing gate reviews, action items, and readiness checklists to ensure smooth transitions from concept to commercial launch. * Requirements \& Portfolio Artifacts: Assist in drafting and maintain Market Requirements Documents (MRDs), Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), product roadmaps, and business cases for new standard products and customized or configured products. * PM Toolset Standardization: Utilize and champion standard product management tools, project management tools, PLM software, workflow management tools, and financial models. **2\. Cross\-Functional Integration (Engineering, Marketing, \& Sales)** * Marketing Alignment: Partner closely with Corporate and Product Marketing teams to guide product positioning, define key value propositions, support launch campaigns, refine web/collateral content, and analyze market/competitor dynamics. * Engineering Collaboration: Act as liaison with thermal, mechanical, and electrical design engineering teams to translate customer/market requirements into technical scope. * Commercial \& Sales Enablement: Collaborate with Sales and Application Engineering to create technical selection guides, datasheets, pricing tools, and customer\-facing application notes. **3\. Market \& Business Analysis** * Portfolio Tracking: Work with finance and operations to track cost models, product margin targets, and pricing structures across CDU configurations. * Voice of Customer (VoC) Integration: Gather feedback from field engineers, sales teams, commissioning agents, and marketing intelligence to continuously feed revision requirements back into the product backlog. **Basic Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related field required (Mechanical, Thermal, Mechatronics, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering). * A minimum of one (1\) year of experience in multi\-piece mechanical manufacturing. * A minimum of one (1\) year of experience as an Associate PM, Junior PM, or Product Specialist in a technical hardware manufacturing company. Experience in technical program management may also be considered. * Experience with Stage\-Gate Discipline: Practical experience with Stage\-Gate / Phase\-Gate NPI methodologies used to bring physical hardware products from concept to full production. * Experience with PM/TPM Toolsets: Hands\-on familiarity with PLM systems, project tracking software (Jira, Asana, MS Project), and financial modeling in Excel. * Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. No relocation assistance is available for this position. * Travel: Minimal to moderate travel (up to 25%) for internal stage\-gate alignment meetings, factory visits, or key customer/marketing events as needed. * We will not consider applicants for employment requiring immigration sponsorship or support for this position. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Compensation:** $130,000\-$200,000 per year **Location:** Omaha, NE – Hybrid or United States \- Remote We’re always looking for great software engineers who want to shape the future of construction technology! This posting is part of our ongoing effort to build a pipeline of talented professionals for current or future opportunities. While hiring needs may not be immediate, we welcome your application. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will reach out if your experience aligns with a future opening. **The job:** As a Senior Software Engineer at Buildertrend, you'll help shape the future of construction technology and build the tools that construction professionals rely on to run their businesses, to work smarter, move faster, and deliver with confidence. You're not here to just execute tickets; you're here to make an impact. You'll work closely with our customers, and when something you ship makes their day easier, you'll hear about it. Your technical expertise will not only shape our products but also play a crucial role in delivering solutions that make a lasting impact on how construction teams work and succeed. **What you will do:** * Talk to our customers, and turn what you hear into technical solutions you drive through design, development, and delivery. * Write clean, maintainable code while maintaining high standards for performance and reliability as the platform scales. * Push back on solutions that are technically clean but don't solve the real customer problem, and make the case for the ones that do. * Lead code reviews and mentor engineers, helping strengthen engineering practices across the team. * Identify and advocate for improvements that make the platform stronger over time. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders. * Contribute to planning, retrospectives, and other agile practices that support consistent delivery. **Who you are and what you need:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or related field, or equivalent experience required. * 5\+ years of experience building production software; taking ownership of problems from discovery to delivery, and driving solutions to completion. * Prior experience at a B2B SaaS company, ideally where you’ve worked through scaling and reliability problems. * Strong hands\-on experience with React and C\#/.NET. * Fluency with AI\-assisted engineering, using it to work faster without sacrificing quality. * Strong understanding and experience with software design patterns and modern development practices (Agile, Scrum, etc.) * Measure success by whether the solution actually works for the customer, not just whether it shipped. * Contribute to a strong engineering environment by sharing knowledge, supporting and mentoring teammates, and helping raise technical standards. **We are giving you:** * Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability benefits * A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future * Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge * Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments * Volunteer time off – because giving back matters * Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best * Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need * Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home * Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team **Who we are:** Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/ **Working at Buildertrend:** At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. What makes Buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. Our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. of assigned issues and ensure appropriate follow\-through. **End\-User Technical Support** * Provide advanced troubleshooting for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and end\-user administration, permissions, identity, and access control. * Assist with endpoint management, security configuration, and device administration. * Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 applications and cloud service issues. **Server and On\-Premises Infrastructure** * Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments and traditional Active Directory domains. * Support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File and Print Services, and domain controllers. * Assist with server maintenance, patching, system health monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Support customers operating hybrid environments DNS, DHCP, VPN connectivity, switches, firewalls, VLANs, wireless networks, and general network communication. * Work with internal engineering resources and third\-party vendors when additional network support is required. **Identity and Access Management** * Administer user accounts, permissions, security groups, authentication, and access controls across Microsoft 365 and Active Directory environments. * Assist with identity\-related troubleshooting and security configuration. **Email and Security Support** * Support enhanced email security solutions designed to protect customer environments from phishing, malicious email, and other threats. * Assist with security\-related investigations, endpoint remediation, vulnerability remediation, and account security issues. * Follow established security standards and escalation procedures. **Deployment and Systems Administration** * Deploy and configure desktops, laptops, applications, and related technology for new and existing users. * Assist with workstation imaging, provisioning, software deployme  requirements. * Transition effectively between customers and technical issues throughout the workday. * Maintain professionalism and attention to detail while balancing multiple priorities. **Qualifications** **Experience** * **3 years of professional IT support experience preferred.** * Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience is strongly preferred. * Experience supporting small to mid\-size business environments. * Previous experience functioning as a technical escalation resource is preferred. **Technical Proficiency** Candidates should have hands\-on experience with several of the following areas: * Windows desktop operating systems * Windows Server * Active Directory and Group Policy * Microsoft 365 * Exchange Online * Microsoft Entra ID * Microsoft Intune * DNS and DHCP * VPN troubleshooting * Firewalls, switches, VLANs, and network connectivity * Endpoint troubleshooting and administration * Ticketing systems * Remote Monitoring and Management platforms * Business application troubleshooting Experience with both Microsoft cloud environments and traditional on\-premises Active Directory environments is highly valued. **Customer Service and Communication** * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical users. * Strong customer service mindset with the ability to build trust and maintain professional relationships. * Ability to remain professional and composed while troubleshooting customer\-impacting issues. **Ownership and Problem Solving** * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Ability to independently investigate and resolve technical problems. * Demonstrated ability to take ownership of issues and follow them through to resolution. * Ability to prioritize work effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-customer environment. * Willingness to collaborate, ask questions, and escalate documentation standards. **Certifications** Relevant industry certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar credentials are advantageous but are not required. **Work Environment** * Candidates
