This role is responsible for designing, automating, and optimizing the infrastructure that powers AI/ML workloads, enabling efficient model training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. The ideal candidate brings strong experience with AWS EKS, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, and distributed systems, along with a passion for platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. Working closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Software Engineers, you will play a key role in modernizing infrastructure, improving developer productivity, and advancing AI capabilities across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable MLOps platforms for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models. * Develop and manage cloud\-native infrastructure supporting large\-scale ML workloads on Kubernetes. * Implement and operate GPU workload scheduling solutions such as Volcano and Kueue. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML services, infrastructure, and platform components. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management using Terraform, Helm, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices. * Manage and optimize Kubernetes environments, including AWS EKS production clusters. * Lead infrastructure modernization and cloud migration initiatives. * Partner with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Software Engineers to productionize AI/ML solutions. * Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions across distributed systems and GPU clusters. * Troubleshoot complex performance, scalability, and reliability issues across ML platforms and infrastructure. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles. * 3\+ years supporting production AI/ML or Machine Learning platforms. * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and workload orchestration. * Experience with Kubernetes batch schedulers such as Volcano and/or Kueue. * Experience managing production workloads on AWS EKS. * Strong programming skills in Python and/or Golang. * Experience with Terraform, Helm, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code methodologies. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps. * Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting capabilities. * Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions using Prometheus and Grafana. * Solid understanding of distributed systems, containerization, cloud\-native architecture, and microservices. * Knowledge of ML lifecycle management, model deployment, and production operations. **Required Technical Skills** Kubernetes, AWS EKS, Terraform, Helm, Python, Golang, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Linux, Prometheus, Grafana, Kubeflow, MLflow, Distributed Systems, Cloud\-Native Architecture, Containerization, Microservices **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting GPU\-intensive AI/ML environments. * Hands\-on experience with Kubeflow and/or MLflow. * Experience with distributed training frameworks and GPU resource management. * Familiarity with LLMOps, RAG architectures, Generative AI, and vector databases. * Experience with ArgoCD or Flux. * Experience supporting multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments. The pay range that the employer in good faith reasonably expects to pay for this position is $34\.88/hour \- $54\.50/hour. jobs.title: Front-end Engineer 4
jobs.description: Front\-end Engineer 4*Capital One Travel is building a brand\-new product area inside Emerging Verticals — a true greenfield* bet within the fastest\-growing credit card travel portal in the US. You won’t be optimizing an existing product, instead, you’ll be designing and shipping high\-impact systems from scratch and defining the technical foundation for a category we expect to scale into a multi\-billion\-dollar market operation. This is a rare pitch for true technical ownership. You’ll join a small, entrepreneurial team that is pioneering AI\-native development — using tools like Claude to spec, prototype, build, and QA across many surfaces at 10x speed — all backed by Capital One’s massive distribution engine. If you love going zero\-to\-one, moving fast, and seeing your work reach millions of customers, this role is for you. ***What You’ll Do*** * Build new, customer\-facing products and platform services from the ground up across the front end — from data and APIs through to the experiences customers touch. * Work AI\-natively: use modern AI tooling to prototype, generate, test, and ship features across many different areas and surfaces at a pace traditional teams can’t match. * Partner directly with product, design, business, and external supply/partner contacts — translating real\-world business needs into technical solutions and owning them end\-to\-end. * Lead a portfolio of fast\-moving projects and help set the engineering bar for a new team, mentoring others and raising the standard for AI\-accelerated delivery. * Make pragmatic architecture decisions for systems that need to scale quickly and reliably as the vertical grows. * Utilize programming languages like JavaScript (Angular, React, Node), HTML/CSS, TypeScript and Java, open source frameworks, RESTful web services, and work on cross\-browser and cross\-device development ***What We’re Looking For*** * Builders who have shipped their own projects end\-to\-end with AI — not just code\-completion, but using AI across the whole build cycle. * Engineers who move fast in ambiguous, zero\-to\-one environments and have launched new features at scale. * People who are comfortable owning business and partner relationships, not just tickets. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience jobs.title: AI & Software Automation Developer
jobs.description: **Location:** Hendersonville / Nashville, Tennessee **Schedule:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time **Work Arrangement:** Primarily Remote \+ Weekly In\-Person Meeting **Experience Level:** Junior to Mid\-Level **Part\-Time Compensation:** **$25–$45/hour, depending on experience and ability** **Full\-Time Compensation:** Salary based on experience About the Opportunity We are a growing automotive company operating an established automotive repair facility and used\-vehicle dealership in Hendersonville, Tennessee. We're looking for a technically minded developer who is excited about **AI, software development and business automation** and wants the opportunity to build real applications that will actually be used every day. **This position can be full\-time or part\-time.** Most work can be performed remotely, but we would like the person to be located within reasonable driving distance of Hendersonville/Nashville so we can meet **in person approximately once per week** to review projects, understand business processes and plan what we're building next. This could be an excellent opportunity for an early\-career developer who wants more responsibility and hands\-on experience than they might receive at a large company. You don't need 10 years of experience. You don't need to know every technology we use. You **do** need to know how to build software, be comfortable figuring things out and be genuinely interested in what is happening with AI. What You'll Work On We are actively building technology across our businesses, including: * Internal management dashboards * AI\-powered employee assistants * API integrations between automotive software platforms * Vehicle inventory and reconditioning tracking * Customer communication automation * AI\-assisted vehicle evaluation and purchasing tools * Browser extensions * Reporting and analytics tools * Internal knowledge and training assistants * Applications that work with vehicle photos, videos and documents * Automation of repetitive business processes These aren't hypothetical projects. You'll be working with real employees, real business data and real operational problems. What You'll Do You'll work directly with company leadership to: * Build and improve internal web applications * Connect third\-party software using APIs * Build dashboards and reporting tools * Integrate AI models such as OpenAI/ChatGPT and Claude into applications * Automate repetitive workflows * Work with databases and business data * Build prototypes to test new ideas * Turn successful prototypes into reliable applications * Troubleshoot and improve existing applications * Maintain projects through GitHub * Deploy applications to the cloud * Research new technologies and determine how we can use them * Document what you build so other people can understand and maintain it What We're Looking For You should have a working understanding of software development and experience with some of the following: * JavaScript / TypeScript * Python * React, Next.js or similar web\-development frameworks * REST APIs * SQL / databases * Git / GitHub * Basic cloud deployment **You do not need to be an expert in all of them.** We're especially interested in someone who has experimented with or built projects using: * OpenAI / ChatGPT APIs * Claude / Anthropic APIs * AI agents * AI coding tools * Automation platforms * API integrations * RAG / AI knowledge bases * Image or document analysis using AI Experience Approximately **1–3 years of professional software\-development experience** is ideal, but we're flexible. We will also consider: * Recent computer science / software engineering graduates with strong projects * College students with demonstrated development ability * Self\-taught developers with an impressive portfolio * Developers who have built their own applications or SaaS projects * Candidates with internship or freelance experience * Candidates who have been heavily experimenting with modern AI development **What you can actually build matters more to us than the number of years on your résumé.** You Might Be a Great Fit If... You're the person who enjoys figuring things out. When you don't know how to do something, your first instinct is to research it, test it and get it working. You probably have personal projects you've built simply because you wanted to see if you could. You use modern AI development tools to make yourself more productive, but you also understand the fundamentals behind the software you're building. You're comfortable being given a business problem without being handed detailed technical instructions. For example: "It takes too long to get vehicles through our reconditioning process. We have data in several different systems. Can we build something that shows us where every vehicle is and what's holding it up?" We want someone who gets excited about figuring out how to solve that problem. Work Schedule \& Location We're intentionally flexible about how this position is structured. The role can be **full\-time or part\-time**. For part\-time candidates, compensation is **$25–$45 per hour**, depending on experience, technical ability and fit. Most development work can be completed **remotely and on a flexible schedule**. However, understanding the actual business is important when building software for it. We would therefore like to meet **in person approximately once per week at our Hendersonville location**. These meetings will be used to review projects, demonstrate what's been built, understand employee workflows, identify new opportunities and establish priorities for the next development cycle. Outside of these meetings, we're primarily interested in **results rather than where you're sitting while you write code.** What This Position Is Not This is not an IT/help\-desk position. It's also not simply a "prompt engineering" position. You'll use AI extensively, but you'll also write code, work with APIs, databases, authentication and existing business systems. Automotive Experience **Automotive experience is not required.** We'll teach you our industry, systems and business processes. We're hiring you for your technical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn. Why This Could Be a Great Early\-Career Opportunity At a large technology company, an early\-career developer may spend years working on a small portion of a much larger system. Here, you'll have the opportunity to work on entire projects: **Identify a problem** **design a solution** **build it** **deploy it** **watch employees use it** **improve it.** You'll work directly with company ownership and management and have substantial input into how our technology evolves. As your capabilities grow, the position can grow with you. How to Apply Please send: * Your résumé or LinkedIn profile * Your GitHub or portfolio, if available * Examples of applications, websites, automations or AI projects you've built * A short description of the **most interesting thing you've personally built** * An example of how you're currently using AI to improve the way you develop software * Whether you're interested in **full\-time or part\-time work** * Your general availability and approximate distance from Hendersonville, Tennessee Personal projects absolutely count. **We're much more interested in seeing something you built than reading a long list of technologies on a résumé.**

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Test Automation
jobs.description: **About Care Access** Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.** With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all. To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com. ### **How This Role Makes a Difference** The **Senior Engineer, Test Automation** is responsible for designing, implementing, and advancing the automated testing infrastructure that supports Care Access's regulated software platforms. This position develops and maintains scalable test automation frameworks, with a strong emphasis on Playwright\-based end\-to\-end testing, to ensure the quality, reliability, and compliance of software solutions throughout the development lifecycle. The role applies expertise in GxP validation principles and computerized system validation to support software quality within a regulated environment. The Senior Engineer collaborates closely with cross\-functional product, engineering, and quality teams to integrate automated testing into development and deployment processes, promote quality engineering best practices, and continuously improve testing strategies. This position also evaluates and implements emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted testing approaches, to expand test coverage, improve efficiency, and strengthen software validation while ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and organizational requirements. ### **How You'll Make An Impact** * Build, maintain, and improve the end\-to\-end test automation framework, with Playwright as the primary toolchain across UI, API, and integration layers. * Author and maintain release validation documentation, in support of 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP compliance. * Evaluate and apply AI\-assisted testing techniques, such as LLM\-based test generation and intelligent failure triage, to extend coverage and reduce toil. * Integrate and maintain quality gates across CI/CD pipelines, balancing speed with the rigor required for a regulated environment. * Partner with engineers during active development to shift quality left — writing tests alongside features and surfacing risk early. * Contribute to QA process improvements and share knowledge with teammates; you're a resource others lean on without being responsible for managing them. ### **The Expertise Required** * Strong proficiency with Playwright and experience building automation frameworks that are reliable and easy to maintain. * Exposure to GxP validation practices — you have contributed to or authored traceability matrices and validation summary reports. * Familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, GCP, or similar regulatory frameworks as they apply to software systems. * Curiosity about AI tooling in testing — you've experimented with or are eager to explore LLM\-assisted test generation and failure analysis. * Solid engineering fundamentals: you can read production code, debug across the stack, and build test infrastructure engineers actually want to use. * Clear communication: you can explain test strategy and risk tradeoffs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience** * Minimum Education: + Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience * Minimum Experience: + 5\+ years of software or QA engineering experience, with meaningful depth in test automation. ### **How We Work Together** * **Location**: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment. * **Travel**: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role. * **Physical demands associated with this position Include**: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment. + Walking \<5%, Standing 20%, Sitting 70% The expected pay range for this role is $130,000 \- $180,000 USD per year for full time team members. ### **Benefits \& Perks (US Full Time Employees)** * Paid Time Off (PTO) and Company Paid Holidays * 100% Employer paid medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options * Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Accounts * Bi\-weekly HSA employer contribution * Company paid Short\-Term Disability and Long\-Term Disability * 401(k) Retirement Plan, with Company Match ### **Mandatory Employer Disclosures:** **Notice to Illinois applicants:** Applicants are not obligated to disclose expunged juvenile records or adjudication, arrest, or conviction. **Notice to Connecticut applicants:** Care Access may require applicants to submit to a urinalysis drug test in connection with an application for employment. **Notice to Arizona, Georgia, Indiana, and North Dakota applicants:** Care Access complies with applicable laws prohibiting smoking in and around places of employment. **Notice to Massachusetts applicants:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **Notice to Rhode Island applicants:** Care Access complies with Rhode Island law prohibiting smoking in enclosed areas within places of employment. Care Access is also subject to is subject to Chapters 29–38 of Title 28 of the Rhode Island General Laws. **Notice to Maryland applicants: UNDER MARYLAND LAW, AN EMPLOYER MAY NOT REQUIRE OR DEMAND, AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT, PROSPECTIVE EMPLOYMENT, OR CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT, THAT AN INDIVIDUAL SUBMIT TO OR TAKE A LIE DETECTOR OR SIMILAR TEST. AN EMPLOYER WHO VIOLATES THIS LAW IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND SUBJECT TO A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $100\.** \#LI\-Remote **Diversity \& Inclusion** We work with and serve people from diverse cultures and communities around the world. We are stronger and better when we build a team representing the communities we support. We maintain an inclusive culture where people from a broad range of backgrounds feel valued and respected as they contribute to our mission. jobs.title: Coherent DSP Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Principal Applications Engineer Irvine, CA or San Jose, CA About the Role Celero is seeking a hands\-on, highly motivated Coherent DSP Applications Engineer to help bring next\-generation coherent optical DSP solutions from the lab to customer deployment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, enjoys solving complex technical challenges, and wants to make a direct impact on both products and customers. As a key member of the team, you will work closely with DSP, ASIC, hardware, firmware, and product engineering teams, while partnering directly with hyperscale customers and strategic partners to integrate, validate, debug, and optimize coherent DSP\-based optical solutions. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence product direction, contribute to customer success, and help shape the future of high\-speed optical connectivity for AI infrastructure and cloud networking. What You'll Do Customer Integration and Technical Leadership * Serve as the technical owner for customer integration and deployment of coherent DSP\-based optical modules and systems. * Work directly with hyperscalers, network equipment manufacturers (NEMs), and strategic partners to support: * System design and architecture discussions * Platform integration and bring\-up * Interoperability and qualification testing * Field trials and early customer deployments * Configure, tune, and optimize coherent DSP parameters to maximize performance and reliability. Debug and System Validation * Troubleshoot complex issues spanning multiple disciplines, including: * DSP algorithms and signal processing * Optical impairments, including chromatic dispersion (CD) and differential group delay (DGD) * Host electrical interfaces, including 200G/400G/800G PAM4 and beyond * Module management and control interfaces, including CMIS and telemetry * Analyze system performance metrics, including BER, Q\-factor, SNR, and debug logs, and drive issues to root cause. * Support interoperability testing in multi\-vendor environments. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner closely with DSP, ASIC, hardware, firmware, and systems engineering teams to resolve issues and improve product performance. * Contribute to technical documentation, application notes, validation reports, and customer\-facing materials. * Provide direct feedback to engineering and product teams on feature prioritization, product requirements, and roadmap decisions. What You Bring * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Optical Engineering or Applied Physics Related technical discipline * 8\+ years of experience" and "ability to travel up to 25–40% to customer sites as needed * Strong fundamentals in digital signal processing, telecommunications theory, and optical communications. Hands\-on experience with: * Coherent modulation techniques, including QPSK and 16\-QAM * Forward Error Correction (FEC) and framers * DWDM optical systems and coherent transceivers * Experience debugging complex hardware and software interactions in a laboratory environment. * Ability to independently solve ambiguous, cross\-functional technical problems. * Ability to generate technical documentation, such as Applications notes, Data sheets, Product requirement Documents, etc. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with customers and internal engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting coherent optical module products, including: * 400ZR * 800ZR * Coherent Lite * Familiarity with QSFP\-DD and OSFP coherent modules. * Knowledge of high\-speed host electrical interfaces, including CEI\-112G, PAM4, and next\-generation standards. * Experience using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for analysis, automation, and data processing. * Experience working with hyperscalers, network equipment manufacturers (NEMs), or cloud infrastructure providers. * Exposure to open networking environments and multi\-vendor interoperability testing. How You'll Succeed * You are comfortable working in ambiguous environments and can make progress without perfect specifications. * You take ownership and drive issues to resolution from initial discovery through deployment. * You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. * You enjoy learning quickly and contributing beyond a narrowly defined role. * You are excited to help shape not only a product, but also a company and its culture. Why Join Celero? * Work on cutting\-edge coherent DSP technology powering next\-generation AI infrastructure and optical networking. * Make a direct impact on product direction and customer success. * Collaborate with a small, highly experienced engineering team. * Gain exposure across DSP, optics, ASICs, firmware, systems, and customer applications. * Grow your career quickly in a dynamic startup environment with significant opportunities for leadership and ownership. Annual Base Salary Range: $175,000 \- $225,000 (The final offer will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location.)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere in the United States. Meet the Team Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. Cisco Isovalent is building the next generation of products for securing workloads and AI infrastructure using advanced technologies across Linux and Windows. Our software agent team builds high\-performance, secure, and lightweight software agents that run across traditional and modern workloads in on\-premises and cloud environments. These agents collect rich information about workloads and system activity, provide network and runtime visibility, enforce security policies, and help protect containerized and endpoint environments. As part of the Windows agent engineering team, you will focus on extending these security capabilities to Windows environments. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross\-functional teams to develop system\-level security capabilities while contributing to a cross\-platform product spanning Windows and Linux. Your Impact As a Software Engineer on the software agent team, you will develop and enhance runtime security features for a Windows\-based endpoint agent. You will use systems programming, Windows platform APIs, operating system fundamentals, and networking concepts to build reliable and efficient security capabilities that operate close to the underlying operating system. You will investigate Windows platform behavior and interactions between user\-mode and kernel\-mode components while designing and implementing endpoint security and system\-monitoring functionality. You will participate in architecture and design discussions with senior engineers and architects, troubleshoot complex implementation issues, and optimize software for performance and reliability. Because our products operate across platforms, you will also collaborate with engineers developing related capabilities across Linux and other environments. The features you develop will contribute to Cisco Isovalent's ability to provide security, visibility, and protection across modern enterprise, data center, and cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop and enhance runtime security features for a Windows\-based endpoint agent. * Design and implement systems\-level endpoint security and monitoring capabilities using Go, C, and C\+\+. * Participate in architecture, design, and implementation discussions with senior engineers and architects. * Develop software using Windows system programming interfaces, including Win32 APIs, File I/O, and Winsock. * Investigate Windows platform behavior, APIs, and interactions between user\-mode and kernel\-mode components. * Develop multi\-threaded and multi\-process applications and system\-level software. * Debug and resolve complex implementation issues and perform code reviews to improve software quality. * Analyze and optimize feature performance to ensure efficient endpoint operation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand runtime security requirements and translate them into reliable software solutions. * Contribute to cross\-platform security capabilities spanning Windows and Linux environments. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree with 5\+ years of software development experience, or a Master's degree with 4\+ years of software development experience * Experience with systems programming using C, or C\+\+, including multi\-threaded and multi\-process application development. * 2 \+ year’s experience with operating system fundamentals, including threads, processes, file systems, networking, and inter\-process communication. * Experience with Windows system programming, including Win32 APIs, File I/O, Winsock, and familiarity with API hooking concepts. * Experience debugging and troubleshooting complex software systems. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Understanding of Windows kernel concepts and how user\-mode and kernel\-mode components interact. * Experience developing endpoint security, cybersecurity, or system\-monitoring software. * Experience with Windows kernel programming, driver development, or low\-level Windows internals. * Familiarity with malware detection techniques, endpoint protection technologies, or security monitoring concepts. * Experience with network programming and security\-related protocols. * Experience implementing complex systems\-level software features in production environments. * Experience analyzing and optimizing performance for systems\-level or endpoint software. * Experience collaborating with senior engineers and architects on software architecture and technical design decisions. \#LN\-RN1 Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together a  and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada: The starting salary range posted for this position is $167,700\.00 to $245,200\.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation\*, equity, or benefits. Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job\-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process. U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time. U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies: * 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non\-exempt employees * 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year\-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco * Non\-exempt employees\*\* receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4\.92 hours per pay period for full\-time employees * Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations) * 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next * Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members * Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer For non\-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies. Employees on sales plans earn performance\-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non\-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota\-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows: * .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota; * 1\.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%; * 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and * Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation. For non\-quota\-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. jobs.description: **Company Description** **Appointment Type:** Permanent Exempt (PEX), Category 18\. This position is excluded by the City Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer. Duration of this appointment shall not exceed 36 months. * **Application Opening:** 9/25/2026 * **Application Deadline:** May close anytime but no sooner than Friday, 10/16/2026 at 5:00PM (PDT). * **Salary Range:** $143,572 \- $180,596 annually (click here to learn more) **Controller’s Office** The Controller is the City’s chief financial officer. Our team includes financial, technology, analytical, and other professionals who work hard to secure the City’s financial integrity and promote efficient, effective, and accountable government. We hold ourselves to high standards and strive to be a model for good government. We value the diverse backgrounds, perspectives and lived experiences of our teams and clients in everything we do. We work in a collaborative and inclusive environment, promote equal opportunity, and invest in the professional development and well\-being of our team members. You can expect to work alongside colleagues who are committed to serving the public with integrity and want to see positive impacts from their work. We are looking for smart, motivated individuals who want to make a difference and use government to play a role in solving our City’s issues, including addressing long\-standing and harmful disparities in our communities. For a career with purpose and professional growth, join us in the Controller’s Office! **Systems Division of the Controller’s Office:** The Systems Division of the Controller’s Office manages the City and County of San Francisco’s Enterprise Oracle and PeopleSoft Applications, which include Oracle Interaction Hub, PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM), PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), PeopleSoft Enterprise Learning Management (ELM), and Oracle Business Intelligence. These applications are branded locally as our SF Employee Portal, SF People \& Pay, SF Financials, SF Procurement, SF Learning, and SF Reports and Analytics systems. Collectively, these applications provide a robust, integrated platform that delivers mission\-critical services to 55 City Departments, eliminating the need for hundreds of independent legacy systems and customized applications. The division serves over 35,000 active City employees, 75,000 retirees and 25,000 City vendors (bidders and suppliers). Peripheral and legacy applications also leveraged by the division include Oracle Identify \& Access Management, Sherpa Budget Formulation \& Management, Phire Architect, Control\-M, and FreshWorks. The technology implemented and maintained by the Systems Division provides standardization, transparency, and efficiency for the City’s crucial business processes. Users are fully supported to ensure adoption of these interconnected systems. **Job Description** **Business Intelligence Platform Change Project** The Controller’s Office is working in a multi\-year project to migrate the Reports and Analytics solution into a unified Snowflake\-based platform. The BI Platform Change will provide departments with secure, streamlined access to PeopleSoft data, improving efficiency, governance, and standardizing data sharing citywide. By replacing outdated processes, this modern framework supports transparency, accountability, collaboration, better service delivery, strategic growth, and public trust. **Job Description:** This IS Engineer position will be part of the BI Platform Change project and will work with members of the SF Reports \& Analytics Team, Functional Teams and other City and County staff to support the project. The analyst will perform both functional (business process and systems analysis) and technical (report, query and dashboard development, data extract, load and transformation, metadata modeling, tuning, and troubleshooting) tasks. This position will be supporting the current Oracle BI platform, but it will also collaborate in the building of the new business intelligence platform using tools such as dbt, SQL, and other tools with a Snowflake data warehouse source and target. **Essential duties include but are not limited to:** * Analyze the interrelationships of business processes, complex financial data, human resources data, and systems to develop reporting requirements and data structures. * Perform fit/gap analysis to evaluate reporting and data needs. * Develop and maintain OBIEE/OAS dashboards, analyses, and BI Publisher reports. * Design and enhance RPDs (Physical, BMM \& Presentation Layers). * Support Subject Areas, Logical Table Sources (LTS), and metadata models. * Develop ETL solutions using ODI, perform query optimization, cache management, and performance tuning, support production issues, enhancements, and troubleshooting activities * Write business and system process and technical documentation. * plating to support reusable transformations across multiple datasets and environments * Hands\-on experience in GitHub for code change management and collaboration with other team members * Experience in building and deploying data pipelines using orchestration tools * Understanding the process to build and deploy data pipelines using orchestration tools * Deep understanding of data warehouse concepts, data modeling, and modern ETL principles * Understanding of data governance, data security, and data privacy principles * Understanding of PeopleSoft applications such as PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), PeopleSoft Capital Human Resources (HCM) experience performing data analysis, design and testing. * Working with DBAs, BI Development team, PeopleSoft, and Security teams to improve performance and data quality using Agile sessions * Working knowledge of business process flows used to support a complex accounting system, and experience in developing and executing application test plans. **Collaboration and Communication Skills** * Strong problem\-solving skills with ability to design practical and effective data solutions * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * A collaborative mindset with enthusiasm to work across diverse, cross\-functional teams **Mission alignment** * Commitment to equity, transparency, and ethical data use * Passion for public service using data to improve government services **Additional Information** **Selection Procedures** The selection process will include evaluation of applications in relation to minimum requirements. Candidates whose qualifications most closely meet the needs of the Department will move forward in the recruitment process. **Additional Information Regarding Employment with the City and County of San Francisco:** * Information About the Hiring Process * Conviction History * Employee Benefits Overview * Equal Employment Opportunity * Disaster Service Worker * ADA Accommodation * Right to Work * Copies of Application Documents * Diversity Statement **Where to Apply** All job applications for the City and County of San Francisco must be submitted through our online portal. Please visit https://careers.sf.gov/ to begin your application process. Computers are available for the public (9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Monday through Friday) to file online applications in the lobby of the Dept. of Human Resources at 1 South Van Ness Avenue, 4th Floor and at the City Career Center at City Hall, 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place, Room 110\. Ensure your application information is accurate, as changes may not be possible after submission. Your first and last name must match your legal ID for verification, and preferred names can be included in parentheses. Use your personal email address, not a shared or work email, to avoid unfixable issues. Applicants will receive a confirmation email from **notification@smartrecruiters.com** that their online application has been received in response to every announcement for which they file. Applicants should retain this confirmation email for their records. **Failure to receive this email means that the online application was not submitted or received.** If you have any questions regarding this recruitment or application process, please contact the Nancy Giang at nancy.giang@sfgov.org. Recruitment ID: RTF0168328\-01159490 The City and County of San Francisco encourages women, minorities and persons with disabilities to apply. Applicants will be considered regardless of their sex, race, age, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition (associated with cancer, a history of cancer, or genetic characteristics), HIV/AIDS status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, military and veteran status, or other protected category under the law.

jobs.title: Information Technology Architect | (Cloud Engineer)
jobs.description: **Information Technology Architect (Cloud Engineer)** **General Description and Classification Standards:** The Information Technology Architect (Cloud Engineer) in the Enterprise Data Services (EDS) team, within the Office of Technology and Digital Experience (TDE), is responsible for architecting, engineering, and operating the cloud and database platforms that support the Department of Aviation’s enterprise data and AI initiatives. This hybrid role combines cloud engineering with database administration: enabling secure, scalable cloud services while administering Oracle, SQL Server, and cloud\-managed database systems, including design, development, implementation, capacity planning, monitoring for availability, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security, upgrades, and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud infrastructure, along with the ability to design and deliver reliable, secure, and cost\-effective data platforms that keep airport systems available 24 x 7 x 365 while enabling the airport’s analytics, automation, and AI roadmap. **Supervision Received:** Reports to the Information Technology Director II, Enterprise Data Services, and works with minimal supervision, using independent judgment and initiative. Makes decisions on process and procedure improvements, solutions to reduce system downtime, system maintenance to improve performance and availability, and hardware and software for databases and database application servers. Provides advice on system upgrades and new technology implementation. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** *These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.* * **Cloud Architecture \& Engineering** + Design, build, and maintain cloud architectures, landing zones, and reference designs for enterprise data services, aligned with EDS standards, security requirements, and the enterprise data and AI roadmap. + Enable and manage cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and managed database and analytics services, for airport applications and data workloads. + Plan and execute migrations of on\-premises databases and applications to cloud platforms, including assessment, sizing, cutover, and validation. + Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment using scripting, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines. + Monitor and optimize cloud consumption and costs, and recommend right\-sizing, reservation, and licensing strategies. * **Database Administration \& Operations** + Administer and maintain day\-to\-day operations of Oracle, SQL Server, and cloud\-managed databases, services, and software, including creating user accounts, assigning permissions and schemas, and creating tables and fields. + Configure and maintain database software and environments, ensuring data remains consistent, accurate, and clearly defined, and that security levels comply with Division and Department standards and procedures. + Monitor the overall health, availability, and performance of database systems, services, and data flow, and take corrective action as required to ensure reliable performance. + Perform installation, upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and performance tuning, and resolve database performance, capacity, replication, and other distributed data issues. + Develop and implement data models, database designs, data access code, and table maintenance code, documenting how data elements are defined and used. * **Backup, Recovery \& Availability** + Plan, schedule, and verify backup and recovery procedures, and ensure that required backups are completed. + Restore failed production databases and services through the disaster recovery process, and design high availability and disaster recovery solutions across on\-premises and cloud environments. + Act as a member of a team to ensure 24 x 7 x 365 availability of the Department’s enterprise database systems and cloud services. * **Security \& Compliance** + Plan, coordinate, and implement security measures, including access controls, encryption, and auditing, to safeguard information against accidental or unauthorized damage, modification, or disclosure. + Develop standards and guidelines to guide the use and acquisition of software and to protect vulnerable information. + Ensure cloud and database environments meet security, compliance, and operational resilience requirements, including the protection of Sensitive Security Information (SSI), Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), personally identifiable information (PII), and critical infrastructure data. + Ensure databases and software applications are patched and upgraded to current supported product versions. * **Data Platform \& AI Enablement** + Architect and support the data platforms that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and the AI roadmap, including data integration, pipelines, data warehouses, and secure envi es. * Database Administration: Strong background in Oracle and SQL Server administration, including SQL, PL/SQL, and T\-SQL, performance tuning, replication, and backup and recovery. * Systems \& Security: High\-level understanding of system architectures, storage, and database and cloud security practices, with working knowledge of Azure environment. * Automation \& Tooling: Proficiency with scripting and infrastructure as code (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Terraform) and with monitoring and database management tools such as Oracle Enterprise Manager and Toad. * Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently and to prioritize effectively. * Problem\-Solving \& Initiative: Self\-starter able to use judgment and initiative to undertake activities and resolve complex technical problems with minimal supervision. * Communication \& Customer Service: Excellent oral and written communication skills, the ability to work alone or within a team, and a customer\-focused, responsive approach when serving business units. * Vendor Management: Experience maintaining software licenses and managing vendor maintenance and support agreements. Availability \& Flexibility: Willingness to work extra hours as needed, participate in an on\-call rotation, and respond to after\-hours emergencies. * * **Industry Experience:** Aviation, transportation, or public sector experience with knowledge of FAA and TSA requirements, cybersecurity standards, and airport IT ecosystems. * **Cloud Architecture:** Experience designing and migrating enterprise workloads and databases to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or similar cloud platforms, including networking, identity, and landing zone design. * **Database Platforms:** Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, and cloud\-managed database services, including high availability, replication, backup and recovery, and performance tuning. * **Automation \& Infrastructure as Code:** Experience with scripting (PowerShell, Python, shell), infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep), and CI/CD and DevOps practices. * **Vendor \& Cost Management:** Experience managing software licenses, vendor support agreements, and cloud consumption costs (FinOps). **Work Environment** Typical office setting, with participation in an on\-call rotation and after\-hours support as scheduled or requested. **Lifting Requirements:** Sedentary work : Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. *It is the policy of the City of Atlanta (“COA”) that qualified individuals with disabilities are not discriminated against because of their disabilities regarding job application procedures, hiring, and other terms and conditions of employment. It is further the policy of the COA to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of the employment process. The COA is prepared to modify or adjust the job application process or the job or work environment to make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of the applicant or employee to enable the applicant or employee to be considered for the position he or she desires, to perform the essential functions of the position in question, or to enjoy equal benefits and privileges of employment as are enjoyed by other similarly situated employees without disabilities, unless the accommodation will impose an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact the Human Resources Director for your department.* ***The City of Atlanta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, ender identity, marital status, veteran’s status or national origin, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law.*** ***We value and encourage diversity in our workforce.***

jobs.description: **Join the City of Chattanooga Team** **Chattanooga** , a vibrant and growing community of over 190,000 residents within a metropolitan area of nearly 600,000 is known as the "Scenic City" for a reason. Nestled along the Tennessee River and surrounded by the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains, we are a hub of outdoor adventure and innovation. Home to the **University of Tennessee at Chattanooga (UTC)** and **Chattanooga State Community College** , our city blends a rich industrial history with a tech\-forward future—famously powered by the nation’s first community\-wide "Gig" fiber\-optic network. The City of Chattanooga was also recently designated as a "National Park City,” the first of its kind in the United States. ### **Our Organization** As a City, we are powered by a dedicated workforce of approximately **2,600 employees** committed to excellence in public service and making Chattanooga the best community in the country. Our team ensures our city thrives through a wide range of municipal services, including: * **Public Safety:** Chattanooga Police and Fire Departments. * **Infrastructure \& Utilities:** Public Works, Waste Resources, and specialized Stormwater management. * **Quality of Life:** Award\-winning Parks and Outdoors and Community Development systems and the Chattanooga Public Library. * **Transportation:** The Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport (CHA) and citywide transit and pedestrian friendly initiatives. * **Innovation:** Leading\-edge smart\-city programs with a commitment to cutting edge workforce development policies to ensure all our residents can get ahead. ### **Why Choose Chattanooga?** The City of Chattanooga’s workforce is the heartbeat of our community. We don't just offer jobs; we offer careers with purpose: making Chattanooga the best city in America. We are committed to being the **premier employer of choice** in Southeast Tennessee by providing: * **Competitive Compensation:** Robust pay scales that reflect our commitment to our staff. * **Work\-Life Balance:** Generous paid time off and flexible scheduling where possible. * **Exceptional Wellness:** Comprehensive health benefits and wellness programs designed for you and your family that deliver savings to you beyond your paycheck, featuring a centralized health clinic and pharmacy for all City employees. . * **Growth:** A focus on professional development and upward mobility within the organization. * **The Great Outdoors: Your Backyard Playground:** Chattanooga isn't just near nature, it's immersed in it. Whether you are an adrenaline junkie or a weekend wanderer, world\-class adventure is always less than an hour away. * **Vertical Adventures:** Scale legendary sandstone cliffs in what is widely considered the **premier rock climbing hub** of the Southeast. * **Water \& Rapids:** From the high\-octane **whitewater kayaking** of the Ocoee River to world\-class **bass fishing** and peaceful paddling on the Tennessee River. * **Trails for Miles:** Explore a massive network of **mountain biking** and **hiking trails** that wind through lush ridges, hidden waterfalls, and deep river gorges. Our mission is to work together to build a safe, vibrant, and sustainable city for all Chattanoogans. To do that, it takes a team of skilled and passionate individuals. jobs.title: SCADA System Analyst I - Software Specialist
jobs.description: **City Utilities Engineering** **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; hours may vary ***Do you enjoy using programming, data, and automation to solve real\-world problems? Join City Utilities Engineering and help support the software and control systems that keep Fort Wayne's essential water, sewer, and stormwater operations running.*** **What You'll Do** As the SCADA System Analyst I – Software Specialist, you will help develop, support, and improve the software behind City Utilities' industrial control systems. You will work alongside engineers and operations staff to maintain SCADA applications, databases, process historians, dashboards, data pipelines, and virtualized operational technology infrastructure. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys programming and troubleshooting but also wants to see how their work directly supports critical public infrastructure. **Key Responsibilities** * Configure and support SCADA applications, HMIs, graphical interfaces, and industrial control platforms, with an emphasis on Inductive Automation Ignition. * Create, maintain, and document custom scripts and software integrations using Python, SQL, C, C\+\+, or related programming languages. * Maintain SQL databases, process historians, dashboards, reports, historical trends, and data collection or migration pipelines. * Support control\-system servers, virtual networks, telemetry systems, and industrial communications, including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, and LAN/WAN connectivity. * Troubleshoot SCADA connections to PLCs and field devices using alarms, event logs, historical trends, and communication\-analysis tools. * Partner with engineering and operations teams to identify control\-system needs, develop solutions, document completed work, and support automation projects. * Train employees on SCADA interfaces and custom or newly implemented software solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled software, and assist with their responsible implementation and long\-term management. **What You Bring** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical or Computer Engineering Technology, or another approved engineering discipline from an accredited college or university; **or** * An equivalent combination of education and hands\-on experience. * At least two years of experience in an industrial environment involving industrial control systems, programming, instrumentation, database management, or process automation. **Technical Skills** * Knowledge of industrial control and SCADA platforms; Inductive Automation Ignition experience is preferred. * Experience with SQL databases, queries, and custom database solutions. * Ability to read, modify, create, and document scripts using Python, SQL, C, C\+\+, or related languages. * Understanding of process historians, dashboards, reporting tools, virtual infrastructure, and PLC interfaces. * Knowledge of industrial communications, including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, gateways, routers, and wireless systems. * Basic understanding of industrial instrumentation used to measure level, flow, pressure, and other process conditions. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and teamwork skills. * Ability to explain technical information clearly to engineers, operations employees, and vendors. **Preferred Certifications** * Inductive Automation Ignition Core or Gold Certification. * Candidates without these certifications must have the interest and ability to pursue them during employment. * A valid Indiana driver's license is required when operating a City vehicle. **Work Environment** This position includes a combination of office\-based computer work and occasional work within active utility facilities. Employees may encounter industrial equipment, electrical systems, chemicals, weather conditions, elevated areas, and moderate noise. The position may occasionally require climbing, kneeling, crouching, or lifting up to 50 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why Work for the City of Fort Wayne?** Your work will support the systems that help deliver safe, reliable utility services to the Fort Wayne community. The City offers meaningful work, opportunities to strengthen your technical skills, professional development, paid time off, health benefits, and participation in Indiana's public retirement program. ***The City of Fort Wayne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.title: Desktop Support IT Engineer II - (Police)
jobs.description: **Description/Duties** ---------------------- ***This vacancy is in the Police Department's Public Safety Information Technology (PSIT) unit for the Desktop Support Assignment.*** The Information Technology (IT) Engineer II class provides skilled technical services in support of installation, configuration, testing, integration, and ongoing support for City applications or infrastructure requiring an in\-depth knowledge of the City’s platforms and environment in support of meeting availability and performance goals. This class applies to Business Solutions and Application Development; Business Analytics; Database; Desktop and Mobile Services; Service Desk; Geographic Information System (GIS); Network; Security; Unified Communications; and Server, Storage, and Backup. Common responsibilities and skills include: leadership skills, including performing independent judgment and decision\-making, especially related to diagnostics and troubleshooting with enterprise applications or infrastructure; providing quality written and verbal communications/presentations to customer areas and senior leadership in both small and large settings; supervising and coordinating day to\-day activities of technical staff ***(by assignment)*** of usually three or less direct reports; and performing primary and secondary highly technical application or product support within one of the technical support areas of Business Solutions and Application Development; Business Analytics; Database; Desktop and Mobile Services; Service Desk; GIS; Network; Security; Unified Communications; and Server, Storage, and Backup. This class may perform technical and/or project leadership for a medium\- to large\-size project using the Project Management Office (PMO) standard methodologies or concurrent small\- to medium\-scale project management. This class is responsible for positively and actively participating in team training and demonstrating team skills learned by applying and reinforcing team principles in daily work with functional teams. Common duties include: performing work on multiple assignments simultaneously such as configuration, integration, development, testing, and resolution of problems for systems; assessing, troubleshooting, and following established guidelines in the escalation of hardware, software, and networking problems; initiating and/or maintaining Incident Reports (IRs) using an on\-line incident management system; assisting with research, evaluation, and implementation of new technologies and/or packaged software; installing and supporting hardware and/or software; preparing and/or updating system documentation; controlling changes in system environments to ensure stable and reliable delivery of computer resources; coordinating and mentoring staff; developing and analyzing data for problem resolution and strategic planning; implementing, maintaining, and monitoring systems and their related subsystems; participating in projects and/or leading small\- to medium\-scale projects and activities related to City computer systems, data, and infrastructure; participating in design, programming, installation, and/or implementation of information systems; planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, coordinating, and scheduling processes, procedures, and strategies for systems that function or communicate across multiple platforms; supporting computing processes executed across multiple platforms and/or networks; and utilizing monitoring, forecasting, trend analysis, and/or reporting tools. Ensures all work is done in alignment with City and IT long\-term strategies. This class is also responsible for performing related duties as required. Project management duties may include: estimating task duration and complexity; developing work plans and scheduling target completion dates; informing customer and management of project status; coordinating efforts of team members; reviewing adherence to policies and procedures; and reviewing results with and motivating team members. ***Desktop, Help Desk, and Service Desk Assignment:*** Ensures desktop computers interconnect seamlessly with diverse systems including associated authentication systems, file servers, email servers, application servers, and administrative systems. Provides expert technical services in support of installation, configuration, testing, integration, and ongoing support for desktop applications, local desktop printing and peripherals, and mobile devices. Managing inventory of installed software, managing software licensing, and creating policies and procedures for upgrades; and working with hardware and software vendors to verify timely product delivery and ensure desktop and mobile devices are installed and ready to operate. Provides telephone or email support and manages and troubleshoots hardware, software, or network problems that can be resolved at first call, provides tier 2 support, and recognizes and escalates more difficult problems and logs call activity. Develops trends by monitoring and analyzing incoming calls, problems, and support requests. Manages tasks for medium\- to large\-projects, including project plan development and execution. **Qualifications \& Requirements** ---------------------------------- **Employee Values****:** All employees of the City of Mesa are expected to uphold and exhibit the City’s shared employee values of Knowledge, Respect, and Integrity. **Minimum Qualifications Required.**Any combination of training, education, and experience equivalent to graduation from an accredited college or university with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, such as Engineering or Geography***(by assignment)***. Considerable (3 \- 5 years) computer systems experience in at least one of the following technical support areas: Applications, Database, Desktop, GIS, Network, Security, Server, or Web Support. **Special Requirements.** For this position, an individual receiving a conditional offer of employment from the City of Mesa must pass a background investigation through the City of Mesa Police Department, the Arizona Department of Public Safety, and the Federal Bureau of Investigation prior to commencing employment with the City of Mesa ***(by assignment)***. Because of the confidential, sensitive nature of information handled, successful completion of a background investigation is required ***(by assignment)***.Must possess a valid Class D Arizona Driver’s License by hire or promotion date ***(by assignment)***. **Substance Abuse Testing.** Due to the safety and/or security sensitive nature of the assignment, individuals in this classification shall be subject to pre\-employment or pre\-placement alcohol, drug and/or controlled substance testing as outlined in City policy and procedures. **Preferred/Desirable Qualifications.**Good (1 \- 3 years) project or technical leadership experience is highly desirable and may be required ***(by assignment)***. Customer service and teamwork experience is also highly desirable. Supervisory experience may be preferred ***(by assignment)***.

jobs.title: (Construction PM) - Project Manager, Technology Systems
jobs.description: **Project Location: Fairfax, Virginia** This role offers a unique opportunity for career growth within a forward\-thinking and collaborative environment. BICSI, ASIS, CTS, etc. a plus. * 5 \-7 years construction management experience is required. * Prior experience working on large scale, complex, technology systems implementation (in commercial construction) is highly preferred. * Demonstrated experience managing projects successfully from start to finish.Skilled at negotiating and developing relationships with owners and subcontractors. * Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a team; Minimum 2 years supervisory experience. * Strong work ethic, motivated, self\-starter, problem\-solver. * Strong communication skills, written and verbal. * A strong passion for technology systems, construction management, and the industry is essential. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations. **Our High\-Performing Culture:** This is a demanding, high\-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time\-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team. **A Drug Free Workplace:** Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre\-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests. Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short \& long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back\-up daycare, tutoring \& family support benefits, EAP/Work\-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $85,000 \- $150,000\. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. https://www.clarkconstruction.com/careers/clark\-experience

jobs.title: Principal Instrumentation & Controls Engineer — Aragonite Operations
jobs.description: **Principal Instrumentation \& Controls Engineer — Aragonite Operations** ========================================================================= Join us to safeguard people, the environment, and production uptime through resilient automation. In this principal role, you will design, commission, and operate site control systems and process control networks—bringing modern DCS/PLC practices to life across ABB 800xA, Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell, WonderWare, and Canary Historian. **Your mission** ---------------- Reduce trips. Elevate reliability. Make data visible. You’ll lead controls strategy, mentor teams, and harden our infrastructure while ensuring every change is safe, documented, and risk\-assessed. **Core outcomes** ----------------- * Safety leadership—embed safe work practices and compliance in everything you do. * Operational readiness—align the Controls Systems team to meet Aragonite production needs. * Reliability—proactively prevent incidents; implement logic changes under the Clean Harbors MOC process. * Optimization—develop, test, and implement control algorithms; advance Basic Process Control and Process Optimization. * Visibility—define goals, KPIs, and dashboards to monitor control health and performance. * Continuous improvement—renew and evolve DCS platforms;
