jobs.title: Head of IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
jobs.description: Overview LabConnect improves lives by partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies, and clinical research organizations (CROs) to accelerate the development of new medicines around the world. We are an independent, global, one\-stop\-shop focused on delivering Central Laboratory Services that are tailor\-made, timely and flexible to meet the evolving study demands of traditional to increasingly complex trials. Additionally, we provide Functional Service Provider (FSP) Solutions, supporting our clients with scientific and technical expertise, acting as an extension of their team, coordinating all laboratory related needs, advising on strategies for lab data collection and providing end\-to\-end analytical and logistical solutions. LabConnect is seeking a senior leader to establish and mature our IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance function — and to lead the organization in using AI itself as the engine of that compliance. This is a build role for a leader who believes that in a GxP environment, controls should be authored, tested, and enforced continuously by intelligent systems rather than rediscovered during an audit. You will own the strategy and operating model that advances compliance across SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, while deploying AI and agentic tooling to draft and maintain SOPs, detect compliance gaps across our code and configuration, and enforce regulated\-development standards at the point of work. In parallel, you will govern AI adoption responsibly across internal workflows and product development, setting the validation and oversight standards that make AI trustworthy in a healthcare context. **Position Overview:** In this role, you will work closely with teams across infrastructure, security, engineering, data, quality, and operations to make compliance a continuous, largely automated property of how LabConnect builds and operates — not a documentation exercise performed after the fact. You will define the target state for an AI\-enabled GxP control environment and the roadmap to reach it: AI\-assisted authoring and maintenance of SOPs and controlled documents, automated detection of compliance and validation gaps across code, configuration, and infrastructure, agentic development rules that encode regulated\-engineering requirements directly into the tools engineers use every day, and continuous evidence collection that keeps the organization audit\-ready by default. At the same time, you will govern the AI systems themselves — establishing the validation, human\-oversight, transparency, and monitoring standards required for AI to be used safely in clinical research and healthcare — working in partnership with the Quality team that owns CSV and GxP validation. Key Areas of Responsibilities **AI\-Enabled Compliance Operations:** You will lead LabConnect’s shift from periodic, manual compliance work to continuous, AI\-assisted compliance. This includes deploying AI to draft, revise, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and controlled documentation against current regulation and actual practice; keeping the SOP register, change history, and training impact current; and surfacing drift between what our procedures say and what our systems actually do. **Automated Compliance Gap Detection:** You will establish the capability to scan code, configuration, infrastructure\-as\-code, pipelines, and system documentation for compliance and validation gaps — Part 11 controls such as audit trails, electronic signature, access control, and record retention; privacy and PHI handling; and change\-control evidence — surfacing findings continuously to engineering teams rather than at audit time. **Agentic Development Rules and Policy\-as\-Code:** You will define and enforce the guardrails that govern AI\-assisted and agentic software development in a regulated environment: repository\-level rule sets that encode regulated\-engineering requirements into the coding agents themselves, mandatory human review and approval gates, traceability from requirement to code to test evidence, explicit boundaries on autonomous agent action in validated systems, and automated checks that block non\-compliant changes before they merge. **AI Governance and Healthcare AI Compliance:** You will own the governance framework, review process, and risk controls for LabConnect’s AI\-first internal workflows and AI\-enabled product capabilities. This includes acceptable\-use standards, model and vendor oversight, data handling, human\-in\-the\-loop requirements, auditability, validation of AI outputs that carry regulatory or clinical weight, and ongoing monitoring for drift — aligned to HIPAA, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act considerations, and FDA expectations for AI in regulated healthcare settings. **Regulatory Compliance and Continuous Audit Readiness:** You will assess LabConnect’s current controls, documentation, and operating practices across frameworks such as SOC 2, HIP ommunication:** You are comfortable communicating complex risk, compliance, and security topics clearly and credibly to senior leaders, auditors, clients, and cross\-functional stakeholders — including explaining and defending an AI\-enabled approach to compliance to sponsors and regulators. Qualifications \& Experience Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field is required; an advanced degree is a plus. You bring 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience across IT security, risk, compliance, or GRC, including accountability for a regulated control environment, along with a demonstrated track record of building strong teams and leading meaningful transformation. You have led successfully at a senior executive or enterprise leadership level, with accountability for compliance strategy, organizational capability, and audit outcomes in complex environments. You have introduced AI or intelligent automation into compliance, quality, or regulated documentation workflows and carried it through to adoption and auditor acceptance — not just to pilot. You have hands\-on familiarity with modern engineering practice, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, AI\-assisted development, and emerging agentic approaches, sufficient to define enforceable rules for how software is built in validated systems. You have a strong grasp of data architecture and data governance, including relational, unstructured, blob, and vector\-based data models, and the control considerations that follow when that data feeds AI\-enabled solutions. You have significant experience in Microsoft Azure environments, including platforms such as Purview, Entra ID, Defender, Azure Data Lake, and Azure AI services. You have a demonstrated record of audit and inspection success across frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and of partnering with engineering leaders to deliver resilient, compliant, and scalable solutions without stalling delivery. Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, or similarly complex operational environments is strongly preferred. Compensation \& Benefits Competitive base salary aligned to experience Annual incentive opportunity through the company’s bonus plan Comprehensive benefits package Join our team and discover how your work can impact patients' lives around the world! **Some of the Perks our LabConnectors Love:** * Financial Security (Base Pay, 401k Match and Possible Annual Bonus Eligibility) * Health Benefits beginning on date of hire * PTO plan, plus 11 Paid Company Holidays, and 1 Day to Volunteer in your community * Short and Long\-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and AD\&D * We celebrate our differences, which enriches our culture! In addition to great perks and challenging work assignments, we invest in our people with career growth opportunities, globally. We believe in a friendly and collaborative environment with open lines of communication. While living out our values of People First, Quality Focused, Customer Centered, Technology Driven, and Accountability Always. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and value the diversity of our workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. To learn more about equal employment opportunity, please view the posters here: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters LabConnect also prioritizes the privacy and security of your personal data. All candidate information is handled in accordance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). To learn more, please review our Privacy Notice on our website, by navigating to https://www.labconnect.com/ If you need assistance to complete your job application, search for a job opening, or submit an online application at LabConnect, please email talent@labconnect.com or call \+1 (423\) 722\-3155\.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Architecture)
jobs.description: ### **About Lantern** Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Lantern is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our expanding Architecture team. This is a strategic and highly visible role focused on driving architectural consistency, elevating technical standards, and helping scale our cloud\-native healthcare platform to meet the needs of patients, care advocates, and enterprise clients. As a Staff Engineer, you'll partner with cross\-functional teams – including engineering leads, product managers, clinicians, and compliance – to influence the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable systems. You will provide hands\-on technical leadership across the stack while guiding engineering teams through complex architectural decisions, platform evolution, and modernization initiatives. We are looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, can zoom out to evaluate systems holistically, but is not afraid to dive into code to unblock teams or lead by example. If you enjoy solving complex system design problems, mentoring other engineers, and enabling organizational scale through thoughtful architecture, we'd love to hear from you. **Location:** Hybrid \- at least 3 days/wk in our Dallas, TX office **Responsibilities** * Act as a senior architecture contributor and technical leader across key domains, collaborating with multiple pods to deliver cohesive and scalable solutions * Lead modularization and platform decoupling efforts to reduce tech debt, improve maintainability, and empower team\-level ownership * Drive system design and architecture for secure, resilient, and performant services using modern cloud\-native technologies (Azure preferred) * Collaborate with engineering, product, and compliance partners to ensure architectural alignment with business priorities, regulatory constraints, and product roadmaps * Guide and mentor engineers, both formally and informally, on architecture best practices, technical growth, and system\-level thinking * Champion code quality, testability, and design standards, providing deep technical reviews and working examples that elevate engineering excellence * Evaluate frameworks, tools, and integration strategies, including Salesforce and other CRM platforms, to support scale and interoperability * Contribute to and evolve Lantern's internal architecture guidelines, reference implementations, and technical documentation, with an emphasis on innovation, AI integration, and long\-term maintainability * Lead technical discovery and prototyping for complex integrations and data flow challenges, including those involving FHIR, HL7, and Kafka * Influence technical direction and execution of multi\-team projects, ensuring delivery meets high standards of reliability, security, and performance **Requirements \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 3\+ years in a senior, staff, or principal\-level role * Proven track record designing and building distributed systems, APIs, and cloud\-native services using .NET Core (C\#) and modern front\-end frameworks (React or Angular) * Experience with AI/ML services or architectural contributions to innovation\-driven initiatives * Strong experience in domain\-driven design (DDD), microservices, and event\-driven architectures using tools such as Apache Kafka (or similar platforms like RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS), including familiarity with saga patterns * Hands\-on experience architecting solutions on Azure or AWS, including serverless functions, messaging queues, managed databases, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep) * Solid experience with CRM integration design, particularly with Salesforce, and other external systems requiring structured API\-based data exchange and synchronization * Demonstrated ability to lead architectural initiatives that drive improvements in scalability, performance, reliability, and developer experience * Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, DevSecOps, and secrets management best practices * Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills; able to clearly explain complex technical topics to both technical and non\-technical audiences **Nice to Have:** * Experience working in highly regulated industries such as healthcare, financial services, government, insurance, banking, etc. * Experience applying FHIR, HL7, or X12 standards within healthcare systems * Familiarity with cross\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud architectural design patterns **Strong Candidates Will:** * Thrive in ambiguity, comfortable zooming out to evaluate systems holistically while staying hands\-on enough to dive into code and unblock teams * Communicate complex architectural trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Coach and elevate other engineers through code review and design discussions, not just their own output * Balance architectural rigor with engineering velocity and product needs, rather than optimizing for either in isolation * Take ownership at the system level, driving multi\-team initiatives to completion rather than staying within a single service's boundaries **Benefits**: * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Life Insurance * 401k with company match * Flexible Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave **About You:** * You use **LOGIC** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast\-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small \& big wins. * **INCLUSION** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives \& you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with. * You have the **GRIT**, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas. * You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep **HUMANITY** in all decisions. Your customers aren't just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change. * Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the **TRUTH** vs. giving people the answers they want to hear. * You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change. These pillars of **LIGHT** are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this **LIGHT**, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern. Please apply to our role \& someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process. jobs.description: **Full\-time · San Antonio, TX** Leadhub is a full\-service marketing agency focused on growing home service and trades businesses. Most of your work is standing up client sites on that foundation and shaping it to each trade's business, not starting from a blank file. Some of it is improving the theme itself, so the next build goes faster and cleaner. Our clients are trade businesses: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical. You'll also carry a working knowledge of technical SEO and how AI search reads a page, because at Leadhub we believe a site that ranks and a site that's built well are the same. **The Work** * Build client sites on Leadhub's theme, from the designer's file to a live page * Extend and improve the core theme so every site after it benefits * Wire content with ACF so a non\-developer can edit a page without breaking the layout * Reach for Elementor when a page builder fits, hand\-code when it doesn't * Build pages that load fast. Compressed images sized to fit, a short plugin list, and no scripts the page never uses. * Add schema and structured data so pages earn rich results and surface in AI Overviews * Build technical SEO into every site. Semantic HTML, canonical tags, clean URLs, a crawlable structure with no orphan pages. * Manage our automations and integrations for the Leadhub team and clients. Zapier workflows, scripts against client and vendor APIs, small internal tools when nothing off the shelf fits. * Keep forms, tracking, and integrations firing correctly, then confirm they still do * Fix and improve existing client sites without breaking what already works * Own the path from staging to production so nothing ships untested, managing WP Engine environments, Cloudflare, DNS, and site migrations along the way **What Good Looks Like** * Pages pass Core Web Vitals. Actually green, not close enough. * The next developer opens your code and knows what's happening in a minute * The site launches on the date you committed to, tested, no scramble at go\-live * Structured data validates and the client shows up where they should * A change to the shared theme doesn't break the sites already running on it * Multiple client sites in flight, all moving forward on schedule * Forms, tracking, and integrations fire correctly and stay that way **What You Bring** * Three or more years building and delivering WordPress sites, not just editing them * PHP you can write and debug yourself, comfort in the template hierarchy, and ACF as second nature * You can pick up a codebase someone else built and work within it instead of rewriting it * Real work in Elementor or Bricks, and the judgment to know when to skip them * A feel for technical SEO. Schema, site speed, semantic markup, crawlability. * Enough grasp of AI search to build pages that structured data can feed * Automation experience. Zapier or Make, plus scripting against an API in PHP, JavaScript, or Python. * Git, a staging habit, and testing before you push * Real care for the details, because on a trades site a broken form is a lost customer * You finish what you start, and you'd rather do it once, right * Comfortable using an LLM like Claude to write code faster when it earns its place, and ***sharp enough to catch what it gets wrong*** * A portfolio or GitHub we can look at matters more than a degree **Bonus Points** * GA4 and Google Tag Manager setup * Experience with accessibility and remain up to date with web standards * You've handed sites to an SEO or content team and kept them happy * Experience on a support team and communicating with clients on closed tasks or opportunities for improvement * UI/UX experience with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization **What We Offer** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience * Health benefits and 401K * In\-office in San Antonio, working alongside the rest of the team **How We Work** We give you a clear brief and a real deadline, then leave you to build. You'll have several client sites in flight, so you'll move between them, but the work is heads\-down and hands\-on. If you take pride in a clean build and want the room to get it right, you'll like it here. If you'd rather leave things half\-finished and move on, you won't.

jobs.title: Test Technician II
jobs.description: **Legrand** has an exciting opportunity for a **Test Technician II** to join the **Power and Thermal Management Team** in **Canonsburg, PA**. As a member of the Test Engineering team, the Test Technician position will support daily production testing of electromechanical assemblies and the implementation of automated manufacturing technologies through software and hardware systems construction, validation, data collection, operator training, technical support and maintenance. * Maintain, upgrade, repair and troubleshoot production test systems and automated manufacturing technologies (software and hardware). * Validate functionality of software and hardware systems prior to deployment or following updates. * Update LabVIEW application source code under direction and guidance of Test Engineers * Develop training materials and guidance, and provide training support as needed, both internally (all Starline sites) and externally (all global contract manufacturers). * Provide on\-demand technical support through the Production Technology Help Desk + Respond to and troubleshoot all issues + Escalate issues to engineers, as necessary + Ensure all issues are addressed and closed * Maintain test equipment inventory + Maintain test equipment inventory logs + Prepare ready\-to\-deploy spares for critical components + Ensure that the equipment requiring calibration remains current + Handle RMAs for equipment requiring repair * Create technical documentation such as drawings, operations and maintenance manuals, installation instructions and work instructions. * Provide general IT troubleshooting and support for test equipment, printers, computers, and other company devices used in the manufacturing processes at Contract Manufacturers and Starline locations. * Adhere to all company policies, guidelines and practices. * Assembly of test stations, fixtures, probes and other Starline equipment. * Assist Test Engineers, as needed. * Oversee and support outfitting new assembly lines with required test equipment, both internally and externally, on a global scale. * Investigate and correct production test issues that are not identified by the test systems. * Identify opportunities for new technologies and improvements. * Other duties as assigned by management. * Flexible scheduling to support global operations, as necessary. **Education:** * Two\-year technical degree, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or related field. * Minimum 2 years in electrical/electronic testing or other relevant experience. * Understanding of high\-voltage electrical safety practices. * Working knowledge of international test standards as they apply to Starline products (UL/NEC/IEC/CE/CCC). * Ability to develop and read technical assembly drawings, schematics and assembly instructions. * Proficient use of hand tools and power tools. * Proficient knowledge of network and computing equipment. **Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:** * Ability to interface with frontline production team members in a professional manner in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. * Ability to interface and integrate with cross\-functional teams as part of Operational and Engineering projects and processes. * Knowledge of safety standards and the ability to integrate them into processes and test system design. * Working knowledge of IT troubleshooting tools and practices. * Ability to create technical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams and operating instructions/manuals. * Basic understanding of LabVIEW\-based software applications. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills in relation to software development and electronics testing. **Working Conditions/Physical Requirements:** * Primary environment: ambient room temperatures, lighting and traditional office equipment as found in a typical office environment. * The performance of this position may occasionally require exposure to the manufacturing areas where certain tasks require the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and mandatory hearing protection. * Regularly required to stand; walk and communicate with others. * Ability to sit for extended periods of time. * Able to lift and carry up to 25lbs. Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Its comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and datacenter markets makes it a benchmark for customers worldwide. Trusted by the world’s largest hyperscalers, Legrand's Power \& Thermal Management division helps operators manage the critical infrastructure that powers modern data centers. Through a portfolio of best\-in\-class brands spanning power, cooling, connectivity, management, and supporting infrastructure, we enable customers to deploy, operate, and scale high\-density environments. Combining deep domain expertise with a customizable design approach and dedicated support services, we help customers build and operate resilient infrastructure that meets current performance requirements while adapting to future demands. Power \& Thermal Management industry\-leading brands include Approved Networks, Raritan, Server Technology, Starline, Ortronics, Kratos Industries, and ZPE Systems. Legrand, North \& Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short\-term and long\-term disability benefit plans, above\-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company’s incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***\*PLEASE NOTE: this position is located in Denver, CO or Seattle, WA and requires attendance in office up to three days a week.\**** ***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.*** #### **The Opportunity** LendingTree is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Insurance technology team and help build, support, and evolve web applications used by our customers and internal teams. You will work across existing and new capabilities, including applications that integrate with third\-party services, databases, and user\-facing experiences. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, working thoughtfully in established and greenfield codebases, and partnering with the business to turn requirements into reliable, maintainable software. Our team primarily works in C\#/.NET and modern web technologies, but we are open to engineers from other technical backgrounds who bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can learn and ramp quickly. #### **How You'll Make an Impact** * Design, develop, and enhance scalable, highly maintainable web applications that support LendingTree's Insurance business, including solutions that integrate with third\-party web services, databases, and user\-facing interfaces. * Own and support existing applications through troubleshooting, bug fixes, required upgrades, performance improvements, and thoughtful changes to existing functionality. * Break down complex business and technical problems and design solutions that are resilient, robust, and practical to maintain over time. * Translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into well\-designed technical solutions, and demonstrate completed features against agreed\-upon outcomes. * Contribute to strong engineering practices through code reviews, testing, documentation, design discussions, and continuous improvement of the development process. * Collaborate with engineers and business partners on multi\-person initiatives, communicating technical ideas and tradeoffs clearly. #### **Who You'll Work With** You will be part of the technology team supporting LendingTree's Insurance business, working closely with other engineers and business partners to build and enhance applications that support our customers and internal teams. This is a collaborative environment where engineers are expected to understand the business context behind the work, share ideas openly, participate in code review and technical discussions, and help one another solve problems and deliver high\-quality software. #### **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting web applications. * Experience with a modern object\-oriented programming language and web development framework. Our team primarily uses C\# and .NET/ASP.NET, but experience with comparable technologies is welcome if you have strong fundamentals and can ramp quickly. * Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue, or demonstrated ability to learn new frameworks quickly. * Experience building business applications using relational databases such as SQL Server, with familiarity with database design and data access patterns; exposure to NoSQL databases is helpful. * Experience building and integrating with service\-oriented and event\-driven systems, including APIs and third\-party integrations. * Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including maintainable design, SOLID principles, design patterns, code review, and unit testing * .Experience working in an Agile development environment and delivering work against defined requirements and acceptance criteria. * Ability to understand complex business logic and project requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. * Provide leadership by contributing to design decisions, team processes, sharing knowledge, mentoring engineers through feedback and code reviews, and identifying opportunities to raise engineering standards across the team. * Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to design and implement workflows, automation, or other solutions that improve technical processes and/or drive meaningful business outcomes, with the ability to serve as a thought leader and catalyst for AI adoption, innovation, and growth across the organization. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. #### **What Will Help You Thrive** * You are curious and willing to learn new languages, frameworks, technologies, and business domains rather than being tied to one specific stack. * You are comfortable joining an established codebase and use sound judgment when deciding when to improve y, and voice your point of view when you see a better path. * Exposure to cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is helpful. Azure experience, including provisioning, monitoring, performance management, or Application Insights, is a plus. * Knowledge of current web development practices using HTML5, CSS, and TypeScript is helpful. #### **What Success Looks Like** * You quickly build an understanding of the Insurance applications, integrations, and business processes you support and become a dependable owner of that work. * You become productive in the team's technology stack, applying your existing engineering fundamentals while learning unfamiliar tools or frameworks as needed. * New features and enhancements are delivered against clear requirements and acceptance criteria with maintainability, reliability, and testability built in. * Existing applications become easier to support and evolve through thoughtful fixes, upgrades, refactoring, and engineering improvements. * Business partners and teammates can rely on you to communicate clearly, surface tradeoffs early, and collaborate effectively on complex work. * You raise the quality of the engineering environment through strong technical judgment, constructive code review, documentation, and knowledge sharing. **Life at LendingTree** We're a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that's curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You'll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed. We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we're committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You'll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together. And while we work hard, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way. Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what's next. **What We Offer** We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Generous time off * Wellness programs and resources * Annual performance bonus eligibility **The Details** **Base Pay:** 120,000\-160,000 The base pay offered may vary based on internal factors, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Incentive Compensation:** This position is eligible for an annual performance bonus. **Work Authorization:** This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Please do not apply for this role if you will need employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment. **Everyone Belongs Here** LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at humanresources@lendingtree.com. Qualified candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of this position satisfactorily with or without a reasonable accommodation. This job post is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all essential responsibilities, skills, tasks, or requirements associated with this position. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the position posted, LendingTree reserves the right to modify or change the essential functions of the job based on business necessity. CCPA Disclosure

Within AIDA, Data Strategy \& Governance turns priority insurance and retirement use cases into governed, reusable data products and services. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI\-native platform teams, with governance built into the product. In this role, you will build and operate the data and service components behind Lincoln's priority AI\-ready data products. You will use Python and SQL to connect legacy sources, implement transformations and agent\-facing interfaces, encode defined business rules, and make testing, lineage, and provenance part of the build. You will learn from senior engineers and business experts while taking increasing ownership of production work. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * Work with product owners, data owners, stewards, and business experts to define the decisions the product must support, its authoritative sources, common terms, rules, and ownership. * Design the product slice, including models, keys, effective\-date logic, exceptions, data contracts, API and Model Context Protocol contracts, and versioning. jobs.title: VP, IT Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Job Summary: **Job Purpose** The VP, IT Platform Engineering is a senior leadership role within Live Nation's Global IT department, responsible for the enterprise\-wide IT infrastructure engineering including our cloud\-based compute, storage, network, security, and identity and access management capabilities, along with the strategic management of related technology contracts, licensing, and third\-party relationships. Reporting to the SVP, Global IT Operations, this role is a strategic leadership position, accountable for delivering key initiatives critical to improving the quality, reliability and security of our infrastructure engineering function, building new teams and capabilities, and improving the pace of infrastructure delivery. This role is also responsible for the management of a global Identity and Access Management (IAM) team, maturing cloud engineering and cloud application support capabilities, developing network engineering architecture, and driving disciplined, cost\-effective management of the enterprise's technology contracts and vendor ecosystem. This role is ideally based in LA with hybrid work at our offices in Beverly Hills, CA, but remote candidates open to frequent travel will be considered. **Role Description** **Strategic Leadership:** * Develop and implement a comprehensive global IT engineering capability improvement roadmap that aligns with Live Nation's business objectives and incorporates disaster recovery \& business continuity goals. * Collaborate with executive leadership to identify and prioritize technology initiatives that drive growth and efficiency. * Envision and implement AI\-native practices and tools to drive effectiveness and delivery throughput * Implement frameworks and ways of working to ensure regulatory compliance across all technology domains. * Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service\-level agreements (SLAs), and other metrics to track performance. * Own budget management for the function, including forecasting, cost optimization, vendor spend, and capital expenditure planning across security, cloud, and third\-party contracts **IT Security Engineering \& Identity and Access Management (IAM)** * Own the enterprise IT Security Engineering function, setting technical direction, standards, and roadmap for IT security tooling and architecture across the organization. * Lead the global Identity and Access Management (IAM) team, hiring and developing talent, and managing the operating model, processes, and governance for identity, authentication, and access control, in partnership with global Cyber Security team. * Manage the IAM technology stack (e.g., SSO, MFA, privileged access management, identity governance) across the enterprise, ensuring secure, scalable, and audit\-ready access management practices. * Define and implement security engineering processes covering vulnerability management, secure architecture review, threat detection engineering, and security tooling integration. * Partner with Compliance, Risk, Data Privacy and Legal teams to ensure IAM and security engineering practices meet regulatory, audit, and data protection requirements. * Drive continuous improvement of the organization's security posture, working closely with SOC/security operations, engineering, and infrastructure teams to reduce risk and close gaps. **Cloud Engineering** * Lead the Cloud Engineering function, setting architecture standards, governance, and best practices for cloud infrastructure across the enterprise's cloud environments. * Oversee Cloud\-based Third\-Party SaaS Application Implementation, Integration \& Escalated Support, ensuring reliable, secure, and well\-supported operation of business\-critical cloud\-hosted applications, with clear escalation paths and service level accountability. * Drive cloud engineering roadmap decisions including automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, cost optimization (FinOps), scalability, and resilience of cloud platforms. * Ensure security engineering and IAM practices are embedded into cloud engineering design and operations from the outset (secure\-by\-design). * Partner with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to ensure cloud engineering and support practices align with broader enterprise technology strategy. **Enterprise Networking Engineering Architecture** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture and technical standards for the enterprise's global network estate, ensuring consistent, compliant, scalable design across cloud, and office (incl. international venue) locations. * Lead the technical design of network integrations for M\&A activity, ensuring acquired businesses are architected into the global network in line with corporate standards. * Embed security\-by\-design principles (segmentation, Zero Trust, encryption) into all network architecture decisions, partnering closely with Security and Infrastructure teams. * Drive the network technology roadmap, including automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and resilience/capacity planning, to reduce risk and manual effort across global operations. **General Leadership, Governance \& Business Enablement** * Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team across security engineering, IAM, cloud engineering, and vendor/contract management disciplines, with a strong focus on coaching, mentoring, and career development. * Own enterprise\-level contract management for technology agreements, including negotiation support, renewals, terms review, and lifecycle management in partnership with Legal and Procurement. * Own enterprise\-level relationships with strategic third\-party technology vendors and partners, serving as the senior point of contact for escalations, commercial discussions, and roadmap alignment. * Drive efficiency, innovation, and modernization through the adoption of AI and automation across security engineering, cloud operations, and service delivery. **Experience \& Qualifications** **Essential** * Significant senior IT leadership experience, with a demonstrable track record across cloud engineering, security engineering, \& identity and access management. * Prior experience at an equivalent level, leading technical teams within a complex enterprise IT environment. * Proven experience building new teams, processes, and technology capability from the ground up, ideally in an IAM or security engineering context. * Strong background in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and SaaS applications integration, operations and support. * Demonstrated experience managing enterprise\-level technology contracts, software licensing, and vendor/third\-party relationships. * Sound commercial acumen with experience managing sizeable technology budgets and vendor spend. * Deep understanding of IT security, identity governance, and regulatory/compliance requirements (e.g., data protection, cybersecurity frameworks). **Desirable** * Experience working within a de\-centralized IT organization * CISSP, CISM, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent professional certifications. * MBA or equivalent business qualification. * Experience working within a large, publicly listed organization. **Skills \& Personal Attributes** * Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, able to engage credibly from engineers through to C\-suite executives * Strong communicator with the ability to translate complex technical subjects into clear, business\-relevant language. * Hands\-on builder mentality, comfortable standing up new teams, processes, and technology from scratch. * Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities across security, and cloud workstreams simultaneously. * Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build high\-performing, cross\-functional teams. * Commercially minded, with a focus on value delivery, cost discipline, and operational performance. * Resilient and decisive under pressure, particularly during security incidents or critical vendor escalations. * Genuine passion for technology, security, and cloud innovation as enablers of business growth. \- The expected compensation for this position is: $243,000\.00 USD \- $304,000\.00 USD *\*\* Pay is based on a number of factors including market location, qualifications, skills, and experience.* Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

This engineer will collaborate with ML engineers, embedded software developers, and systems teams to deliver production\- ready solutions across Lucid's vehicle platforms. ##### **Responsibilities** * Research, develop, and integrate bird's\-eye\-view (BEV) transformer models for perception tasks. * Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art machine\-learning\-based prediction solutions for production perception systems. * Develop and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests. * Deploy and optimize ML models on embedded platforms. * Write production\-grade C\+\+ code aligned with MISRA/AUTOSAR standards. * Develop and maintain diagnostic pipelines for perception modules. * Debug and resolve static analysis violations and performance bottlenecks. * Collaborate with multi\-disciplinary teams across ML, perception, systems, and safety. ##### **Qualifications** * Strong foundation in software integration, operating systems used in embedded environments, including QNX and Ubuntu, and embedded software development. * Strong theoretical foundation and practical expertise in deep\-learning algorithms for dynamic and static object detection, tracking, and segmentation. * Experience contributing to large, complex production codebases in a collaborative development environment. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. * Minimum of three years of relevant work experience. Candidates considered for a senior\-level position should have additional relevant industry experience or a Ph.D. in a related field. ##### **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree or Ph.D. in engineering, computer science, or a related field. * Deep understanding of deep learning deployment pipelines and GPU inference. * Experience developing BEV transformer models for perception. * Hands\-on experience with embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Drive Orin/Xavier. * Proficiency in Bash scripting for automation and debugging. * Strong familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows. * Develop preventive maintenance and restoration procedures for OSP facilities; * Splice and test fiber optic cable in all types of field environments; * Communicate verbally with construction subcontractors regarding proper procedures for placement of outside cable plant; * Interface with OSP engineers to determine best course of action for repairs; * Install racks and Fiber Distribution Panels (FDPs); * Terminate fiber optic cables; * Read and interpret Method of Procedures (MOPs), OSP drawings, and Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR) traces; * Provide oversight to junior team members; * Manually uncover manhole/handhole using hand tools in all types of field environments; * Conduct reel testing of new fiber optic cables; * Troubleshoot issues relating to fiber plant; jobs.title: BIOPHARMACEUTICAL – Senior Filling/Finish CQV
jobs.description: **Previous Pharmaceutical/Biotech experience is mandatory for this role.** **Relocation packages or travel packages are available for this role** MMR Consulting is an engineering and consulting firm specializing in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. Its services include Engineering, Project Management, and Validation. MMR Consulting has offices in Canada, USA, and Australia. This is an outstanding opportunity to join our growing team, where the successful candidate will work with a group of engineers involved in the design, commissioning \& qualification, start**\-**up and project management of various processes, systems, and facilities. The ideal candidate should possess leadership skills to lead teams of intermediate \& junior engineers. This role is for to work on the filling and packaging operations within a sterile / aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. Tasks may include all or in part, design / re\-design, installation, start\-up / commissioning, qualification as well as operation support for analysis, trouble shooting and / or process improvements of the filling / packaging equipment systems. The ideal candidate should possess technical as well as leadership skills to independently perform or manage resources and activities related to the filling and packaging operations. The work will require working out of client’s facilities, which are **in Portland, Oregon.** **Responsibilities** * Lead or participate in design or operations of packaging pharmaceutical products into their final forms and containers by fill / finish and packaging like, vials, syringes and other delivery systems. * Work with production and packaging groups to create User Requirements Specifications (URS) for ongoing operations or new projects * Collaborate with vendors for packaging machinery, equipment systems, automation controls, materials and consumables, to create Design Specifications (DS) and Functional Specifications (FS) to implement solutions for reducing contamination risks \& process failures * Assess current packaging operations for troubleshooting, efficiencies and continuous improvement opportunities * Spearhead innovations in packaging technologies to support existing client needs * Perform reliability studies on packaging equipment * Perform optimization studies for the optimal use of packaging equipment systems for use in campaigns * Support documentation and/or execution of FAT / SAT / Commissioning, Qualification of packaging systems * Coordinate meetings with cross\-functional departments to drive project progress, facilitate decisions, provide updates to higher management * Other duties as assigned by client, and / or MMR, based on workload and project requirements. * Work may require occasional support over shutdowns or extended hours, specifically during installation and commissioning / validation phases **Qualifications** * College / Bachelors’ Degree or Diploma in Engineering discipline, preferable Mechanical * 8\+ years in GxP environment typically for design or operation of pharmaceutical packaging operations, including sterile / aseptic manufacturing * Previous experience in the pharmaceutical / biotech industry, with knowledge of requirements for a cGMP operations * Possess leadership skills and be able to take initiative to lead projects, involving multiple stakeholders, departments, and varying complexity * Ability to handle multiple projects and work in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to lift 50 pounds * Travel and / or off\-hours work may be required on occasion *As part of our recruitment process, we may use technology\-assisted tools, including AI\-enabled systems, to support application review and candidate evaluation. Hiring decisions are made with human oversight and consideration.* **Equal Employment Opportunity and Reasonable Accommodations** MMR Consulting is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please let us know the nature of your request.

attachments, and related vehicle integration components. * Lead assigned components and subsystems from requirements definition and concept selection through detailed design, validation, production release, and launch. * Create and manage 3D CATIA models, assemblies, 2D drawings, engineering specifications, interface definitions, and design documentation. * Ensure proper vehicle packaging, jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers. Magna Legal Services is seeking a hands\-on Lead Data Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design, development, and ongoing evolution of our enterprise data platform. This role will own the architecture and optimization of scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and our Snowflake data warehouse, establish engineering standards, and guide the delivery of reliable data solutions across the organization. The Lead Data Engineer will partner with technical and business stakeholders, mentor team members, and remain actively involved in implementation as we modernize and scale our data infrastructure. ### **Primary Responsibilities** * Own the technical direction, architecture, and ongoing evolution of our Snowflake data warehouse, with accountability for performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Lead the design, development, and standardization of scalable ETL/ELT pipelines across data sources and destinations, including the continued evolution toward Azure Data Factory. * Establish and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, documentation, version control, deployment, monitoring, and data quality. * Lead the design and development of dimensional data models, including star schemas within a medallion architecture, using tools such as dbt, Sigma, and related technologies. * Partner with technical and business stakeholders to translate data needs into a prioritized technical roadmap and deliver trusted, reusable data solutions that support decision\-making across the company. * Provide technical guidance through solution design and code reviews, mentor data engineers and analysts, and help the team resolve complex technical challenges. * Evaluate and introduce tools, patterns, and process improvements that strengthen scalability, reliability, maintainability, and delivery efficiency. * Lead complex and ad hoc data engineering initiatives from requirements through delivery while promoting data governance, data literacy, and responsible data practices across the organization. ### **Desired Background** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, including ownership of complex initiatives and technical leadership within a modern cloud data environment. * Advanced hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including data warehouse architecture, performance tuning, security and access controls, and cost optimization. * Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with a scripting language such as Python for data processing, automation, and troubleshooting. * Strong experience designing and operating scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, testing, monitoring, and production support. * Hands\-on experience with dimensional data modeling, star schema and medallion architectures, and dbt or a comparable transformation framework. * Experience with Azure Data Factory or a comparable cloud orchestration platform; experience modernizing or migrating legacy data pipelines is preferred. * Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, design and code reviews, engineering standards, and cross\-functional delivery, with strong communication and prioritization skills. *An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue\-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.* *Magna Legal Services provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Mechanical Design Technician
jobs.description: Description: **Position Summary:** Prepare detailed drawings of parts, weldments, and assemblies using SolidWorks according to MSI’s engineering and manufacturing standards. Create and upload Bills of Materials into our ERP software. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent Mechanical Design, CAD, or related technical program graduate to gain hands\-on experience creating drawings used in the manufacturing of custom machinery. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and interested in developing their skills in a hands\-on manufacturing environment. **Key Responsibilities:** * Create, modify, and release detail and assembly drawings using SolidWorks and AutoCAD. * Create and revise drawings based on engineering changes, redlines, and customer specifications. * Convert AutoCAD drawings into SolidWorks models and drawings. * Prepare detailed multi\-view drawings and drawing packages for production. * Maintain and update drawing files. * Review and self\-check drawings for accuracy, completeness, dimensions, fits, and stack\-ups. * Work closely with Designers, Project Managers, Engineers, and shop employees to clarify drawing requirements. * Follow established drawing standards and department procedures. * Manage changing priorities and complete assigned work within required timeframes. Requirements: **Qualifications:** * Associate degree in Mechanical Design or a related field preferred; equivalent education and/or experience will be considered. * Experience creating or modifying technical drawings from written and verbal instructions. * Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and redline changes. * Proficiency in SolidWorks is preferred. * Familiarity with AutoCAD and other design software. * Basic understanding of mechanical design, dimensions, tolerances, and manufacturing processes. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. * Ability to work independently while also collaborating with Engineers, Designers, and shop personnel. * Strong communication and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to learn new information, ask questions, and adapt to changing priorities.

It plays a key role in shaping the future of traffic management and operations through the operation of the MCDOT Traffic Management Center (TMC), optimization and maintenance of traffic signals, and design and deployment of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and development of tools and resources for supporting traffic operations and mobility on the arterial roadway network. Key responsibilities include strategic planning, managing, and directing the Arterial Operations and Traffic Signal Maintenance Programs and the overall Traffic Operations Branch. The position also spearheads the operational focuses of the AZTech partnership and regional ITS initiatives, particularly those funded by USDOT, FHWA, or MAG. This role is ideal for individuals passionate about the intersection of traffic operations and traffic signal maintenance, with a focus on using data\-driven strategies to improve arterial roadway performance, reliability, and mobility. **About Us** We value your time. The time with your family. The time you spend on the road. And the time you spend making a difference. At the Maricopa County Department of Transportation (MCDOT), we provide connections that improve people's lives. By combining innovative technologies with the vast talent of our employees, we plan for future needs and operate a transportation system with the community in mind. Are you interested in contributing to the community in which you work, live, and play? Then, join our team and help us build connections. **Proud to Offer** * Work with a greater purpose * Tuition reimbursement * Exceptional work\-life balance * Opportunities for growth and development within Maricopa County * Low\-cost, high\-value healthcare for you and your qualifying dependents * Child care benefits, including access to the Maricopa County Kids Club , dedicated to serving Maricopa County families * Paid vacation, sick time, and parental leave * Extensive wellness program, including an incentive * Enrollment in the Arizona State Retirement System, a defined retirement benefit requiring an 11\.98% per paycheck contribution rate that includes a 100% employer match on Day 1 Want to learn more about the County’s Qualifying and Compensation Philosophy? Follow this link to learn more! Work With Us \| Maricopa County, AZ * **We Require** * Five years of engineering experience, including three years of experience with Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) and related transportation technologies, and one year of engineering experience in a lead or supervisory capacity * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related engineering discipline, such as, but not limited to, Chemical, Environmental, or Mechanical Engineering * Postgraduate degrees or professional\-level\-related experience may substitute for the education or experience on a year\-for\-year basis **We Also Value** * Experience with telecommunications, computer networking, database management, or systems integration within an Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) or traffic operations environment * Experience in overseeing a Traffic Management Center (TMC), Traffic Operations Center (TOC), or traffic signal maintenance program * Experience with designing, operating, maintaining, or managing the construction of traffic signals * Registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) in Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline * Professional Traffic Operations Engineer (PTOE) certification * Federally funded Project Management experience * Ability to strategically lead a technical team **Job Contributions** * Manage the activities of the ITS Operations Branch, including the Traffic Management Center (TMC) and the Traffic Signal Maintenance groups. Hires, trains, and evaluates staff performance * Oversee large\-scale ITS projects from inception to completion, including regionally significant projects, to ensure seamless arterial operations and efficient mobility * Coordinate budget preparation and manage capital and operational costs, and oversee contracts, purchase orders, and payment approvals * Lead and implement advanced ITS operations strategies, including Integrated Corridor Management (ICM), advanced signal timing systems, and other TSMO strategies, as defined by the AZTech Regional Partnership * Develop inter\-jurisdictional collaboration and partnerships to improve traffic signal system integration and traffic management on regional corridors by having an active role in the technical programming of the AZTech Regional Partnership * Propose ITS and traffic signal infrastructure expansion and operational concept plans to support traffic mobility. Prioritize and assign supporting tasks to the Branch team members. Seek Federal funding opportunities to support innovation and expansion * Other job duties as assigned **Working Conditions** * Exerting 20 \- 25 pounds occasionally, 10 \- 25 pounds frequently, or up to 10 pounds constantly * Position is typically office or administrative work and is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions. Will require occasional travel to/from job locations **Machines, Tools, Equipment, Software, and Hardware** Computer, Bluebeam, Microsoft 365, Adobe Pro, and a cellular phone. **Protective Equipment Required** All PPE will be provided by MCDOT. **Selection Procedure** * Consideration will only be given to candidates who submit online applications * Candidates will be contacted primarily through email and their Workday online application profile * Must pass a pre\-employment background and/or fingerprint investigation as required by statute or policy, including drug and alcohol testing requirements for positions designated as safety\-sensitive Maricopa County is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process or to perform the essential functions of the position under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), please contact MHRFeedback@maricopa.gov to initiate the interactive process.
