jobs.title: Software Engineer (L6) - Compute Runtime
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **About the Compute group:** Netflix’s Compute group owns our internet\-scale cloud footprint. We constantly innovate to increase fleet\-wide agility, efficiency, and reliability of this infrastructure. We build, operate, and maintain Compute services so that Netflix developers can rely on foundational building blocks that enable a “set it and forget it” approach to achieving scalability and cost efficiency. We are responsible for one of the largest Cloud Compute footprints built on AWS, and constantly seeking to push boundaries through innovation to delight hundreds of millions of Netflix users daily. **About the Role:** We are seeking an experienced staff engineer to drive the Compute Runtime team’s charter, guide the team's engineering work, and break new ground through hands\-on innovation on the hardest technical challenges. You will be part of the team of engineers responsible for the runtime portion of our Cloud Compute group. The team is responsible for enabling containers to run on our compute nodes as efficiently and reliably as possible. The team owns the Kubernetes data plane software; the container runtime; the way we download and run containers; and the underlying compute node’s operating system. The team partners with many other teams within Netflix to ensure we stay ahead of the business's needs and enable other teams to innovate on top of our platform. You will be amongst the stunning set of engineers who tackle some of the largest Cloud Compute challenges in the industry. We are moving quickly to support critical business initiatives. You will own key pieces of the Cloud Compute infrastructure and be able to directly trace your work to meaningful business impact, all while working on extremely high\-scale systems only found at a handful of companies. Some examples of the team’s work can be found in tech blogs on “noisy neighbor” detection and mount lock contention . **What you will do:** * Deliver compute platform capabilities and drive adoption across Netflix with a focus on engineering excellence, decisive execution, a spirit of bold experimentation, and tight alignment with business context. * You are an expert in building scalable and extensible compute platforms, and even better at working with other experts. You form strong cross\-functional partnerships driven by trust, embracing a highly aligned and loosely coupled approach with many engineering teams, ensuring our solutions meet their needs while maintaining our focus on agility, scalability, reliability, and efficiency. * Set the example for operational excellence on the team and across Compute, continuously improving incident response, on\-call, and other operational practices. * Maintain currency on, if not create, industry trends for new architectures, features, and off\-the\-shelf services; guide the team’s decision\-making on incorporating industry trends. You recognize industry trends early and stay ahead by developing new architectures, features, and off\-the\-shelf services, while guiding the team's decisions on when and how to adopt them. Identifying trends matters, but you go further: driven by a passion to learn from and contribute to the open\-source world, you keep a pulse on it to shape and forecast the direction of technology. * **Desired Skills \& Experience:** * A proven track record of architecting and implementing large\-scale distributed systems that define and modify infrastructure at 100M\+ user scale. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong relationship\-building ability. * Passion for technology and the ability to jump into an ambiguous area and break down complex problems. * Demonstrated technical leadership to empower the team around you and get the most from diverse stakeholders, including product managers, peer engineers across Netflix, and more. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and how to abstract away its complexities. * Experience with Golang, Java, and/or Python. You have opinions but are also open to strong feedback. * You are able to execute strategically in the short term while thinking long term. * Have the ability to define and self\-manage cross\-functional projects fueled by ambiguous questions. * You take pride in your work, and the work your team delivers, and you always think at a team and business level. You bring an uncomfortably exciting mindset and are comfortable with risk in pursuit of the exceptional. jobs.title: Platform Engineer, AI Observability
jobs.description: **LOCATION: Remote \| Type: Contract** **About Newpage Solutions** Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real\-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human\-centered practices. We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives. **Your Mission** The team runs a shared observability platform for LLM\-based applications, currently built on Langfuse. This role owns it as a product: what capability it offers, how it is configured, and where it goes next. That means deciding which of the platform's features are enabled and why, how organisations, projects and access are structured, and what the defaults are for retention, sampling and redaction. It means judging at each upgrade which new upstream capability is worth adopting, rather than only keeping the version current, and setting that capability up properly when it lands so it is genuinely usable rather than merely switched on. It also means looking ahead: assessing additional or replacement backends as the estate grows and requirements change, running the spikes, and making a recommendation with evidence behind it. Keeping the platform running is a separate role. This one is judged on what the platform can do for the teams using it, and on whether the configuration decisions behind it still look right a year later. It is a hands\-on technical role. The person is expected to configure, test and evaluate the platform themselves, and to arrive at a view rather than collect requirements and pass them on. **What You’ll Do** **Own what the platform offers.** * Decide which features are enabled, for whom, and why, and keep that decision under review as the platform and its users change. * Own the tenancy model: how organisations, projects and environments are structured, how access maps onto existing teams, and what the naming and ownership conventions are. * Set the defaults that shape the data, including retention, sampling, payload trimming and redaction, balancing what is useful to keep against what should never be stored. * Define what the platform exposes to the systems around it, so the integrations built against it have a stable and deliberate surface. **Keep the capability current.** * Track upstream releases and decide what is worth adopting, distinguishing genuinely useful capability from noise * Configure and test new capability before it is offered to teams, including piloting it with a willing team where the change is significant. * Retire configuration and features that are not earning their place. * Work with the reliability engineer on upgrades: this role decides what to adopt and how it should be configured, while execution of the migration and its rollback sits with them. **Look ahead.** * Assess additional or replacement backends as requirements grow. Langfuse is the current backend and the assumption is that it stays, but the role is expected to know where it falls short and what else the market offers, whether for telemetry storage, metrics or evaluation. * Run the spikes and proofs of concept, define the criteria in advance, and make recommendations that show the working rather than the conclusion alone. * Understand the cost and scaling consequences of configuration and architecture choices, and make them explicit when recommending a change. * Document what the platform offers and when to use what, so teams can serve themselves rather than asking. **What You Bring** * Hands\-on ownership of an observability or developer\-tooling product, as the person who configured and administered it rather than a user of it. Langfuse is ideal, another LLM observability product is close behind, and a comparable APM, tracing or analytics platform is acceptable. * Configuration and administration of self\-hosted software at organisation scale, covering tenancy, rolebased access, retention and data lifecycle. * A working grasp of telemetry data models, including traces, spans, attributes and sampling, and OpenTelemetry conventions, sufficient to reason about what the platform is storing and why. * Familiarity with LLM application architecture, including prompts, retrieval, tool calling, agents and evaluation, sufficient to judge which capability is worth enabling and what the resulting data is good for. * Technology evaluation. A track record of assessing options against criteria set in advance, running a proof of concept, and writing a recommendation that a decision\-maker could act on. * Data governance judgement. Retention, redaction, personal data and access control, and the ability to hold a position on what should not be captured. * Enough Kubernetes, Helm and GitOps literacy to make configuration changes through the delivery pipeline rather than by hand, and to discuss changes credibly with the engineers who run the platform. * Working directly with engineering teams to understand what they need, then making a decision and explaining it, including to the teams who wanted something else. * Clear written communication, since the output includes configuration standards, guidance and recommendations that others rely on without the author present. * Nice to have Experience administering a self\-hosted Langfuse deployment, or LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Braintrust at a comparable level. * Nice to have OpenTelemetry collector configuration, including pipelines, processors and exporters. * Nice to have SQL and comfort querying an analytical store directly to understand platform usage. * Nice to have Experience owning a platform through a vendor or backend migration. **What We Offer** At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer: * A people\-first culture \- Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging * Smart, purposeful collaboration \- Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges * Balance that lasts \- We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life * Room to grow \- Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you * Meaningful rewards \- Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential **Ready to Apply?** Let’s build the future of health together. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. **So, what's the role all about?** * You'll architect and deliver production\-ready conversational AI agents that sit at the core of the business and directly fuel company growth. * These are live, scalable agentic AI systems, not experiments or proof\-of\-concepts, operating across sectors like financial services, healthcare, and commerce. * You'll have full ownership of the entire AI agent lifecycle, steering projects from early pilot through launch and ongoing refinement. * You'll collaborate directly with decision\-makers at the world’s leading enterprises to tackle their highest\-priority challenges with agentic AI. * The patterns and problems you encounter in the field will feed directly into the evolution of the platform, tools, and product roadmap. **How will you make an impact?** * Develop agentic systems (agents) for large\-scale companies that measurably outperform human operators in areas like retention and churn reduction. * Build agents that handle nuanced, integrated customer interactions, across a range of CX transforming use cases. * Design reusable agent frameworks adapted to the specific demands of di erent industries. * Drive design partnerships around new product directions, including agent architectures, self\-service features, and generative development workflows. * Push the boundaries with emerging voice models and pioneer their integration into enterprise\-grade deployments. * Set the standard for how AI agents are constructed, evaluated, and improved in live production settings. **Have you got what it takes?** Education \& Background * Hands\-on experience building and operating end\-to\-end production systems at scale. * With a natural builder's mentality with high personal agency, you default to finding solutions and shipping them. * Startup founder or early engineer experience is highly valued, you understand the tradeo s between speed, quality, and ownership. AI \& Technology Expertise * Proven technical problem\-solving ability, particularly in rapidly shifting, loosely defined environments. * Experience developing or operating AI/LLM\-powered systems in production is a major plus. * Working knowledge of the current AI agent toolkit: evaluation frameworks, orchestration tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering. * Familiarity with React, TypeScript, and/or Go is an advantage. CX \& Industry Knowledge * At ease working face\-to\-face with customers to unpack their problems and deliver practical solutions. * Prior experience in customer\-facing or externally\-led technical roles is a plus. Strategic \& Communication Skills * A clear, direct communicator who can be equally persuasive with engineers and executives. * Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making forward progress without waiting for complete clarity. * Able to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across technical and business teams. **What's in it for you?** * Build AI agents that run in production at meaningful scale, not slideware or research exercises. * Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with leaders at globally recognized enterprises and high growth startups. * Directly influence the direction of NiCE's AI agent platform through the real problems you solve. * Operate with genuine autonomy and end\-to\-end ownership across the agent lifecycle. * Work at the cutting edge of AI agent development with access to the latest models, infrastructure, and research. **Requisition ID:** 11747 **Reporting into:** Manager **Role Type:** Individual Contributor ***About NiCE*** *NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.* *Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.* *NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

This is a senior level role that is frontend focused, but requires a breadth of knowledge and a general level of comfort with backend tools like git, AWS, shell operations, hosting solutions, database development with SQL/ORM, Docker, and others. The candidate should have an understanding of the software development lifecycle as a whole, and experience using the Atlassian tool set to build software as part of a team. **Reasonable Accommodations Statement** To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Essential Function Statements** * Write organized, testable, and efficient frontend code, with inline documentation * Engage in UX planning to translate the user journey into an effective mobile\-first UI that adheres to brand standards * Participate in code reviews and the QA feedback cycle * Generate documentation as part of the deliverable * Work within an Agile/Scrum methodology using the Atlassian suite of tools * Help evaluate and adopt emergent frontend technologies * Work with a hybrid team with members both on\-site and distributed across North America * Work on full\-stack tasks as needed **What We Look For** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong expertise in React and Next.js **(required)** * Expert\-level abilities in Javascript/Typescript * Expert\-level abilities in HTML/CSS and the associated FE build tools like SASS/LESS, Vite, Webpack, etc * Deep experience with ReactJS and React\-based frameworks like Next, Remix, Fastify, and and an understanding of rebasing and branching strategies * Advance understanding of the principles driving CI/CD * Ability to think through and architect systems, then execute on building them end\-to\-end * Advance understanding of authentication using OAuth providers like Auth0, and cybersecurity principles in general * Basic experience with unit testing, functional testing, and following company procedures. * Enthusiastic \- Ability to bring energy to the performance of a task. * Self Motivated \- Ability to be internally inspired to perform a task to the best of one's jobs.title: Tier II Service Desk Specialist
jobs.description: **We’re going places, hop on board.** **Our value is in our employees – smart, passionate, and fun people.** We are going places, hop on board. Our value is in our employees – smart, passionate, and fun people. Grow with us! As a growing business, every NuAxis Innovations employee impacts the success and direction of this company. We all share a true passion for technology and enjoy working together to develop solutions, share ideas, and exchange knowledge. At NuAxis Innovations, we celebrate diversity and the unique perspective each team member brings to his/her job, team, and community. We are currently seeking a talented and motivated **Tier II Service Desk Specialist** for a Full\-Time position in Denver CO. **Job Summary:** The Tier II Service Desk Specialist must possess and apply expertise on multiple complex work assignments. Assignments may be broad in nature, requiring originality and innovation in determining how to accomplish tasks. The Tier II Service Desk Specialist is required to meet contract Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident Response, Update, Handoff, and Resolution times. The Service Desk Specialist must follow published Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Knowledge Base Articles (KBAs), but may also be called to perform additional activities, developing methodology and presenting solutions to problems. Must contribute to deliverables and performance metrics where applicable. **Essential Functions:** * Responds to and diagnoses problems through discussion with users and hands\-on assistance. * Provides on\-site support to end\-users on a variety of issues. * During remote support periods, receive customer calls, emails, and self\-generated tickets to initiate tickets, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and requests. * Identifies, researches, and resolves technical problems. * Responds to tickets assigned by Tier 1\. * Ensures all assigned tickets are updated and moving towards a successful resolution in a manner that meets or exceeds SLAs. * Documents, tracks, and monitors tickets to ensure a timely resolution. * Provides second\-tier support to users’ applications or hardware issues. * Interacts with network services, software systems engineering, and/or applications development to restore service and/or identify and correct core problems. * Simulates or recreates user problems to resolve operating difficulties. * Recommends systems modifications to reduce user problems. * Performs Moves, Adds, and Changes (MAC) **Support\-Incident Management:** Provide impact\- and priority\-based Incident categorization in order to track the progress of all incidents and restore degraded or disrupted services as quickly as possible: * Escalate tickets based on expertise and appropriate group membership * Answer customer telephone calls and emails to the SD in accordance with the applicable SLAs during Normal Working Hours * Monitor voicemails and emails left for the SD * Log Incidents and Service Requests into the ITSM. * Ensure that all Incidents are promptly and accurately documented in ITSM so that up\-to\-date information is available at all times. Track Incident from the first report to remediation * Perform initial diagnosis and analysis of Incidents and provide immediate resolution and recovery if possible. * Use remote control tools to assist and resolve customer Incidents as initial resolution, providing warm handoff escalation of Incidents that cannot be immediately resolved * Escalate tickets as required by the applicable Service Level Agreements (SLAs) * Communicate system outages in accordance with established standardized operating procedures (SOP) to appropriate government points of contact and Users using government\-provided tools and communication methods and continue ongoing communications until the Incident has been resolved and all services have been restored * Follow\-up on resolved Incidents to check the quality, get customer concurrence of incident closure, and report customer satisfaction * Work with Operational and other teams to ensure final summary, review. analysis, resolution, and lessons learned are documented in Incident Reports for all major Incidents and unplanned service outages and submitted in writing to government management * Establish (or update existing ones) and maintain data in the Known Error Database (KEDB); document workarounds and generate known to error sub\-processes to facilitate quicker diagnosis and resolution for future Incidents * Proactively monitor Automated Call Distribution (ACD) calls, Incidents, and Service Request workflows, processes, and queues to immediately identify and address performance issues that will impact the delivery of services to Users * Ensure non\-IT requests are properly routed to appropriate support organizations. **Ticket Updates:** Update or ensure that all tickets are updated in a manner that meets the applicable SLAs: * Update tickets by adding work log information as required by the applicable SLAs * Monitor status of all open tickets and escalate as required * Coordinate resolution with other internal and external teams, as appropriate * Check the assigned tickets queue on regular basis throughout the NWH * Provide advice and guidance to the Users regarding restoration of interrupted service * Verify ticket resolution with the User * Provide advice and guidance to Users regarding restoration of interrupted service **Ticket Closure:** No ticket can be closed without concurrence from the User that the ticket has, in fact, been fully resolved and that the service has been restored. When an issue is resolved, change the status of the ticket to "Resolved". Follow up periodically to verify the service meets client expectations; close when completed. **Incident Handling and Management:** Assume responsibility for resolving Incidents in a manner that meets or exceeds the applicable SLAs and OLAs. Escalate and/or seek assistance if other support teams are not being responsive to requests for assistance. Maintain the status of all open tickets in a manner that meets the SLAs and OLAs. **Problem Handling and Management:** Continuously review Incident data as well as other sources of information to identify trends that may lead to the discovery of a common cause of incoming incidents. When such a cause is determined, create a Problem ticket and link all related Incident tickets to it. Upon resolution of the Problem ticket, update all related Incident tickets. **Education/Certification:** The ability to obtain at least one (1\) of the following: CompTIA A\+ Certification Microsoft IT Support Specialist Professional Certificate Certification in ITIL v4 Foundations Help Desk Institute's Desktop Advanced Support Technician certification **Knowledge Requirements:** Must have experience using industry standard ticketing systems such as BMC Helix Remedy and ServiceNow. Must have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11 Operating System. Experience with Apple MAC laptops is a plus. **Experience:** At least 2 years of current experience in participating in a desk\-side support environment. College degrees or certifications can be substituted for experience. **Does this opportunity sound like a fit for you? If so, join our talent community and click to apply now!!** **Our Profile:** NuAxis is an IT Services firm providing innovative solutions to the U.S. Federal Government using state\-of\-the\-art technologies, architectures, and life cycle management. We are a Certified Microsoft Partner with extensive Microsoft technologies experience. Our services portfolio includes Project Management, Application Development, Infrastructure Management, and Security Management. We offer competitive salaries, an attractive benefits package, and the opportunity to learn from experts. High technology small business with long\-standing U.S. Federal Government experience \* Visionary executive leadership \* Expert professional services team comprises highly skilled engineers and software developers \* Rapid growth over the last several years. *NuAxis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer including Vets and Disabled. Employment contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation* At NuAxis Innovations, we are committed to a comprehensive employee benefits program that helps our employees stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain a healthy work/life balance. NuAxis Innovations benefits include medical, dental, vision, spending accounts, disability, basic and supplemental life insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and additional voluntary benefits. More specific information on benefits eligibility will be provided as part of the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Client Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE COMPANY:** OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on: trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond. We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real\-time operational intelligence to strategic decision\-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. And we're embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, pairing decades of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that weren't possible before. Travel moves the world, and we move travel. For more information visit www.oag.com **ABOUT THE ROLE:** The Senior Client Solutions Engineer leads OAG's global developer relations capability and is the technical and solutions bridge between OAG and its most commercially significant accounts worldwide. Reporting to a Regional Sales Director, you will lead technical discovery, run proof\-of\-concept workstreams, own the technical path through complex integrations and build credibility with demanding technical buyers. You will also define and own the structured feedback loop from the field to the product organisation, shaping OAG's API and data integration roadmap, and act as the primary technical authority across OAG for API architecture, data integration and the developer ecosystem. This is a technically demanding role that requires genuine depth across technical, commercial and product disciplines. **WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:** * Lead technical discovery and qualification on enterprise opportunities worldwide, matching OAG capability to the customer's problem and handling technical objections when a buyer's engineering or data team gets involved. * Design and lead proof\-of\-concept workstreams end to end, from scoping through to presenting results in commercial terms, and stay engaged through implementation on complex deals. * Own API and integration consultation, including architecture review, data pipeline scoping and technical risk identification. * Act as the primary technical authority across OAG for API architecture, data integration and the developer ecosystem, advising product and engineering on customer\-driven technical direction. * Run OAG Intelligence Platform proofs of concept with early adopter customers, building the technical proof points the wider commercial team can use and feeding back on readiness ahead of broad commercial release. * Define and own the structured feedback loop from the field to the product organisation, working with the Head of Digital Product and the Head of Data Products to translate field intelligence into roadmap decisions. * Identify and facilitate customer developer partnerships, prototyping solutions to specific commercial problems and remaining the field\-side point of accountability. * Support commercial teams at key moments in the deal cycle: briefing on technical market signals, creating replicable plays from every engagement, and coaching colleagues on technical topics where it materially improves customer conversations. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:** * Demonstrable track record of technical pre\-sales or solutions work at enterprise level in a data, analytics, or SaaS business, with direct involvement in deals from first technical qualification through to contract. * Hands\-on fluency with data APIs, integration architecture, and data pipeline design. Able to review an integration proposal, identify weaknesses, and redirect without needing to involve a delivery engineer. * Experience leading proof\-of\-concept workstreams independently: scoping, executing, and presenting results to both technical and commercial stakeholders. * Genuine credibility with senior technical buyers. Not experience presenting to senior buyers — the ability to hold a conversation at CTO or engineering lead level that the buyer finds substantive and specific to their context. * Some experience working alongside a product organisation: contributing to roadmap discussions, translating customer signals into structured input, or understanding how product decisions get made. * Strong commercial instinct. Understands the difference between a customer who is genuinely bought in and one who is managing you. Knows when a technical conversation is the deal and when it is a delay. **IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:** * Forward\-deployed engineering or developer relations experience. * Experience with AI\-enabled data products or intelligence platforms. If you don't meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you. **WE WILL OFFER YOU:** You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day\-to\-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility. Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust. Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance 401k administered by vitality. Medical, dental and vision insurance. ️ 22 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys The salary range for this role is $131,000 to $198,000 per annum plus bonus OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

:** Sept 2026 * **Scope :** NAO Region. **Responsibilities :** * The Quality Program Engineer (QPE) is responsible for coordinating project quality related tasks * Act as the quality representative as jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Location (Short): Houston, Texas\-USA \| Madison, Alabama\-USA \| New York \- Home Office, New York\-USA Workplace Type: Remote Req Id: 3346 **Responsibilities** -------------------- The Data Engineer owns the reliable flow of data from Hexagon's source products into the Octave platform's Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. This role is responsible for building and operating the connectors, pipelines, and staging infrastructure that ensure every downstream capability — from ontological transformation to knowledge graph construction — has high\-quality, timely, and trustworthy data to work with. The Data Engineer is the first and most critical link in the platform's data supply chain. * Design, build, and operate data integration pipelines connecting Hexagon source products (Sequence/EcoSys, Loop/Smart Materials, Forte 3D, Attune/EAM) to the Fabric lakehouse * Implement and maintain database mirroring configurations for SQL Server and Oracle source systems, ensuring near\-real\-time replication with schema change detection * Configure and operate Databridge Pro (DBPro) as a middleware integration layer where direct mirroring is not viable — API adapters, event streams, and scheduled extracts * Enforce the staging discipline: land data in its original form in the lakehouse Bronze layer before any transformation, minimizing logic in extractors and enabling replay * Build and maintain the change\-data\-capture (CDC) infrastructure to track record\-level changes over time — a prerequisite for temporal queries and the Delivery Genome * Own pipeline observability: monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and data quality checks at ingestion time * Collaborate with the Graph Engineer on schema understanding to ensure ingested data maps cleanly to ontological transformation requirements * Work with the Governance function to implement data classification, access controls, and audit\-ready lineage at the pipeline level * Contribute to the no\-code pipeline capability within Platform Studio's data engineering tool, informing what connectors and patterns should be productized **Education / Qualifications** ------------------------------ * 7\+ years in data engineering, with hands\-on production experience building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines at scale * Strong proficiency with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse Analytics — Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, and Spark\-based transformation * Experience with database mirroring or CDC for SQL Server (e.g. Fabric Database Mirroring, Debezium, SQL Server replication) and Oracle * Hands\-on experience with REST API integration and OData/OpenAPI\-based data extraction * Solid understanding of medallion/lakehouse architecture patterns (Bronze/Silver/Gold or equivalent staging discipline) * Experience with pipeline orchestration tools (Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Workflows, Airflow, or comparable) * Proficiency in Python and/or PySpark for transformation logic and notebook\-based ETL * Strong data quality mindset — schema validation, null handling, deduplication, and monitoring at ingestion * Familiarity with enterprise authentication patterns (OAuth2 client credentials, service principals, managed identities) #### **Preferred:** * Experience with Databridge Pro or comparable industrial middleware integration products * Background in capital projects, EPC, or industrial enterprise software data models * Exposure to knowledge graph construction pipelines downstream of lakehouse staging **About Octave** ---------------- Octave provides mission\-critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle \- Design, Build, Operate and Protect \- where performance, safety, and reliability are non\-negotiable and failure is not an option. Turning complex operational data into actionable intelligence, Octave connects expertise, real\-world conditions and enterprise\-scale insight to improve performance, resilience and incident response where it matters most. Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn. **Why work for Octave?** ------------------------ All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. And it's why we're committed to creating an environment that's truly supportive, providing you with the resources you need to support your ambitions, no matter who you are or where you are in the world. **Everyone is welcome** ----------------------- At Octave, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Here, everyone is welcome. As an inclusive workplace, we don't discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all. Respect is the cornerstone of how we operate, so speak up and be yourself. You're valued here. ### **Recruitment Fraud Alert** Octave posts all official job opportunities on either https://careers.octave.com/ or https://www.octave.com/about/careers and communicates only from email addresses ending in @octave.com. We never request payment or personal banking information during recruitment. No offers will ever be extended without a proper interview via Teams or in person, never done over email alone. If you suspect fraud, it probably is, and contact us at careers@octave.com

jobs.title: Plant Manager
jobs.description: Job ID: 529242 Exempt Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies. Oldcastle Infrastructure \- Built For Life from Oldcastle Infrastructure on Vimeo. **Job Summary** The Plant Manager is the senior leader on site and is responsible for everything that goes on inside the fence\-line and is the driver of the production process. We look to the Plant Manager to build a collaborative environment between operations, sales, engineering, accounting, and transportation. This dynamic leader will be pushing continuous improvement in workplace safety, production efficiency, product cost, and customer service. **Job Location** * This role will be on site at our facility in Redding, CA. **Job Responsibilities** * Ensure the plant employees and guests on site comply with safety and environmental practices – lead by example and build a safety first culture * Lead production scheduling to meet customer needs including timely delivery * Develop a keen focus on customer service and proactive communication across the team * Partner with the engineering team to ensure proper drawings and designs are being used during the manufacturing process * Purchase material/services to successfully operate the facility * Successfully hire, supervise, orient, train and retain operations/product staff * Promote and maintain a clean workplace that is “tour\-ready” at all times * Ability to read drawings, plan production tasks from those drawings, and coach employees to produce product correctly * Ability to operate some of the standard tools on the plant floor such as overhead cranes, hand tools, batch plant, etc. While the Plant Manager will not be asked to operate these things continuously, having some of these skills will make him/her a better coach and troubleshooter * Be a leader and coach leadership. Motivate crews during morning huddles. Lead effective Mid\-Day meetings. Coach Leads on how to set expectations on a whiteboard and have them followed. Lead inventory counts. Promote safety best practices in meetings with other Plant Managers * Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager as deemed appropriate and necessary by them **Job Requirements** * Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Engineering or equivalent experience * 10\+ years of experience working in a leadership role in an industrial manufacturing environment * Experience with precast/concrete or building materials is a plus * Proven track record of developing, leading and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset at the plant * Ability to work on your feet for the majority of the day in a production/plant environment subject to areas that are unheated and/or non\-air conditioned * Ability to work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, AX) * Ability to lead and direct other individuals and work with other group leaders **Compensation** * Yearly target salary is $120,000\.00\-130,000\.00 * Yearly bonus eligible * 401(k) plan / group retirement savings program * Short\-term and long\-term disability benefits * Life insurance * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * Paid holidays **What CRH Offers You** * Highly competitive base pay * Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs * Group retirement savings program * Health and wellness programs * An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion **About CRH** CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization. If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest! Oldcastle Infrastructure, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. EOE/Vet/Disability CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Manager, Commercial
jobs.description: **About Omnidian** Omnidian, Inc. is a fast\-growing Series C tech\-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. *We are a certified B Corps, headquartered in Seattle, WA* **The Job** As a Technical Operations Manager, you'll play a vital role in ensuring optimal performance for a distributed portfolio of solar PV and energy storage assets. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for assigned clients, working closely with Portfolio Managers and the broader Commercial Operations Team. We’re looking for commercial technicians and installers who also love working with clients and partners. From asset onboarding to performance management and reporting, you'll directly contribute to delivering exceptional client experiences while supporting operational excellence and innovation in clean energy. ### **What You'll Do** At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing: **Technical Expertise and Client Engagement (60%)** * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned clients in a portfolio of about 250\-350 MW of distributed solar assets * Review service visit reports before they are presented to clients and participate in weekly client check\-in calls to provide on\-the\-spot technical expertise * Cultivate strong relationships with clients, field service partners, internal team members, and other asset stakeholders **Operational Support and Field Coordination (20%)** * Investigate issues using site monitoring platforms, and initiate activities to improve asset performance. * Create, manage, and oversee tickets for planned and unplanned service activities. * Coordinate and manage service activities with field service partners. * Support onsite service technicians during service work and check\-out calls. * Collaborate with external engineering firms for retrofits, repowering, and redesigns. **Battery Storage and Continuous Improvement (20%)** * Own the technical aspect of our Commercial BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) program, including sales support, pricing proposals, scope development, contract review, and operational implementation * Contribute to the development and updates of Omnidian’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and QA/QC program * Participate in initiatives supporting sales and product development. ### **Who You Are** * You thrive at managing multiple priorities and making independent decisions. * You exercise sound judgment and escalate issues appropriately. * You are highly organized, process\-driven, and detail\-oriented. * You embrace learning new skills and adapting to evolving business needs. * You excel in high\-pressure situations and can de\-escalate tensions effectively. * You communicate clearly and professionally in both written and verbal forms. ### **Experience You'll Need** * Typically 3\+ yrs of hands\-on experience as a solar technician, installer, OEM field service engineer, or similar role, with at least 2 of those years in Commercial Solar * Hands\-on experience should include 1000V\+ DC systems, 3\-phase AC interconnections, and advanced system diagnostics for projects exceeding 500kW * Typically 4\+ years of professional experience in the solar energy industry, or equivalent demonstrated scope, showcasing a history of leadership in account management, asset management, operations and maintenance, or field service coordination. * Familiarity with energy storage technologies * Experience with solar monitoring DAS platforms and interpreting system design drawings. * Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), G Suite (Gmail, jobs.title: Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: OneOncology is positioning community oncologists to drive the future of medical care through a patient\-centric, physician\-driven, and technology\-powered model to help improve the lives of everyone living with cancer and other diseases. Our team is bringing together leaders to the market place to help drive OneOncology’s mission and vision. Why join us? This is an exciting time to join OneOncology. Our values\-driven culture reflects our startup enthusiasm supported by industry leaders in oncology, urology, technology, and finance. We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to improve and build new processes that support the meaningful work of independent physicians and the patients they serve. **Job Description:** Reporting to the Manager, Software \& AI Engineering, the **Platform Software Engineer** builds, operates, and enhances the Microsoft Azure foundation that supports OneOncology’s engineering teams and applications. This role is also responsible for the technical controls that support OneOncology’s HITRUST CSF certification, with a focus on automating infrastructure, strengthening a HIPAA\-regulated environment, and creating continuous, efficient processes for compliance evidence collection. This is a hands\-on role with a high degree of autonomy on a small engineering team. The Platform Software Engineer will contribute to both technical design and implementation and will take ownership of solutions from end to end—from developing and maintaining Terraform modules to supporting technical controls, compliance requirements, and audit responses. This is a full\-time remote position within the United States. Employees located in the Nashville, TN area have the option to work from the Nashville office. **Responsibilities:** * Design, provision, and operate Azure infrastructure—including App Service, AKS, Functions, networking, storage, and databases—using Terraform or Bicep with disciplined module design, state management, and peer review. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for secure, repeatable infrastructure and application deployments with appropriate change management. * Automate routine operational tasks and workflows using PowerShell, Bash, or Python. * Own the platform and infrastructure controls that support OneOncology’s HITRUST CSF certification, partnering with Security and Compliance on scoping, readiness, remediation, and assessment. * Build and maintain secure configuration baselines, reusable infrastructure modules, and automated control monitoring and evidence collection using tools such as Azure Policy and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Extend controls and tooling to newly acquired practices and environments as OneOncology grows. * Administer identity and access controls through Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management, Conditional Access, and MFA, including access reviews and enforcement of least\-privilege and segregation\-of\-duties principles. * Manage secrets, certificates, and encryption keys in Azure Key Vault, including rotation and lifecycle management. * Maintain centralized logging, monitoring, detections, alerts, and dashboards using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Sentinel, with appropriate audit retention and immutability requirements. Participate in incident response and the on\-call rotation. * Run authenticated vulnerability scanning and drive risk\-based remediation within agreed SLAs. * Manage patching across cloud and server workloads with minimal disruption. * Maintain backup and disaster recovery capabilities and test recovery against defined RTO and RPO targets. * Develop self\-service tooling, templates, runbooks, and documentation that enable application engineers to move quickly within established security and compliance guardrails * Additional responsibilities as assigned to help drive our mission of improving the lives of everyone living with cancer. **Qualifications:** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * High school diploma or GED. * 5\+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, cloud, or site reliability engineering. * 3\+ years of hands\-on Microsoft Azure experience across compute, networking, identity, storage, and monitoring. * Demonstrated experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates), including module design and state management. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python. * Working knowledge of at least one healthcare or security compliance framework — HITRUST CSF, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, or NIST — and practical experience enforcing those controls in a cloud environment. * Comfort operating autonomously on a small team and owning problems end to end. **Preferred** * Direct experience supporting a HITRUST CSF validated assessment (e1, i1, or r2\) or an equivalent audit, including evidence preparation. * Experience in healthcare technology or another HIPAA\-regulated environment. * Kubernetes / AKS and container security experience. * SIEM experience (Microsoft Sentinel) and familiarity with compliance automation tooling such as MyCSF, Vanta, or Drata. * Certifications such as AZ\-104, AZ\-400, AZ\-500, CKA/CKS, CISSP, or HITRUST CCSFP. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools and how to adopt them safely in a regulated environment. **Essential Competencies:** * Autonomy and ownership — able to take an ambiguous problem from design through production with limited oversight. * Architectural judgment — designs systems, not just features, and can explain the tradeoffs behind a decision. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical partners. * Generalist range and comfort operating on a small, fast\-moving engineering team. * Sound handling of protected health information and a security\-first mindset. * Attendance is an essential job function.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - AI Governance
jobs.description: ### **Strength in Trust** OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. ### **The Challenge** As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader for OneTrust's AI Governance (AIG) platform, driving the design, scalability, and reliability of systems that enable enterprises to deploy and govern AI and LLM\-powered applications responsibly. You will deeply understand how customers build, deploy, and operate AI systems, and translate those needs into secure, compliant, and observable platform capabilities. ### **Your Mission** **Development** * Lead the design and development of Java/Python microservices and shared libraries integrating with AI platforms for OneTrust's AI Governance product. * Design, build, and test cloud\-native applications deployed on Microsoft Azure using Core Java, REST, and the Spring ecosystem. * Lead the architecture and development of reusable AIG reporting and dashboard capabilities that integrate governance data from SQL databases and analytical platforms with runtime observability signals. * Design reusable semantic\-layer and metric\-abstraction capabilities, including dataset contracts, metric definitions, query APIs, pre\-aggregation, caching, filtering, time\-period selection, and drill\-down workflows. * Lead event\-driven integrations using Kafka and Apache Flink to consume normalized observability events and produce dashboard\-ready datasets and derived metrics. * Integrate with the AI Observability platform through well\-defined APIs and data contracts for runtime metrics, logs, traces, alerts, policy decisions, and evidence. * Own technical design for critical systems, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability. * Partner with frontend engineers to build reusable dashboard shells, visualization components, filters, data tables, and entity drill\-down experiences. * Maintain strong automated unit and integration test coverage in line with team standards. **Collaboration** * Work closely with UX, Product Managers and/or Product Owners, as well as other developers to contribute to planning and grooming sessions and drive team discussions on system architecture and component design. * Partner with Product, UX, and Customer Success to understand customer AI use cases and governance needs. * Lead architecture discussions and technical planning. * Drive alignment across teams on platform design and priorities. * Contribute to sprint planning and delivery. **Support** * Reduce defects by identifying and addressing issues early in the development lifecycle. * Ensure critical and high\-priority CII's are delivered per SLA. * Promote early defect detection through strong design and testing. * Improve system monitoring, resilience, and operational maturity. **Code Review** * Set standards for clean, secure, and maintainable code. * Conduct thorough reviews for distributed and AI\-enabled systems. * Guide engineers on testing, automation, and AI system validation. **Lead** * Help build high\-performing teams by mentoring the team on new technical skills. * Influence technical strategy and long\-term platform direction. * Build a culture of ownership, learning, and engineering excellence. * Lead multi\-quarter technical roadmaps across teams and make practical build\-versus\-reuse decisions. ### **You Are** A senior technical leader with strong system design and hands\-on execution skills, who understands how enterprises use AI and LLMs in real\-world workflows and can translate those needs into scalable, secure, and compliant platform solutions. **Your Experience Includes** * Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical or business field. * 12\+ years of professional software engineering and development experience. * Strong expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring, Python, design patterns, microservices, and cloud\-native distributed systems. * Proven experience leading reusable platform, reporting, analytics, or data products that support multiple teams or dashboards. * Hands\-on experience with Cube.js, semantic layers, metric layers, or comparable metric/query abstraction systems. * Hands\-on experience with Apache Flink for real\-time stream process ith graph data models, dependency maps, entity resolution, or supply\-chain analysis. * Experience designing SDK telemetry, model gateways, runtime instrumentation, or post\-market monitoring. * Proficiency in Kubernetes, including cluster deployment, scaling, and management is highly desirable. * Background in enterprise, regulated, or security\-focused environments. ### **Where we Work** We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. ### **Benefits** As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers. ### **Resources** Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: * OneTrust Careers on YouTube * @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram ### **Your Data** You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview**.** You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com. ### **Our Commitment to You** When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - Cyber Security
jobs.description: **Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!** We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities. If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you! **Job Summary** --------------- As a Senior SOC Engineer (AI \& Automation), you will design, build, and operate the AI, automation, and detection\-engineering capabilities that power our Security Operations Center. Bridging security operations and software engineering, you will develop AI\-driven detection, triage, and response tooling, integrate large language model (LLM) and agentic workflows into analyst operations, and ensure those capabilities are accurate, safe, measurable, and continuously improved. As a senior member of the team, you will also serve as a technical leader during major security incidents, leading investigations and turning lessons learned into stronger detections, automations, and playbooks. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and maintain AI/ML\- and automation\-driven capabilities for alert enrichment, correlation, summarization, triage, and prioritization. * Develop and maintain SOAR automations and detection\-as\-code pipelines that are version\-controlled, tested, and peer\-reviewed. * Integrate LLM and agentic AI tooling into SOC workflows (copilots, auto\-triage agents); engineer prompts, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses. * Evaluate, benchmark, and tune AI models and tools for security use cases, measuring precision and recall, false\-positive reduction, and impact on mean time to detect and respond (MTTD/MTTR). * Build data pipelines and feature engineering from security telemetry to support detection and jobs.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is growing rapidly as one of the world’s major cloud platforms. The expansion of AI, machine learning, and traditional enterprise workloads is creating new demands for cloud infrastructure, from silicon to system software to the boundary where hardware and software meet. The Virtual Networking Data Plane team within OCI builds highly customizable Virtual Cloud Network data plane services on industry\-leading programmable SmartNICs and DPUs. Our work enables predictable performance, secure isolation, and high availability for OCI customers at cloud scale. We are in the middle of a generational transformation in cloud infrastructure, and we are looking for exceptional systems engineering talent to help shape what comes next. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands\-on system software engineer who enjoys building low\-level software close to the hardware. Domain\-specific processors and programmable hardware accelerators are becoming central to modern cloud infrastructure, especially as data centers evolve to support AI\-ready, efficient, and sustainable computing workloads. In this role, you will help develop software for next\-generation programmable DPUs that are foundational to OCI’s networking platform. You will work on performance\-critical systems where Linux internals, hardware\-software co\-design, and high\-performance networking come together. * Architect and implement high performance, highly available system software components – DPDK\-based networking stack, hardware abstraction layers, and custom hardware acceleration stacks. * Leverage C/C\+\+ expertise in building network virtualization, high performance packet processing and protocol parsers. * Leverage Linux OS expertise to manage memory, scheduling, I/O virtualization, kernel drivers and security features of the DPUs. * Collaborate with senior architects and peers across Compute, Storage, OS and Security groups across Oracle, to lead and drive project execution. **Why Join Us** You will be part of a team building the foundation of OCI’s next generation cloud networking platform. The work is technically deep, highly impactful, and central to the future of cloud infrastructure. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging systems problems at scale while helping build infrastructure that supports the next wave of AI, enterprise, and cloud\-native workloads. **Required Qualifications** * Expertise with systems programming in C, C\+\+, Rust, or similar low\-level languages. * Strong understanding of Linux operating system internals. * Experience with networking protocols, packet processing, or high\-performance network programming. * Familiarity with embedded systems, SmartNICs, DPUs, programmable hardware accelerators, or hardware\-adjacent software development. * Ability to debug complex software issues across operating system, driver, firmware, and hardware boundaries. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in a highly technical engineering environment. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing software for SmartNICs, DPUs, NIC drivers, kernel networking, or user\-space packet processing frameworks. * Knowledge of virtualization, cloud networking, SDN, or distributed systems. * Experience with performance tuning, concurrency, memory management, or low\-latency systems. * Background in hardware\-software co\-design or close collaboration with silicon, platform, or firmware teams.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Data Engineer is a Key Personnel position responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure. This role leads data migration from the legacy system to the modernized platform and ensures all data management practices conform Data Governance Manual Location: Huntsville, AL Clearance: Public Trust Background Investigation **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement ETL pipelines using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) to migrate legacy data to the modernized system with 100% source\-to\-target traceability. * Define and document data mappings, transformation rules, and validation logic for all migrated data elements. * Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to validate data mappings prior to implementation, achieving ≥90% SME sign\-off. * Build and maintain a comprehensive Data Dictionary and Entity Relationship Diagrams updated each sprint. * Optimize Microsoft SQL Server database schemas, queries, and indexes to meet performance targets (e.g., search queries ≤2 seconds, record retrieval ≤1 second). * Design and adapt data interfaces including the Spartan and EODIMS integrations to align with Modernization lexicon and schema. * Ensure all database work adheres to Data Governance Manual v4\.2 and relevant API standards and best practices. * Monitor and validate ETL package execution results, documenting row counts, successes, and failures each sprint. * Support the CI/CD pipeline with data\-layer test automation and ensure ETL activities are linked to user stories in Digital.ai. * Participate in Agile SCRUM ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent experience accepted. * 3\+ years of experience designing and implementing ETL pipelines using SSIS or comparable tools. * Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, including schema design, query optimization, and index tuning. * Demonstrated experience with source\-to\-target data mapping and data migration on enterprise systems. * Familiarity with federal data governance frameworks * Strong written and verbal communication skills; Work Location: In person
