jobs.title: Principal Electro-Optical/Adaptive Optics Engineer, Fusion Systems
jobs.description: Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion! **This is a full\-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO.** Xcimer is seeking a Principal Electro\-Optical/Adaptive Optics Engineer to serve as the technical authority for adaptive optics within the organization, leading the design, specification, procurement, and integration of a high\-speed custom adaptive optics system for our fusion beamlines. You will own the architecture: system\-level requirements, performance budgets, and the bandwidth, stroke, and latency trades that determine whether closed\-loop correction is good enough to put energy on target. You will also own the vendor relationships that supply the system and the commissioning that proves it works. The physics of what reaches the target decides what the adaptive optics system has to do, so this role is built around the performance model as much as the hardware. You will predict far\-field irradiance and focal\-spot quality through the beamline, decompose the error budget into fitting, temporal, measurement, calibration, and non\-common\-path terms, and use that to set the requirements on deformable mirrors, wavefront sensors, and the real\-time loop. You do not need to be at the bench yourself. You do need to be able to define the proof\-of\-concept and de\-risking experiments and direct optical engineers, laser scientists, and technicians to execute them. This is also a group\-building role. Xcimer’s adaptive optics capability is small and growing, and you will help shape what it becomes: the technical standards and development practices it works to, the hiring bar, the engineers you mentor, and technology development that outlives any single program. We move on real hardware quickly. We want the governing equations and a first\-order layout before money is committed, and we want a cheap experiment that could break the concept shortly after. We are looking for our scientists and engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy! ### **Responsibilities:** **Requirements and Performance Modeling** * Serve as technical lead for the adaptive optics system, from requirements definition through integration and commissioning. * Own adaptive optics and wavefront control requirements for the fusion beamlines, from top\-level beam quality and energy\-on\-target objectives down to component and interface specifications. * Build and maintain the end\-to\-end performance model: wave\-optics propagation through the beamline, prediction of far\-field irradiance and focal\-spot quality at target, and a wavefront error budget resolved into fitting, temporal, measurement, calibration, and non\-common\-path terms. * Own the disturbance model that drives it: beam path turbulence and gas density fluctuations, thermally induced aberration in amplifiers and transport optics, static figure error, opto\-mechanical jitter, and pulse\-to\-pulse repeatability at operational repetition rate. * Set the resulting requirements on deformable mirrors, wavefront sensors, reconstructors, and the real\-time control loop, including actuator count and stroke, bandwidth, latency, and disturbance rejection budgets, and review vendor designs against them. * Lead trade studies and architecture decisions: correction topology, sensing approach and wavelength, sampling and control rates, and where the system is limited by physics rather than by hardware. * Ensure designs meet performance, reliability, and operability requirements, and identify technical risks with mitigation plans in coordination with program management. **Vendor Engagement and Procurement** * Lead technical engagement with commercial and research vendors delivering adaptive optics components and subsystems. * Own the technical side of adaptive optics procurements and development subcontracts: statements of work, specification negotiation, vendor technical reviews, and acceptance criteria and testing, including deep\-UV coating and damage\-threshold requirements. * Plan and defend the resources the adaptive optics scope needs: scope, schedule, staffing, and build\-versus\-buy calls, including where a commercial system suffices and where development is unavoidable. * Oversee vendor design reviews, factory acceptance tests, and delivery milestones. * Act as the primary technical interface for resolving performance, schedule, and integration issues with suppliers. **Integration, T ck\-Hartmann sensing (interferometry, phase retrieval, curvature or pyramid sensing). * Experience with predictive or optimal control, system identification, or reconstructor optimization applied to a real loop. * Familiarity with real\-time software, FPGA\-based control, or low\-latency computing architectures. * Experience with beam pointing and jitter control, including opto\-mechanical jitter analysis and vibration isolation. * Familiarity with STOP (structural\-thermal\-optical performance) analysis and its use in setting opto\-mechanical requirements. * Experience with turbulence characterization in enclosed beam paths. * Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical teams, and building out a technical discipline within an organization. * Experience in multidisciplinary research laser facilities, such as national laboratories. * Experience in laboratory and operational environments that demand high reliability and uptime. * Experience writing scientific papers or program technical reports. Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job\-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. The range is published in accordance with Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and California Equal Pay Act. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Xcimer Energy is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified, diverse, and dedicated work force. Xcimer Energy hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork, in which all employees recognize and appreciate the diversity of individual team members. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Xcimer Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. For more information on “EEO Is the Law,” please see here and here. **Benefits** Xcimer offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee health, well\-being, and long\-term success. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; basic and supplemental life insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; paid parental leave for employees at the time of birth or adoption; and a 401(k) with a company match of up to 6%. Eligible employees also receive equity, allowing them to share in the company’s long\-term success. Xcimer operates under a flexible Paid Time Off (ATO) approach. Rather than a fixed number of vacation days, employees are trusted to take the time they need to rest and recharge while meeting the expectations of their role and team. In addition, employees receive paid sick time, 13 company\-paid holidays, and an annual paid company shutdown. Benefits are available to regular employees, including part\-time and fixed\-term roles, as well as interns, with eligibility varying by benefit. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Platform & Integrations
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We started our company to help others launch and run their own businesses, at any stage. The way we help is by keeping it simple and supporting entrepreneurs one step at a time. Put simply: our mission is to enable anyone to start, run, and grow their business while avoiding the common pitfalls that derail hopeful entrepreneurs. No more having to wade through forms, taxes, or ongoing state compliance. We are a remote company based in Austin, Texas. We have team members from Florida to Oregon and all points in\-between. Take pride in your work knowing that it shapes how people all across the country reach their goal of starting, running, and growing their business. If the idea of helping people and working with a genuinely caring, supportive team excites you, then you've come to the right place. **The Role** We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Enterprise Platform and Integrations team. This leader will be responsible for the people, platforms, and delivery practices that power our external partner integrations and connect partner experiences to ZenBusiness's formation, compliance, pricing, and fulfillment capabilities. This role combines engineering leadership with strong integration responsibilities. The Director will lead a pod of engineers, establish the technical strategy and evolve our Platform into a clear set of domain\-aligned capabilities exposed through stable APIs, event , hosted domain services, agent ready tools and work closely with Product, Business Systems, Operations, and external partners to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who understands modern API architecture and can translate business and partner needs into sustainable technical solutions. **Responsibilities** ### **Engineering and People Leadership** * Lead, coach, and develop the engineers supporting Platform APIs and partner integrations. * Create clear ownership, expectations, and development opportunities across the team. * Establish effective engineering practices for planning, design reviews, code reviews, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support. * Partner with Product and business leaders to build realistic roadmaps and make clear tradeoffs across partner commitments, platform investments, technical debt, and team capacity. * Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and succession planning for the team. * Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. ### **API and Platform Strategy** * Define the technical vision and roadmap for ZenBusiness's Enterprise APIs and integration capabilities. * Lead the design and evolution of APIs, schemas, webhooks, authentication, fulfillment packages, and supporting developer tools. * Ensure APIs are scalable, secure, observable, well documented, and easy for partners to adopt. * Establish standards for API versioning, backward compatibility, change management, deprecation, and release communication. * Reduce partner\-specific customizations by developing reusable platform capabilities and consistent integration patterns. * Partner with internal platform teams to connect Enterprise APIs to formation, compliance, pricing, order management, schemas, and fulfillment workflows. * Lead through influence across engineering teams whose systems contribute to the end\-to\-end partner experience, establishing clear ownership and resolving cross\-team dependencies. * Evolve core business capabilities so they can be safely discovered and invoked by AI agents through MCP and other emerging standards, with clear authorization, observability, guardrails, and human oversight. ### **Partner Integrations** * Represent ZenBusiness in senior\-level technical conversations with strategic partners to understand their architecture, requirements, constraints, and implementation plans, while clearly communicating decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery expectations. * Guide partners through solution design, testing, and launch. Establish clear launch\-readiness criteria and lead technical go/no\-go decisions, production stabilization, and ongoing integration health. * Translate partner needs into platform capabilities while protecting the long\-term integrity of the architecture. * Identify integration risks early and create clear mitigation and escalation plans. * Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Sales, Partner Success, Operations, Legal, Security, and Finance when delivering new partner capabilities. * Ensure partner commitments, dependencies, ownership, and launch criteria are clearly documented and understood. ### **Delivery and Operational Excellence** * Own the reliable delivery of API and integration roadmap commitments. * Improve release processes for schemas, fulfillment packages, portal updates, changelogs, and production deployments. * Establish service\-level objectives and operational metrics for API availability, latency, errors, and enterprise integration platforms. * Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, event\-driven architecture, authentication, API gateways, versioning, and integration security. * Experience delivering complex integrations involving multiple internal systems and external partners. * Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Strong understanding of software delivery, testing, observability, incident management, and production operations. * Experience managing technical roadmaps, dependencies, risks, and cross\-functional delivery. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical decisions to nontechnical audiences. * Experience participating in customer\- or partner\-facing technical conversations. * Ability to balance urgent partner needs with long\-term platform health. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building developer portals, integration sandboxes, API documentation, SDKs, or partner certification programs. * Experience supporting high\-volume, business\-critical integrations. * Familiarity with schema\-driven platforms, API lifecycle management, and automated contract testing. * Experience leading teams through platform modernization or the migration of legacy integrations. * Experience working in a product\-led, SaaS, or platform organization. * Experience leading complex, partner\-facing enterprise integrations, including direct communication with senior product and engineering leaders at external companies. * Strong prioritization and stakeholder\-management skills, especially when contractual or launch commitments compete with internal platform investments, operational needs, and technical debt. * The ability to move between executive\-level conversations and detailed technical or delivery decisions without becoming either a purely strategic leader or the team's day\-to\-day solution architect. **Leadership Profile** ---------------------- We are looking for a leader who: * Develops people and creates clarity without becoming a delivery bottleneck. * Is technically credible but does not need to be the person writing every solution. * Can move comfortably between architecture, execution, operations, and partner conversations. * Makes pragmatic decisions while protecting long\-term platform scalability. * Communicates risks and tradeoffs early and clearly. * Builds strong relationships across technical, product, operational, and commercial teams. * Treats documentation, reliability, and knowledge sharing as essential parts of engineering. **Remote Culture.**A great company culture leads to happy employees, and happy employees lead to happy customers. We provide our employees with good salaries, benefits, equity, and interesting challenges that have a positive impact. **Let's stay connected!** We believe in staying connected, and we have a weekly "All Hands" meeting every week. We also have a social committee that hosts frequent events. We've held a virtual talent show, costume competitions, monthly lunch and learn series, Hackathons and more! **Benefits.** The company offers various benefits to employees and their dependents, including medical, vision, dental, disability, and life insurance, as well as parental and military leave. Other benefits include an employee assistance program, 401k \+ match, annual bonus, pet insurance, and RSUs. Paid parking\* and 10 paid holidays are also provided. **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.** We believe in diversity, equity \& inclusion. At ZenBusiness, every voice counts no matter your race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, location, or background. We celebrate the diversity of our teams, knowing that our products, services, and customers thrive best when we lean into and celebrate our differences. Please check out our careers' page to learn more about our culture, benefits, and open opportunities. * applicable to in\-office employees

jobs.title: Director, Marketing AI & Automation
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Zillow Group is seeking a Director, Marketing AI \& Automation to lead a new team within Marketing, Technology \& Operations. This role will be accountable for delivering Marketing AI big bets, responsible for the roadmap, the platform, the governance, and the path that carries use cases into scaled production. This role is responsible for shepherding AI big bets from strategy development to scaled implementation, including the platform and integration work they depend on, the measurement that proves impact, the change management that makes them stick, and the handoff to the teams who will run them day to day. The role also owns what comes next: sourcing and shaping the next generation of bets as the technology and the business shift, building the case for what to invest behind, and deciding what to retire. This role will be responsible for building and leading a multidisciplinary team responsible for scaling AI use cases. The team is expected to have a mix of strategic, technical and operational skills. **About the role** ------------------ **Key Responsibilities** Own the Marketing AI roadmap: Setting and defending the use\-case portfolio, including what gets built, in what order, and for whom, prioritized against reclaimed capacity and business impact * Run the path from idea to production: Building and operating the intake stage\-gate from idea to pilot to production to owned, including the handoff model that transfers run\-state to the team accountable for the outcome * Stand up the agent and orchestration platform: Owning the shared layer, reusable components, and the data and vendor integration that AI use cases depend on, focused on integration and orchestration rather than model building * Own AI governance for Marketing: Running agent audits, brand\-risk scoring, and exclusion zones in partnership with Legal and Brand, aligned to Zillow's AI Principles and to external standards * Drive adoption across the org: Running the adoption program and the network of embedded AI liaisons so that capability is embedded in day\-to\-day workflows rather than sitting unused * Build and lead the team: Hiring into net\-new technical and strategic roles, integrating talent redeployed from across Marketing, and setting the performance bar for a newly formed team * * Report value to leadership: Owning the measurement of capacity gained, speed to market, and business impact, including a clear account of what did not work This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $231,000\.00 \- $369,000\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $219,500\.00 \- $350,600\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- 10\+ years in marketing technology, growth engineering, applied AI, or technical product, including 4\+ years leading teams. * Production track record: Has moved AI use cases from proof of concept to scaled operation, and can speak specifically to what was built, what broke along the way, and what the measured impact was * Marketing fluency: Strong understanding of how Marketing operate, with enough depth to hold a substantive conversation with a channel leader about where AI helps and where it does not * Technically credible: Able to go deep with engineers on agent orchestration, data integration, and evaluation, and to distinguish a serious architecture from a demo, without needing to build models directly. Familiarity with a modern composable stack (CDP, reverse ETL, cloud data platform, enterprise LLM tooling) highly valued * Enablement mindset: Track record running a center\-led function that transferred capability outward as it matured, rather than accumulating ownership. Experience standing up a center of excellence or platform team from zero a plus * Governance judgment: Experience managing brand, legal, and privacy risk in AI systems, and building the review mechanisms rather than resisting them * Influence without authority: Able to drive outcomes that land inside other teams, on other roadmaps, without direct control * Build\-versus\-buy judgment: Experience evaluating and managing AI and martech vendors, with a clear view of when a platform partner beats an internal build * * Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a technical or business field (MBA, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics) a plus **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record\-to\-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real\-time financial intelligence. By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco. **About the Job:** ### **About the Job** Lead Zone \& Co.'s GTM Engineering function and become the driving force behind AI adoption across our go\-to\-market organization. We ditch micro\-management for high\-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Planner GPU Compute
jobs.description: Zoox made the world’s first purpose\-built commercial robotaxi, combining advanced self\-driving hardware and software. In order to ensure safe operation, low latency and consistent resource utilization are critical. The Planner Compute team is responsible for the performance of the largest single software component within the autonomy stack, the motion planner. The Planner Compute team is looking for an expert in GPU performance. You will instrument, monitor, analyze and optimize GPU\-based algorithms that are performance\-critical for our solution. The scope for GPU usage ranges from machine learning inference to custom CUDA kernels written specifically for the motion planner. ### **In this role, you will:** * Analyze performance metrics to identify GPU hotspots and optimizations * Contribute to the adaptation of our current planner to multiple GPU architectures with different resources * Optimize ML models for latency and GPU memory usage * Support engineers within Planner as a subject matter expert on CUDA \& GPU performance ### **Qualifications** * BS in computer science or related field and 3\+ years of experience. * Strong knowledge of CUDA as applied to recent GPU microarchitectures (e.g., Ampere, Blackwell) and experience debugging/optimizing GPU kernels using tools like Nsight. * Strong knowledge of C\+\+ and experience in large code bases, comfortable in Linux development environments. * Experience in development, debugging, and profiling of complex multiprocess systems (e.g., robotic systems, game engines). ### **Bonus Qualifications** GPU kernel development experience There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Engineer – New Product Development Robotics
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space. AutoStore – moving things forward. **The Role:** AutoStore is hiring a Senior Electronics Engineer who has carried new products to market. We are looking for an Engineer with experience taking a product from 0 \- 1, someone who has felt the consequences of their own design decisions at 10,000 units, not 10\. The successful engineer will have owned PCBAs through the messy parts: EMC chamber failures two weeks before certification, yield drops at the EMS partner, and the design trade\-offs required to recover without compromising long\-term reliability. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** **PCBA Ownership – Concept Through to Serial Production Ready** * Set hardware architecture, component strategy, and BOM cost/risk profile for assigned boards. * Schematic design and layout; own signal integrity, power integrity, and thermal outcomes. * Lead bring\-up and root\-cause analysis. * Own EMC and safety compliance, from design\-for\-EMC through pre\-compliance and formal certification. * Lead DFM/DFT/DFx with EMS partners; define production test strategy and coverage. * Own NPI, pilot builds, and 0\-series. * Partner with firmware on control discussions, implementation and fault handling. Design robust technology with the noise immunity a moving robotic platform demands. * **System and Organizational Contribution** * Contribute to electronics design standards, reusable building blocks, and design review practice in functional excellence groups. * Assess how your designs could impact the wider AutoStore portfolio through a platform approach, and flag cross\-product benefits and drawbacks. * Working within a cross\-functional NPD team and foster multidiscipline collaboration between functional disciplines. Mentor to mid\-level and junior engineers; you review their designs and help raise the bar of the team, not just your own output. * **Key Qualifications:** * Master's in Electronics or equivalent. * 7\+ years in electronics engineering spanning analog, digital, and power electronics. * How owned design for high\-volume manufacturing with global EMS suppliers. * Dealt with sensor interface design and embedded communication bus design in electrically noisy, electromechanical environments. * Experienced with CAN, SPE/Ethernet, I2C, RS\-485, etc. * Architected and designed advanced motor driver PCBAs and power electronics. * Experience designing embedded electronics and systems ranging from resource constrained microcontroller platforms to Linux based embedded systems. * Dealt with safety and compliance issues around fault detection, safe state designs and diagnostics. * Deep and practical EMC competence — design\-for\-EMC, not just test attendance. * DFM \& DFT for high\-volume electromechanical products. * Battery\-powered systems and system power budgeting. Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction for others, reviewing designs, and mentoring. * **We Offer:** AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3, Search Backend
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. **About the team and the role:** We are looking for a talented mid\-level engineer to join the Search Backend team and help us push the boundaries of index distribution. You'll be at the heart of building and operating the distribution pipelines that deliver search indexes to thousands of Search nodes, serving as the critical backbone that keeps eBay's search engine fast, fresh, and reliable. This is a high\-stakes, high\-impact role where your work is the foundation of a superior Search experience for hundreds of millions of eBay users every day. **Responsibilities:** * Design and build core components of eBay's search index distribution infrastructure including real\-time streaming pipelines that move data with precision and speed across thousands of nodes. * Architect highly scalable, fault\-tolerant pipelines that power both real\-time and batch index distribution at global scale. * Build intelligent systems for auto\-managing index distribution clusters — think self\-healing infrastructure with proactive health monitoring, smart alerting, and automated remediation. * Take full ownership of distributed pipeline components from initial design all the way to production, driving quality and reliability at every step. * Write clean, well\-documented code that is maintainable, extensible, and ready to scale and built for the long haul. * Work closely with Search Backend, Infrastructure, and partner teams to ensure indexes are fresh, consistent, and delivered on time, every time. * Dive deep into complex distributed system issues debugging and troubleshooting pipeline failures, index delivery anomalies, and performance bottlenecks across a large\-scale, multi\-pool infrastructure. **Requirements:** * BS/BA or above in Computer Science or a related field * 4 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production applications * Demonstrated ability building backend distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, replication, and concurrency * Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, and the fundamentals of distributed systems * Strong proficiency in Java, Scala, or similar languages * Proven hands\-on experience with streaming and data pipeline technologies \- Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar * Experience with cluster coordination tools like Zookeeper * Hands\-on experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed services at scale * Familiarity with search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, Elasticsearch, or proprietary search engines **Additional Details** The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below: $98,000 \- $173,600 Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employees will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship. eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. jobs.description: **We’re changing the way people connect to social care.** ========================================================= At Findhelp, we’ve built a comprehensive platform of products and services that make it easy for you to connect people to resources, follow them on their journey, and track your impact in a fast and reliable way. Our industry\-leading social care network includes more than half a million local, state, and national programs that serve every ZIP Code in the country, from rural areas to major metropolitan centers. Findhelp is headquartered in Austin, Texas and has been enabling healthcare, government, education, and other organizations to connect people with the social care resources that serve them, with privacy and security, since 2010\. As a mission driven organization, we are focused on creating a positive impact by connecting people in need to the programs that serve them with dignity and ease. Powered by our proprietary technology that enables people to find the resources available in their area, we have helped millions of Seekers find food, health, housing and employment programs. **Job Overview:** The R\&D Department is made up of different disciplines including software and database engineers, quality, technical implementation. R\&D designs and develops requested product features, fixes bugs within our platform, provides technical analysis and estimation, ensures successful integration installations, manages and monitors the health of our platform, and develops automation and tooling for efficient and reliable software development processes. R\&D works cross\-functionally with many other departments in the organization as a team to fulfill Findhelp’s mission of connecting all people in need and the programs that serve them with dignity and ease. We are looking for a software development engineer in test to monitor and improve the quality of our operational processes and outputs. The SDET's responsibilities include designing quality standards, inspecting materials, equipment, processes, and products, developing quality control systems, and determining corrective actions. You will also work with managers and supervisors to implement quality measures. **Responsibilities and Duties:** * Ensure products, features, and processes meet established quality standards by identifying gaps and risks. * Develop corrective measures and implement quality control systems and standards. * Conduct inspections and testing of materials, equipment, processes, and software to ensure quality specifications are met. * Monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance metrics for your team or functional area. * Collaborate with product, development, and operations teams to develop and implement process improvements. * Design, implement, and maintain automated test cases and frameworks to improve test coverage, reliability, and efficiency. * Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of broader test automation frameworks. * Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve product or process issues. * Review codes, specifications, and workflows to ensure compliance with internal standards and safety regulations. * Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of test automation frameworks, focusing on reliability and efficiency. * Provide guidance to junior team members when needed. **Qualifications / Traits:** * 4–5\+ years of experience in software development quality engineering, quality assurance, or a related role. * Highly detail\-oriented; you naturally notice gaps others might miss. * Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining automated test cases. * Entrepreneurial mindset: adaptable to change, proactive in creating solutions rather than just following established processes. * Team player with discipline: collaborates effectively while staying focused on delivering results. * Fluency with multiple types of web application testing (smoke, functional, integration, API, performance, etc.). * Experience coding and using QA software tools and processes. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and project management skills. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. **We value being together** : We believe being together enables stronger relationships, collaboration, and culture. **This position is in office and candidates must be located in Austin, Texas or Madison, Wisconsin.** **Perks at Findhelp** 401k \& equity grants Free food and onsite gym at our Austin HQ Paid parental leave Competitive PTO \& 10 paid holidays Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance with **100% company\-paid coverage** for employee only coverage Dog\-friendly office in Austin HQ 24/7 access to telemedicine and counseling Book Purchasing Program **We’re building a diverse, inclusive team** You’re welcome here. We want everyone to be able to easily connect to the help they need, and we want our teams to reflect and represent our communities. It is our policy to recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals, as well as administer any and all Company policies, without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin or ancestry, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, creed, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, or any other protected class, in accordance with applicable laws. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities. Here are some of the ways we support our staff: Culture Committee Leadership Development Training Paid Volunteering Time

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About iDC Logistics** iDC Logistics, founded in 2004 by logistics industry veterans, is a leading end\-to\-end logistics company focused on transparency, efficiency, and innovative supply chain solutions. Headquartered in Los Angeles, iDC provides integrated services including freight forwarding, contract logistics, transportation, and distribution management for retailers worldwide. With expertise across consumer electronics, industrial products, and healthcare industries, iDC Logistics delivers customized logistics solutions through operational excellence, technology\-enabled processes, and customer\-focused service. Our success is driven by a commitment to customer satisfaction, employee engagement, and continuous innovation. **Position Summary** The **Senior Data Engineer** owns the operation of that platform as it moves into production: environments, database administration, security roles and grants, refresh and orchestration, monitoring, deployment and CI. The role also delivers well\-scoped production data work within existing patterns, so that architecture and design work can continue in parallel. Platform architecture, the security model and the data roadmap are owned by the Principal Data Engineer. This role holds deep, autonomous ownership beneath that architecture, primarily the operational and database\-administration side of the platform. **Key Responsibilities** * **Production operations and platform health.** Own environment setup and management, refresh and orchestration operations, monitoring and alerting, and incident response for a platform supporting production report delivery and billing. * **Database administration.** Manage security\-role hierarchies, grants, performance and maintenance. * **Deployment and CI.** Maintain pipeline automation and environment promotion so that releases are routine and reliable. * **Modeling and transformation delivery.** Build staging and gold dbt models, with tests, against defined business semantics and existing conventions. Flag requests that would conflict with established definitions. * **Code review.** Review teammates’ work, including AI\-generated code, for correctness and adherence to standards. * **Reverse\-engineering source systems.** Analyze and absorb legacy and vendor source systems, many with undocumented schemas, as a recurring part of the role. * **Report and billing parity.** Validate that new platform outputs match the legacy system’s reporting and billing figures before cutover. **Required Qualification** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. * **7\+ years of experience** designing, developing, and maintaining large\-scale data pipelines and data warehouse solutions. * **SQL at working depth:** joins, window functions, grain and aggregation tradeoffs, NULL semantics, and the ability to reason about why a query returns what it returns. * **Production Python:** has written and maintained Python code that ran in production. * **Pipeline experience:** has owned scheduled data pipelines in production, including diagnosing and fixing failures. * **Transformation framework:** working depth in at least one modern framework. dbt preferred; SQLMesh, Dataform, Coalesce, Databricks declarative pipelines or a comparable in\-house framework also qualify. * **Production operations:** responsibility for running systems, including deployments, environment management, on\-call or equivalent, and incident response. * **Dimensional modeling:** grain, facts and dimensions, conformance and slowly\-changing history. * **Git\-based workflow:** branching, pull requests, code review and CI as standard practice. * **Communication:** clear in writing, in conversation and in presentations, including explaining technical findings to non\-technical stakeholders. * **Independent problem\-solving:** able to investigate unfamiliar problems substantially before escalating. * **AI tooling:** uses AI tools as a regular part of engineering work for research, design and verification; has built tooling for their own workflow; verifies AI output before relying on it. **Preferred Qualifications** * Multi\-tenant or customer\-facing data experience (isolation, audit, lineage) * Azure (Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault); AWS or GCP experience transfers * Snowflake * Terraform or equivalent infrastructure\-as\-code * Legacy and vendor\-system reverse\-engineering * Logistics, supply\-chain or warehousing domain experience * Familiarity with BI tools **Benefits** The company offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as basic and voluntary life and voluntary ancillary coverages for accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity. Full\-time employees are eligible for paid sick leave, bereavement, holiday and vacation pay. Employees are eligible to participate in the company 401k plan on the first day of the third month following hire date. **Why Join iDC Logitics?** At iDC Logistics, you will join a growing organization committed to operational excellence, innovation, and employee success. We offer the opportunity to make a significant impact by partnering with leadership, shaping organizational culture, and helping drive business performance through people\-focused strategies. *iDC Logistics Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, age, disability, sexual and gender orientation, genetic information or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of the company’s employment practices including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, promoting, transferring, compensation, benefits, training, leaves of absence, termination, and other terms and conditions of employment.* *This job description is intended to set forth the core functions required for this position and describe the general nature of the work performed by employees in this position. It may not contain a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees to do this job. Employees may be assigned additional* Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Vision insurance

jobs.title: Head of Growth, Hospitality
jobs.description: ### **Who we are** The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive\-in, drive\-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn't coming; it's here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it. ### **Who you are** Metropolis is seeking a Head of Growth, Hospitality, to serve as a critical commercial leadership position responsible for developing and executing the growth strategy for the hospitality segment. This leader will shape the long\-term vision and roadmap for profitable growth in Metropolis's hospitality sector, bringing together data\-driven insights, commercial strategy, and ecosystem partnerships while owning the segment growth number. You will drive commercial expansion, scale innovative parking, security, and recognition technology, expand vertical marketing narratives, and forge key enterprise partnerships with major hospitality brands while collaborating cross\-functionally across product, sales, marketing, and operations to establish market leadership. ### **What you'll do** * Lead strategy and execution to grow our hospitality vertical and location base across all regions by partnering with sales and operations teams to close business * Open and win deals in key national accounts within the hospitality vertical while co\-selling alongside regional sellers on high\-priority accounts * Ensure vertically\-oriented value proposition is strong and establish vertical\-standard commercial structures and deal terms * Scale hospitality B2B marketing initiatives, trade\-press coverage, and vertical conference presence across major conventions and associations to ensure Metropolis becomes a recognizable brand * Build strategic partnerships and collaborations with key consultants, advisors, channel partners, and enterprise influencing bodies across major hospitality brands * Collaborate cross\-functionally across product, marketing, sales, and operations to scale core offerings and develop the roadmap for additional vertical products * Build a strong partnership with product leaders to translate customer input into product\-market fit and drive actual impact from our products * Co\-lead the unified product and service roadmap, defining wayfinding solutions, validation strategies, and biometric integrations * Commercialize and scale the Metropolis Recognition Platform throughout the hospitality industry * Partner with the data team to establish performance dashboards showcasing value creation for hoteliers, and drive thought leadership in industry forums to fuel top\-of\-funnel pipeline ### **What we're looking for** * 15\+ years in the hospitality industry segment with proven commercial growth leadership * Strong background in strategy, business development, partnerships, P\&L management, and a track record of winning key national accounts * Extensive contacts, respected relationships, and an established network of vertical\-specific partners across the industry * Skilled in financial modeling, structuring vertical\-standard commercial deal terms, data\-driven decision\-making, and market analysis * Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional teams, partner closely with product leaders to align customer input to product\-market fit, and drive organizational alignment * Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills * Experience leveraging AI platforms and data\-driven tools to accelerate commercial growth, optimize pipeline performance, and scale vertical sales strategies ### **While not required, these are a plus:** * MBA degree or equivalent **4 Days in Office:** Metropolis values in\-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office\-first model, which requires employees to be on\-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world\-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $200,000\.00 USD to $230,000\.00 USD annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base salary is one component of Metropolis' total compensation package, which may also include access to or eligibility for healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans, and more. \#LI\-WT1 \#LI\-Onsite *Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. AEDTs are used to assist in assessing a candidate's application relative to the required job qualifications and responsibilities listed in the job posting.* *As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records.* *Metropolis Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs — without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.* *We are committed to providing a welcoming, accessible hiring experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please reach out to us at* *recruiting@metropolis.io**.*

jobs.title: Senior Operational Engineer
jobs.description: . **About Nscale** ---------------- Nscale is the GPU cloud built for AI. We run high\-performance, cost\-efficient infrastructure for AI\-native startups and global enterprises, from bare metal up through the platform services teams actually build on. Our culture runs on ownership, accountability, and speed. We move with urgency, we tell each other the truth, and everyone here stays close to the infrastructure that makes AI work. **The role** ------------ We are looking for a Senior Operational Engineer to lead cross\-service improvements that make Nscale's engineering services more reliable, secure, controlled, and cost\-aware. You will design and deliver shared operational capabilities—such as service\-readiness standards, canary checks, runbooks, reporting, alerting workflows, and automation—and partner with service teams to address systemic operational risks. This is a hands\-on technical role with significant influence across engineering. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Take ownership of the design and delivery of shared operational capabilities, including readiness checks, canaries, runbooks, service\-health reporting, and operational automation. * Establish practical standards for service ownership, on\-call readiness, alerts, dashboards, recovery procedures, and operational evidence. * Partner with service teams to identify and resolve recurring operational issues and cross\-team blockers. * Design and improve integrations and workflows across Grafana, PagerDuty, Jira, Backstage, public\-cloud platforms, and reporting systems. * Turn incident findings, change failures, and near misses into lasting engineering improvements. * Act as an incident commander and lead technical analysis for incidents; support corrective\-action planning and delivery. * Build safe, observable, auditable automations that reduce manual work and improve the speed and quality of operational execution. * Automate operational reporting, including SLA performance, health indicators, cost trends, patching status, and action closure. * Mentor engineers, review operational designs, and raise the technical standard of the wider team. * Contribute to continuity testing and focused failure\-and\-recovery experiments. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 6–10 years' experience in operations engineering, SRE, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or a similar production\-focused engineering role. * Experience designing and operating shared capabilities for monitoring, alerting, on\-call, runbooks, service readiness, and operational reporting. * Hands\-on experience building integrations and automations across Grafana, PagerDuty, Jira, Backstage, and public cloud. * Experience using incident, change, service\-health, continuity, patching, or cost data to drive operational improvement. * Ability to lead cross\-service work, set practical standards, and support teams through incidents. *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*
